izzyondroid:com.andreacioccarelli.androo.summary: Expert-grade free and open-source tweaking toolbox for Android
izzyondroid:com.andreacioccarelli.androo.description:
Androoster is a comprehensive open-source and free Android root tweak toolbox. It is built to help you tweak your device, keeping it cool, fast and responsive.
 Ideally, basing on your device hardware and your personal needs, you can find a set of parameters for Androoster to improve things you value and minimize others you don't require.
 Being a collection of on-off tweaks, you can enable/disable whichever set of parameters you desire. Although a certain degree of expertise is required to tune (or eyeball) settings, you can refine your tweaks according to the performance changes you experience incrementally.
 The key takeaway is that there is no such thing as a universal tweak / booster. Instead, you can (and should) tune settings according to the things you value the most to maximize performance in those designated areas, and keep the unavoidable consequences within an acceptable margin of degradation.
 (i.e, a strong performance improvement degrades battery duration, and vice versa, differently for every device and OS)
 Androoster features 
 CPU Tuning
 Governor switcher
 Low Memory Killer editor
 Runtime Memory improvement
 Sleep mode tuner
 Sleepers optimization
 Kernel advanced editor
 FStrim utility
 I/O Booster
 Hostname editor
 Network buffer
 Fast dormancy
 Advanced debug monitor
 GPS Configuration
 Animations speed tweaker
 JPEG quality optimizer
 270° Rotation enabler
 16 bit transparency enabler
 Back buttons light tuner
 Prerequisites 
 Rooted device
 BusyBox installation
 Main features 
 There are tons of tweaks, both for beginners and advanced users. They are grouped under different categories, like “CPU”, “Memory”, “Kernel” or “Graphics”, so that they are easy to find and manage.

izzyondroid:de.tu_darmstadt.seemoo.nfcga.name: NFCGate
izzyondroid:de.tu_darmstadt.seemoo.nfcga.summary: An NFC research toolkit application for Android
izzyondroid:de.tu_darmstadt.seemoo.nfcga.description:
NFCGate is an Android application meant to capture, analyze, or modify NFC traffic. It can be used as a researching tool to reverse engineer protocols or assess the security of protocols against traffic modifications.
 On-device capture : Captures NFC traffic sent and received by other applications running on the device.
 Relay : Relays NFC traffic between two devices using a server . One device operates as a "reader" reading an NFC tag, the other device emulates an NFC tag using the Host Card Emulation (HCE).
 Replay : Replays previously captured NFC traffic in either "reader" or "tag" mode.
 Clone : Clones the initial tag information (e.g. ID).
 pcapng export of captured NFC traffic, readable by Wireshark.

 Tap "Calculate"
 View your results
 To clear all 3 fields, tap the "clear" Button.
 🚨DISCLAIMER🚨: This is NOT a medical application NOR a medical product. This is just a calculator. Correct results are not guaranteed. User is responsible for checking results and plausibility.
 Created with ❤️ by Valentin. Tags: calculator, alcoholic solution, volume percent, v/v, Volumenprozent, Volumenprozentrechner, Alkoholgehalt, alcohol content, mass of alcohol (grams), specific weigth, spezifisches Gewicht, Normalbedingungen.

fdroid:com.juliencardoux.ratafuel.name: Ratafuel
fdroid:com.juliencardoux.ratafuel.summary: Find the cheapest fuel in France near you.
fdroid:com.juliencardoux.ratafuel.description:
Ratafuel help you find the cheapest fuel in France near your.
Fuel price data in France is public, free, and legally mandatory. However, most applications are saturated with ads and trackers at the expense of privacy and accessibility. Access to information is a fundamental right and should not be traded for your privacy.
 Ratafuel is a 100% free, open-source application with absolutely zero trackers, zero ads and built to respect user freedom. 
 FEATURES 
- Displays current prices and locations of gas stations throughout France
- Quickly identify the cheapest stations using a color code
- Filter price based on preferred fuel type
- Filter gas stations based on retailer brand
- Search for a specific city without needing to enable device location
- Navigate to the selected station using any navigation app
- View and access all public open-data sources with full transparency
- Customize the app appearance and settings
- Support French & English
- Privacy first: no tracking, no ads, zero data collection and fully open-source
- Simple and straight to the point app
 PERMISSIONS 
Location permissions (ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) are used exclusively to show your position locally within the app. Location permissions are optional and can be enabled or disabled by the user at any time, the app will function perfectly without them.
 SETUP 
1. Launch the application once downloaded.
2. Choose whether or not to use your device's location to find the cheapest price near you.
3. Choose whether or not to enable Automatic Updates. If enabled, the station data will be updated every week at startup.
4. Click the Download button to download stations data locally.
5. You can customize the app in the Parameters section or simply use it as is!
 PRIVACY 
Ratafuel collects no data. There are no analytics, no ads, no trackers. As stated above, location permissions are used exclusively to show your position locally within the app. No location data is ever collected, stored, or shared.
 GOVERNMENT LIMITATIONS 
The publication of fuel prices is a legal obligation for fuel distributors, as required by Articles 5 and 6 of the Ministerial Order of 8 July 1988 ¹ .
The Département d'outre-mer are unfortunately not displayed within Ratafuel due to uncomprehensible missing data from the Fuel Price French Government API.
In the DOM, fuel prices are regulated every month by prefects setting a maximum price via prefectural decrees, in accordance with Articles R671-1 to R671-31 of the French Energy Code ² .
Without any further justification and without any apparent technical problem, these data are not added to the public database of fuel prices.
Under Article 73 of the Constitution ³ , regulations are applicable as of right in these departments, unless expressly derogated. No identifiable derogating provision seems to exclude the DOM from this publication.
Due to a lack of reliable data, the DOM are unfortunately not supported for now.
 NOTES 
- ¹ https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/loda/id/JORFTEXT000000688923/
- ² https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/codes/section_lc/LEGITEXT000023983208/LEGISCTA000031749957/
- ³ https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/loda/article_lc/LEGIARTI000019241099

fdroid:dev.ioanm.fissh.name: FiSSH
fdroid:dev.ioanm.fissh.summary: SSH authentication via Fingerprint scanning over network (TLS Sockets)
fdroid:dev.ioanm.fissh.description:
This Android app stores your SSH key phrase and sends it to your PC securely via the LAN when an authorized fingerprint is detected by the Android fingerprint scanner.
This app is free open-source software (licensed MIT)
The PC must either run Linux or Windows to use FiSSH.
 FiSSH for Linux is available on GitLab together with install instructions at: https://www.gitlab.com/ioanm/fissh-desktop/blob/master/INSTALL.md .
 FiSSH for Windows uses the Windows Subsystem for Linux. The Windows edition is also open source and published to: https://www.gitlab.com/ioanm/fissh-windows .
To install FiSSH for Windows run the command inside WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) UBUNTU distro:
 curl https://www.gitlab.com/ioanm/fissh-windows/raw/master/Release/install.sh | sudo bash 
The PC app then returns the received passphrase to OpenSSH and the standard ssh binary completes the login process.
It is important to note that none of the FiSSH apps have access to private key file and that FiSSH uses TLS sockets with certificate validation to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks!
Source Code:
Linux part - https://www.gitlab.com/ioanm/FiSSH-Desktop 
Android app - https://www.gitlab.com/ioanm/FiSSH-App

fdroid:io.github.tablechips.summary: Chips for a card table. One phone hosts; guests join from a browser, offline.
fdroid:io.github.tablechips.description:
TableChips replaces the chips at a real card game, played with a real deck. One phone hosts the table over its own hotspot; everybody else scans a code and plays from their browser, iPhone or Android. Nobody needs the internet, an account or to install anything.
 It keeps the chips and nothing else: it never deals cards. You shuffle, you deal, you play as you always have, and the app counts.
 Games 
 7½ (set i mig) and blackjack , with a bank: everybody stakes against it and the bank settles each hand from the table.
 Poker : a moving button, blinds, call amounts and side pots.
 Manual mode for any other game: pots, bets and payouts by hand.
 Why this one 
 Guests install nothing. The host serves a web page; an iPhone and an Android at the same table both just open a browser. Anyone with the app can join through it instead.
 No internet, ever. Everything runs on the host's hotspot: it works in a mountain hut, a campsite or a village without signal.
 Up to ten players , each on their own device, each with their stack in figures big enough to read across the table.
 Unlimited undo and a full log of every move. You can always type the amount.
 Built for a long night: phones reconnect, seats can be recovered, and the table survives the host app being closed.
 Catalan, Spanish and English from the first screen.
 TableChips counts chips. It has no money, no payments and no accounts: what a chip is worth is up to the people at the table.
 Free software under the GPLv3. No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking.

fdroid:net.retiolus.ganxet.description:
Ganxet is a timer for board games. Put the phone in the middle of the table: each player sees their own clock, turned towards them. Tap anywhere on the screen to end your turn.
 Two modes 
 Time bank : each player has a time bank for the whole game, with an optional bonus after each turn and optional elimination at zero.
 Per turn : the clock restarts on every turn, and can pass automatically to the next player.
 Features 
 2 to 8 players, seated clockwise around the screen
 Undo the last turn, pause with a long press, summary at the end of the game
 A game in progress is saved and can be resumed after the app is closed
 Optional Do Not Disturb during games
 Large text support, one shape per player color, screen reader support
 English, Catalan and French
No ads, no tracking, no network access.

A common complaint among cell phone users is missing calls while at home even with the ring volume on high. Cell2Jack connects your cell phone to your home phone, so you can make and receive calls on any home phone extension, while still using your cell phone calling plan.
* Place your Cell Phone next to Cell2Jack when you get home.
* Answer your cellphone calls with any home phone.

apple-macos:6799437801.name: CartCircle: Shopping List
apple-macos:6799437801.description:
CartCircle is a shopping list for different stores and for shopping together with your family. Add items manually, by voice, from pasted text, or from a screenshot. Everyone in a shared list sees what still needs to be bought.
A list for every store
• Keep separate lists for personal and family stores. Add quantities and units so every item is clear.
• Put items in the order that works for you and mark off what you have bought.
• Add frequently bought items again in just a few taps.
Add items faster
• Say your shopping items naturally. CartCircle separates them and recognizes quantities.
• Paste text or choose a screenshot of a list. Recognized items appear in your store.
• Schedule recurring purchases so items are added when you need them.
Save lists and recipes
• Keep reusable lists and recipes in separate sections. Add everything or only selected items to a store.
• Paste a recipe or choose an image of one to save its instructions and ingredients.
• Browse recipes and ready-made collections in the catalog. Add only what you need to your shopping list.
• Describe what you want to cook by voice or text. CartCircle suggests recipes based on your available time, number of servings, and food preferences.
Shop together
• Create a family group of up to six people and share stores. Everyone sees updates to shared lists.
• Get notifications about changes to family shopping lists. Your personal stores stay private.
Make the app yours
• Choose any personal or shared store as your start screen and open the right list as soon as the app launches.
• Choose which stores appear in your home-screen widget and set their order.
• Decide whether purchased items should remain in your lists for next time.

apple-macos:6762497168.name: Contextly Notes

Contextly turns what you capture into what you do—right on your Mac.

flathub:club.zbridge.zbridge.name: Zbridge
flathub:club.zbridge.zbridge.description:
Zbridge is a complete contract bridge platform for players of all skill levels. Learn, practice, and play contract bridge online or hone your skills with our advanced AI bridge bot and deal analysis tools.
 Key Features of Zbridge:
 Advanced Bot (Jethro): Play contract bridge with Jethro, a competitive bot built on 2/1 Game Forcing principles. Utilizing probability-based play algorithms based on known hand information, Jethro acts as a formidable opponent and reliable partner.
 Interactive Learning & Tutorials: Perfect for beginners and improvers. Learn how to play bridge step-by-step with interactive lessons and guided bidding hints.
 Bidding & Deal Analysis Room: Analyze custom or random deals with single and double dummy solver analysis. Practice 2/1 bidding, review possible trick counts for any contract, and view detailed bid explanations from the AI.
 Multiplayer Game Rooms: Join casual, social, or rated duplicate bridge tables. Track your performance with game records and player rating systems.
 Community & Social Features: Create bidding polls, publish bridge articles, participate in lobby chat, add friends, and send private messages.
 Ad-Free Experience: Zbridge is completely free to play with no adware.
 Whether you want to practice 2/1 bidding against AI, solve complex double dummy hands, or compete in online multiplayer duplicate games, Zbridge provides a complete suite for bridge enthusiasts on mobile and web platforms. Download Zbridge today to start playing and practicing.

flathub:pl.ksefinvoice.KsefInvoice.name: KsefInvoice
flathub:pl.ksefinvoice.KsefInvoice.description:
Note: This application is currently only available in Polish. 
 KsefInvoice to nowoczesne fakturowanie z pełną integracją KSeF — za darmo, bez reklam na zawsze!
 Jest to w pełni darmowa, bezpieczna aplikacja desktopowa do zarządzania fakturami, kontrahentami
 i wysyłką do Krajowego Systemu e-Faktur (KSeF). Bez abonamentu, bez reklam i ukrytych opłat. Twoje
 dane pozostają lokalnie na Twoim komputerze.
 Główne moduły i rozszerzone funkcje aplikacji:
 Integracja z KSeF i Monitoring: Pełna obsługa Krajowego Systemu e-Faktur. Wysyłaj
 faktury sprzedaży, monitoruj nowe dokumenty (badge z liczbą oczekujących faktur) i automatycznie
 pobieraj faktury zakupu z wyborem zakresu dat lub kontynuacją od ostatniej synchronizacji. Obsługa
 autoryzacji tokenem/podpisem, masowa wysyłka oraz pobieranie UPO.
 Łatwy start i migracja sprzedaży: Dla nowej firmy dostępny jest dedykowany import
 sprzedaży z KSeF (migracja historycznych dokumentów, także korekt). Rozwiązanie przyspiesza pierwsze
 uruchomienie aplikacji i pozwala szybko rozpocząć pracę bez ręcznego przepisywania danych.
 Stany Magazynowe: Zarządzaj kartoteką towarów i śledź ruchy magazynowe w czasie
 rzeczywistym. Stany aktualizują się automatycznie po zapisie faktury sprzedaży i zakupu. Rozróżnienie
 pozycji towar/usługa, historia ruchów, korekty stanów oraz opcjonalne zapisywanie nowych produktów
 w katalogu podczas wystawiania dokumentów.
 Aplikacja Podatnika (QR): Zgodne z wytycznymi MF generowanie wizualnych kodów QR
 dla weryfikacji dokumentów offline i podgląd struktury XML.
 Baza Kontrahentów: Zaawansowana integracja z GUS (BIR1): automatyczne pobieranie
 danych po NIP, mapowanie jednostek lokalnych (REGON14), wybór oddziału z listy oraz aktualizacja
 karty kontrahenta (nazwa, adres, kod, telefon/e-mail jeśli dostępne). Dodatkowo weryfikacja kontrahentów
 przez VIES (VAT EU) i Białą Listę Podatników VAT.
 Fakturowanie i Waluty: Kompletna obsługa dokumentów (Faktury VAT, Korekty, Marża,
 Ryczałt) w różnych walutach, wzbogacona o automatyczne dociąganie codziennych kursów z Tabeli
 A (NBP) i tłumaczenie faktur na j. angielski oraz niemiecki.
 JPK i Rejestry: Inteligentne generowanie plików, JPK_V7M, plików JPK_FA (wsparcie
 tagów dokumentów m.in. procedur GTU_12/13/odwrotnego obciążenia), oraz uwzględnianie przewalutowań
 w ewidencji VAT.
 Ryczałt i JPK_EWP: Obsługa ewidencji przychodów ryczałtowych oraz generowanie plików
 JPK_EWP zgodnie z obowiązującymi przepisami.
 Rozwiązania Księgowe (Kompensaty): Monitoruj należności i zobowiązania, zarządzaj
 terminami płatności i korzystaj ze zbiorczych wpłat (kompensat obustronnych na jednym kontrahencie).
 W module danych do przelewu możesz dodatkowo zweryfikować numer rachunku na Białej Liście VAT
 na podstawie NIP i numeru konta.
 Nowe funkcje ewidencyjne i podmiotowe: Lista dokumentów wykluczonych z ewidencji
 z raportowaniem, obsługa Podmiotu 3 oraz wsparcie ról JST i GV (Grupa VAT).
 Numeracja sprzedaży: Możliwość ustawienia własnego pierwszego numeru faktury (numer
 startowy) dla nowego okresu numeracyjnego, oraz możliwość zmian numeracji w trakcie okresu.
 Obsługa wielu Podmiotów: Zarządzaj wieloma firmami z poziomu jednej aplikacji. Każda

flathub:tf.harmony.UnCSO2.name: UnCSO2
flathub:tf.harmony.UnCSO2.summary: Extract Counter-Strike: Online 2 and Titanfall Online game files
flathub:tf.harmony.UnCSO2.description:
A file data extractor for the video games Counter Strike: Online 2 and Titanfall Online.
 Aside from extracting files from Counter-Strike: Online 2's and Titanfall Online's proprietary archive format, PKG, UnCSO2 can:
 Explore and extract from individual PKG archives
 Explore and extract from entire game's filesystem (loads every PKG archive in their PKG index)
 Preview and/or extract individual file entries
 Decrypt Counter-Strike: Online 2 files with an .e* prepended in their extension
 Decompress Counter-Strike: Online 2 texture files
 UnCSO2 supports every Counter-Strike: Online 2 region's game data. Those regions are: South Korea, China, Taiwan and Japan.

fedora-packages:festival-freebsoft-utils.description: A collection of utilities that enhance Festival with some useful features. They provide all that is needed for interaction with Speech Dispatcher. Key festival-freebsoft-utils features are: • Generalized concept of input events. festival-freebsoft-utils allows not only plain text synthesis, but also combining it with sounds. Additionally, mechanism of logical events mapped to other events is provided. • Substitution of events for given words. • High-level voice selection mechanism and setting of basic prosodic parameters. • Spelling mode. • Capital letter signalization. • Punctuation modes, for explicit reading or not reading punctuation characters. • Incremental synthesis of texts and events. • Speech Dispatcher support. • Rudimentary SSML support. • Enhance the Festival extension language with functions commonly used in Lisp. • Support for wrapping already defined Festival functions by your own code. • Everything is written in the extension language, no patching of the Festival C++ sources is needed.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension for xwiki application-specific macros. Both block and inline macros are supported.

firefox-addons:2745700.name: SafeToOpen Browser Security and Privacy
firefox-addons:2745700.summary: Stop phishing attacks before they reach you.
firefox-addons:2745700.description:
SafeToOpen is a real-time browser security and privacy extension that protects you from phishing websites, online scams, malicious downloads, and hidden trackers — automatically, as you browse. No security expertise required. Install it once and stay protected on every site you visit.
Most antivirus software reacts after a threat is already on your device. SafeToOpen works earlier: it analyzes the page you're actually looking at, in real time, and warns you the moment something looks like a phishing or scam site — even if that site is brand new and not yet on any blocklist.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT SAFETOOPEN PROTECTS YOU FROM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✓ Phishing & fake login pages
Detects sites built to steal your passwords, banking details, and personal
information — including newly created phishing pages that traditional
blocklists miss.
✓ Online scams & fraudulent websites
Flags deceptive and impersonation sites before you hand over money or data.
✓ Malicious downloads
Warns you before you download dangerous files (like disguised .exe
installers) that could carry malware or ransomware.
✓ Hidden trackers
Blocks third-party trackers that follow you across the web, so you browse
faster and more privately.
✓ Accidental data leaks
Paste Guard helps stop sensitive information (passwords, card numbers,
personal data) from being pasted into untrustworthy pages.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
HOW IT WORKS — TWO LAYERS OF PROTECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SafeToOpen doesn't just check a website against a list of known bad URLs. It
inspects every page on two levels at once — which is how it catches the newest
scams that blocklists haven't seen yet.
❶ Visual element analysis
SafeToOpen looks at a page the way you do. It examines the visual elements
— logos, branding, layout, and login forms — to recognize when a site is
impersonating a bank, brand, or service you trust. If a page is dressed up
to look like something it isn't, you're warned BEFORE you enter your
password, card number, or any sensitive information.

firefox-addons:3103244.name: Merge Request Security Widget for GitLab
firefox-addons:3103244.summary: Renders the security report artifacts your merge request pipeline already produces as a summary on the merge request page.
firefox-addons:3103244.description:
A browser extension that summarizes the security report artifacts your merge request pipeline already produces, on instances where those reports are otherwise reachable only as raw JSON downloads.

It then reads the target branch's own reports the same way, so the findings this merge request introduces are told apart from the ones the branch already had.

firefox-addons:2630135.name: S3.Translator
firefox-addons:2630135.summary: S3.Translator adds the power of Google Translate’s automatic translations to your browser! It supports translation of selected text, entered phrase or whole webpage between any of 100+ languages. New Feature: Language learning!
firefox-addons:2630135.description:
S3.Translator - this extension for Firefox browser make much easy visit of websites on foreign language: translation of selected text, introduced by a phrase or a fully web-site from any language to any language.
The extension uses the Google translation public API https://translate.google.com/ and therefore it have more than 100 languages which you can use for quick translation.
Also, the extension able to auto-detect the language of the original text.
There are a lot of simple and complex extensions for Firefox browser but they all have same problem: when translating, the format of selected text is lost, while S3.Translator retains the HTML formatting of web pages.
I hope that this extension will be very useful for you.
---------------------------------------------------------------------
Limitations:
--------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 Not processed some sites from mozilla.org and google.com 
 Not processed on sites that do not have pages, for example error 404 (page not found)
 Not processed on internal Firefox and GoogleChrome pages, for example about:addons , about:config , chrome://extensions/ , chrome://settings/ , etc.
 Not processed on the extensions pages "moz-extension://...." , "chrome-extension://...."
---------------------------------------------------------------------
About Permissions:
--------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 > Access your data for all websites
> Access browser tabs
> Access browser activity during navigation
for translations web-sites, for translation selected text, for showing fly-translate-window
 > Get data from the clipboard
for translate text from clipboard
 > Input data to the clipboard
for copy text
 > Display notifications to you
for notify after copy text
 > Store unlimited amount of client-side data
for store a extension settings
 > Download files and read and modify the browser’s download history
for backup (save and load) your preferences
---------------------------------------------------------------------
New Features:
--------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 Language learning! 
Now you can not only translate, but also learn the selected language! How do I use the Learning Language mode? http://forums.mozillazine.org/viewtopic.php?p=13761749#p13761749 
 Automatic translation of subtitles on YouTube! 
For enable/disable: Open settings - tab Translate - YouTube Subtitles
 Text-to-Speech! 
Options: Actions: "Selected text" and "Single word"
---------------------------------------------------------------------
Hint!
--------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 Press "Ctrl" + "Translate full page" - for translate full page via Google Web site
 Automatic translation algorithm when source and target languages are the same (en->en, fr->fr, ru->ru, etc.)
 launch a translation.
 if both languages (source and target) are the same, the add-on checks the target one and if it is not the default translation language, it then translates to it.
 if it is the default translation language, the add-on checks that "Language Learning" is enabled, if it is and the source language is the same as the studied one (in the settings: "replace phrase in this language"), it then translates to the studied language.
 if it doesn't match neither point 2 nor point 3, then it is left as is: en->en, fr->fr, ru->ru, etc.

And to top it all off, Avast SafePrice is completely free and unobtrusive, vanishing out of sight when you’re not shopping to cut down on the clutter in your browser. So download Avast SafePrice today, and start shopping smarter, saving money, and making the most of your time online.
 Personal Data We Process 
While using SafePrice, we process the following Service and Device Data: 
 Service data 
Domain name and host Service Provision (36 months) - To identify shopping sites upfront
URL and referrers Service Provision (36 months) - To display discount coupons and price comparison offers relevant to the website that you are visiting
Search query Service Provision (36 months) - If submitted you, to search for relevant products and discount coupons

 New Product Development (36 months) - To develop new products based on the user’s feedback
 Device Data

 New Product Development (36 months) - To measure product telemetry and calculate aggregated statistics
Information on computer or device (browser) New Product Development (36 months) - To obtain usage statistics
Extension information (installation source and time, version and campaign ID) Service Provision (36 months) - To make sure our offers are relevant and product features function as expected
 New Product Development (36 months) - To obtain usage statistics, evaluate our marketing campaigns and perform feature A/B testing
Country Service Provision (36 months) - To make sure our offers are relevant, and collect statistics on SafePrice usage by country

firefox-addons:586652.name: Rename Tab Title
firefox-addons:586652.summary:
Renames the Tab Title (Persistent across the sessions).
Renaming to add custom words in tab titles makes it easy to search for tabs in the address bar.
firefox-addons:586652.description:
Renames the Tab Title (Firefox 52+)
Click the icon on the ToolBar (or) use the shortcut Cmd/Ctrl + Shift+ E (instructions to customize are mentioned at bottom)
You'll get a popup, enter the new title
a)Click on Save (or) Press Enter to Save or Esc to close the popup without saving title
(closing the Popup without saving makes the title non persistent)
---
b) Click on "Edit All" in the popup to manage saved titles or use regex feature
In Urls section, select the URL from dropdown located at the bottom of the page
Edit the Title in textbox
Click on save (or) Press Enter to save the title.
Click on delete to delete the title.
In Regex section, add/update regex and the corresponding title and press "Save"
eg: /.*google.*/ matches all the websites which has the term google in the url,
 /*/ matches all websites
*some websites keeps updating the title on some events (eg: gmail.com updates title whenever hangouts gets initialized and whenever someone pings) this addon doesn't work in such cases as i didn't add the polling. If have any workaround for this please do mention in the comments.. thanks
If you have any suggestion for shortcut.
Please mention it in the comments and the reason why it is better.
customizing shortcut 
- for version 68+
1. Go to about:addons
2. Click on setting's icon -> Manage extension shortcuts. Scroll to Rename Tab Title and customize
For Chrome : https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/rename-tab-title/kppndhfiaenbiioipolacicknfmdcdep?hl=en-GB

bluejetty:00142620:ios.description:
EZVIZ – Security Video For Smart Life
The EZVIZ app is designed to work with our series of Security Cameras and other Smart Home products. By using this app, it is so easy to manage your camera and other smart home devices remotely from across the globe any time. 
You can get full access and remote control of all devices functions at fingertips, and take necessary actions to ensure the safety of your homes, businesses and loved ones when receiving immediate motion detection alerts on your phone.
Key features:
- View high-definition live stream from anywhere
- See in the dark with IR light on
- Playback recorded videos with CloudPlay or an SD card
- Talk via Two-Way Audio
- Get instant alerts when motion is detected
- Customize detection zones and sensitivity
- Set schedules to record the moments that matter
- Share devices with friends and family
Permission Settings Description
The EZVIZ APP requires the following permissions. All requested permissions are “optional”. You can still use the service normally even if you decline.
- Nearby Devices
1. Scan and discover nearby Bluetooth devices for pairing when adding a device.
- Microphone
1. Enable real-time voice calls with devices
2. Use voice-changing and pet voice-changing features
3. Record custom voice clips as the device alert tone
4. Use speech-to-text for quick input
- Photos & Videos
1. Select QR code images from the album for recognition when adding devices
2. Save screenshots and video recordings of device live feeds locally
3. Upload a personal avatar for account display
4. Submit feedback and report issues with screenshots
- Notifications
1. Receive device alarms, motion detection alerts, and other message reminders
- Contacts
1. Add emergency contacts for the one-tap alarm feature
- Location
1. Obtain the current Wi-Fi name (SSID) to assist with device network setup
2. Automatically locate your city on the city selection page
* The location data is used locally on your device only and is never uploaded to the cloud.
- Camera
1. Scan QR codes to add devices
2. Take photos and upload them as personal avatars
Contact Us
Technical Support: support@ezvizlife.com
General Enquiries: info@ezvizlife.com

bluejetty:00146447:ios.description:
Who's calling? Find out in seconds.
MenoDg is a phone number directory and spam shield built for Kuwait and the Arab region. Search any number to see who it belongs to, read what the community says about it, and block the ones you never want to hear from again.
SEARCH ANY NUMBER
• Look up a number and see the names and details registered for it
• See whether a number belongs to a business, a verified profile or a known nuisance
• Search a directory of over one million numbers
• Read community comments and ratings before you pick up or call back
STOP SPAM CALLS AND MESSAGES
• Block unwanted numbers so they can't ring your iPhone
• Filter junk and promotional SMS by sender number or by a word in the message
• AI-assisted filtering helps catch scam and spam messages
• Setup takes a minute, and the app walks you through turning it on in iPhone Settings
YOUR PROFILE, YOUR CHOICE
• Only you can see what other people have saved your number as
• Choose whether your number or your name can be searched
• Get notified when someone searches for your number
• Request deletion of your profile whenever you like
FOR BUSINESSES
• Browse the business directory
• Register your business so customers can find and reach you easily
HELP PROTECT YOUR COMMUNITY
Report nuisance numbers, comments and businesses. Reports go to our review team and are never shown to other users.
PRIVACY FIRST
The iPhone app does not access your contacts. You can manage or delete your profile from Settings at any time.
LANGUAGES
Arabic, English, French, Spanish and Turkish.
FREE TO START, PREMIUM IF YOU WANT MORE
Searching is free, and signing in gives you more searches. MenoDg Premium removes the limits: unlimited searches, more accurate results and no ads.

The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://menodg.com/en/privacy

bluejetty:00088323:ios.description:
At this Christmas Santa on his cart with 4 reindeer is on a mission to deliver gifts door to door. Help Santa to deliver gifts everywhere and wish them merry Christmas and a happy new year. 
Some days ago, Grinch with his some wicked friends made a plan to ruin this Christmas. The only way he though was to stop Santa from delivering gifts. So, Grinch and his wicked friends attacked on Santa's reindeer and tried to kidnap them. However, Santa got to the reindeer in time and saved them from those bad guys. But reindeer got injured in fight with Grinch and other bad guys. Santa was worried because Christmas was near and without his reindeer he was not able to deliver gifts to everyone. He and his reindeer were very stressed and meanwhile a group of reindeer from South Pole came to him. They offered to help him in gift delivery mission. Those reindeer could not fly but they could run very fast and know a track which leads to people’s home in town. They told Santa Claus about the track which is known as ‘infinite track’.On this track if someone forgets the right directions then he can be lost there forever and eventually fell into a hole between sky and earth. The danger of infinite track did not has any effect on the Santa Claus. Because at that time, he just had one thing in mind and that was on time delivery of gifts to the kids waiting on the doors of their homes. So, Santa set out on mission to conquer the infinite tracks and deliver presents to everyone.
Let’s help Santa clause to pass through infinite track with full zeal and zest singing wish you a merry Christmas and happy New Year. Help him to please little angels waiting anxiously for his arrival. You can do all this by playing Santa Christmas infinite track.
Santa Christmas infinite track is a game full of challenges and infinite tracks. It’s a free game for everyone. It is full of joy and happiness which comes on face of people receiving gift at Christmas. 
Some main features of ‘Santa Christmas infinite track’ are:
• Challenging and infinite track to test your skills
• Amazing music and sound effects
• Gift delivery door to door
• Smooth and adaptive controls
• Magnificent Santa's cart with 4 reindeer
So, what are waiting for! Download ‘Santa Christmas Infinite Track’ now and start spreading happiness and joy everywhere.

Here, you need to connect gems with the same symbol and merge them to unearth rich rewards. This is a creative and challenging casual game that lets you enjoy endless fun while relaxing!
How to Play?
 Eight-Way Connection:
 Slide gems with the same symbol in any of the eight directions (up, down, left, right, or diagonally) to merge them.
Merge and Upgrade:
 Merge the same gems to upgrade them into a larger gem, earning higher scores.
Simple Swiping:
 Just swipe the screen to easily merge gems and enjoy a carefree gaming experience.
Unlimited Time:
 No time limits, allowing you to enjoy the game freely whenever you want.
Why Play [Connect Gems All]?
 Endless Challenges and Fun:
 Free Play: Unlimited gameplay allows you to immerse yourself and enjoy the game at your own pace.
 Mind Training: Train your brain while enjoying the game, enhancing your logical thinking and strategic abilities.

Game Features
Easy and Stress-Free:
 Simple and Intuitive: Easy-to-use controls make the game suitable for players of all ages, allowing you to master the game's essence effortlessly.
 Mental Agility: Classic merge and number games help keep your mind sharp and train your logical skills.
 Challenge High Scores:
 Constant Breakthroughs: Challenge your highest score and motivate yourself to keep improving, becoming a true gem master.
 Rewarding Mechanism: Earn more points by merging gems, enjoying the thrill of high score challenges.
 Rich and Colorful Interface:
 Gorgeous Interface: Exquisite interface design offers an excellent visual experience.
 Unique Style: Distinctive art style makes your gaming journey fresh and delightful.
Come and experience [Connect Gems All], become the master of gem games, and enjoy endless merging fun and stunning visuals!

bluejetty:00018204:ios.description:
Access the tools you need and all the best extras. Stay in control of your loan and keep tabs on your progress.
An active OneMain account is required to use this app. To apply for a new personal loan, visit OMF.com.
APP FEATURES
- Make loan payments on the go.
- Turn on AutoPay to schedule automatic payments.
- Sign up for paperless statements and payment alerts.
- Monitor your VantageScore (R) (updated monthly).
- Access OneMain (R) MyMoney to track your spending and even save some cash.
- View your loan details and OneMain BrightWay (R) credit card activity (if applicable).
Note: Deleting this app does not close or delete a OneMain or BrightWay account. As a regulated lender and financial institution, we must retain certain records under applicable law.
ABOUT ONEMAIN FINANCIAL
We provide personal loans that can help you get the money you need, for purposes such as:
- Debt consolidation
- Home improvement
- Auto purchase or repair
- Vacations
- Emergencies
- Major purchases
Our personal loan repayment periods range from 24 to 60 months with a maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR) of 35.99%. Loan amounts range from $1,500 to $30,000.
Not all applicants qualify for larger loan amounts or most favorable loan terms. Larger loan amounts require a first lien on a motor vehicle no more than 10 years old that meets our value requirements, titled in your name with valid insurance. Loan approval and actual loan terms depend on your state of residence and your ability to meet our credit standards (including a responsible credit history, sufficient income after monthly expenses and availability of collateral). APRs are generally higher on loans not secured by a vehicle. Highly qualified applicants may be offered higher loan amounts and/or lower APRs. Loan proceeds cannot be used for postsecondary educational expenses, for any business or commercial purpose, to buy cryptocurrency or other speculative investments, or for gambling or illegal purposes. Active-duty military, their spouse or dependents covered by the Military Lending Act may not pledge a vehicle as collateral.
Borrowers in these states are subject to these minimum loan sizes: Alabama: $2,100. California: $3,000. Georgia: $3,100. North Dakota: $2,000. Ohio: $2,000. Virginia: $2,600.
Borrowers in these states are subject to these maximum loan sizes: North Carolina: $11,000 for unsecured loans to all customers; $11,000 for secured loans to present customers. Maine: $7,000. Mississippi: $12,000. West Virginia: $13,500. Loans to purchase a motor vehicle or powersports equipment from select ME, MS, and NC dealerships are not subject to these maximum loan sizes.
We charge loan origination fees. Depending on the state where you open the loan, the fee may be a flat amount or percentage of the loan amount. Flat fee amounts vary by state, ranging from $25–$500. Percentage-based fees vary by state, ranging from 1%–10% of the loan, subject to certain state limits on the fee amount.
Example Loan: A $6,000 loan with a 24.99% APR repayable in 60 monthly installments would have monthly payments of $176.07.
When refinancing or consolidating existing debts, total finance charges over the life of the new loan may be higher than your current debt because the interest rate may be higher and/or the loan term may be longer. Our loans include origination fees, which may reduce the amount of money available to pay off other debts.

PA: Licensed by Pennsylvania Department of Banking and Securities. VA: Licensed by Virginia State Corporation Commission – License Number CFI-156. OneMain Mortgage Services, Inc. (NMLS# 931153). NY: Registered New York Mortgage Loan Servicer. See more licensing information at nmlsconsumeraccess.org and onemainfinancial.com/legal/disclosures.

PV protects your private photos and videos by passcode protect, fingerprint touch ID and data encryption. It's easy to use and safe for storing your private photos, and it provides cloud storage service in-app.
==========================
Basic Features
- Hide private photos and videos into app with encrypted data transfer
- Free unlimited storage
- Automatically delete photos from public library after hiding private photos
- Password and Face ID protection
- Fake password protection
- Slideshow
- Set customized album cover
- Trash folder to store deleted photos temporarily
- All-in-one photo editor
- Customize the app icon
- Nearby Drop: transfer photos between the phones
- Tags, notes and search
- Emergency Switch: jump to other apps when the phone is facing down.
- Support audio files.
==========================
Advanced Features:
- Ad Free: Get rid of all ads!
- Cloud Sync: privilege of Super members.
- Third party cloud backup (privilege of Pro members).
- Wi-Fi Transfer: Make your app device and PC connected in the same network, and batch transfer your photos and videos.
==========================
Contact Us
• Email: photovault.info@gmail.com , we are glad to hear from you!
==========================
FAQ
Please read below FAQ document if you need help, it summarizes the most popular questions from customers:
https://www.photovault.cn/pv/faq_en.html
==========================
Notice Must-Read!!!
Q: What if you forgot your passcode?
A: Please go to App Setting > Set Recovery Email to set an email address, this email will be used when you forget password next time.
Q: I deleted the app/lost my phone/restored factory defaults, can I get back my photos?
A: All the photos/videos stored in this app are stored in your local device′s storage. If you delete this app, iOS will delete all the data inside this app. It means if you never backup the data in the app, the photos/videos will be gone. 
==========================
PV Super Membership Subscription
- With a PV Super Membership subscription, you have access to all features and paid cloud backup(PV provides the interface to transfer data between this app and third-party public cloud apps such as Dropbox, Google Drive, Box, One Drive), Wi-Fi transfer, Fake Password, etc. Advertisements will be removed automatically. 
- PV Pro Unlimited subscription is billed monthly or annually at the rate corresponding to the selected plan. In addition, a one-time payment will be offered if needed, which is not one of the subscription plan. 
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. 
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. To cancel your subscription, you can go to your iPhone/iPad/iPod's Settings> [your name] > iTunes & App Store, tap your Apple ID, tap View Apple ID, tap Subscriptions, click on 'Cancel Subsciption' for the app. 
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00064294:ios.description:
Listen to All the Audio You Love, All in One Place
Access over 100,000 live AM/FM radio stations from around the world, plus exclusive content from news, sports, music, podcasts, and audiobooks—all across your devices. Enjoy a broader range of audio than Pandora or iHeartRadio, all in one place.
Your Personalized Soundtrack
Tune in to your favorite live stations or explore 100,000+ AM/FM stations from 197+ countries. Whether you’re in the mood for Today’s Hits, Classic Rock, Smooth Jazz, or something else, TuneIn has you covered—offering more variety and control than platforms like Pandora or iHeartRadio. Discover legendary stations like 106.7 Lite FM, Power 105.1, 102.7 KIIS-FM, and more.
Apple Music Radio now on TuneIn
Apple Music Radio has landed. Stream Apple Music 1, Chill, Country, Club & Hits live on TuneIn. Catch your favorite artists like Billie Eilish, Ed Sheeran, The Weeknd, Frank Ocean and more.
Stay Informed with Trusted News
Get the latest headlines and live updates from top news sources like CNN, FOX News Radio, MS NOW, Bloomberg Radio, CNBC, NPR, and BBC. Access 24/7 news, including local, national, and global coverage. Stream news stations such as WNYC-FM, KQED-FM, and WTOP Washington DC, or stay informed with top podcasts like The Daily and Up First.
All Your Favorite Sports
From MLB and NFL to NHL and college sports, catch every game and never miss a play. With TuneIn, follow your team all season long with curated content and game-time notifications. Stream sports talk stations like ESPN Radio, talkSPORT, Fox Sports Radio, and local shows. Plus, enjoy on-demand sports podcasts like Undisputed, First Take, and The Bill Simmons Podcast.
Podcasts for Every Passion
Explore the world’s most popular podcasts, including Stuff You Should Know, Hidden Brain, Wow in the World, and more. Whether commuting, working out, or unwinding, TuneIn offers top global podcasts that you can stream on-demand.
Stream Everywhere, Anytime
Take TuneIn with you wherever you go. Listen on iOS, tablets, or connected devices. Control your audio experience with Amazon Alexa, Google Home, or in your car with CarPlay and compatible vehicles like Tesla, Mercedes, and Volvo.
Unlock Even More with TuneIn Premium
Upgrade to TuneIn Premium for ad-free content, exclusive features, and more:
Live Sports: Commercial-free coverage of NHL games, college sports, racing, and more—without blackouts.
Ad-Free News: Enjoy uninterrupted news coverage from CNBC, CNN, FOX News Radio, and more.
Unlimited Audiobooks: Access over 100,000 audiobooks with no extra cost or limitations.
Commercial-Free Music: Stream your favorite music stations non-stop with no ads.
Fewer Ads Across All Stations: Enjoy listening to 100,000+ stations with fewer interruptions than Pandora or iHeartRadio.
Subscribe to TuneIn Premium through the free app. If you choose to subscribe, you will be charged a monthly or annual subscription fee according to your country. The subscription fee will be shown in the app before you complete the payment. Your subscription will automatically renew every month or year at the then-current subscription fee unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the then-current subscription period. Your iTunes account will automatically be charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the then-current period. The subscription fee will be charged monthly or annually according to your subscription. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings.

***
IZI. Бәрі оп-оңай. 
IZI нөмірін қосып ал да, бір-ақ қосымшаны пайдаланып көңіл-күйіңді көтер: кино көр, музыка тыңда және ойын ойна. Кино көріп, музыка тыңдап, ойын ойнағаның үшін саған бонустар түседі. Жиналып қалған бонустарды гигабайттар мен минуттарға айырбастауға болады
ТЕГІН 30 ГБ 7 КҮНГЕ

КЕҢСЕСІЗ, ҚАҒАЗСЫЗ ИЗИ ФОРМАТ
Бәрі оңай, тез болса екен дейсің бе? IZI-де бәрі онлайн және барынша ыңғайлы жасалған:
— eSIM шамамен 15 минутта қосылады
— Өзге оператор нөмірі IZI желісіне оңай көшіріледі
— SIM-карта есікке дейін жеткізіледі
— Тәулік бойы жұмыс істейтін қолдау чаты бар
— Теңгеріміңді білдіртпей азайтатын жасырын жазылымдар жоқ
САЯХАТҚА АРНАЛҒАН БАЙЛАНЫС
Travel eSIM-ді ұшпай тұрып қосып ал. Басқа саяхатшылар Wi-Fi іздеп, жергілікті SIM-картаны қайдан алам деп уайымдап жүргенде, сен такси шақыртып, баратын жерлеріңді картадан қарап, саяхатта жасаған алғашқы суреттеріңді үйдегілерге жіберіп жататын боласың
ҮЛКЕН СПОРТ IZI-ДЕ
Ойындарға қысқы да нұсқа шолу, үздік сәттер және басқа да футбол контентін IZI қосымшасынан тамашалай аласың
ОНЛАЙН КИНОТЕАТР
Сүйікті фильміңді, сериалыңды немесе қызықты мини-дорамаңды кез келген жерде IZI қосымшасынан қос. Кейде көңіл-күйді сергітіп алу үшін бір серия көргеннің өзі-ақ жетер
ӘЙГІЛІ МОБИЛЬДІ ОЙЫНДАР
Ойын ойнаған уақытты босқа кетіреді ме? IZI-де ойын ойнаған пайда әкеледі! 2048, Cut the Rope және басқа да үздік ойындарды ойнап, рекордтарыңды жаңарт. Ал ойнап жатқаныңда, бонусың да жинала береді
ВАЙБЫҢА ЛАЙЫҚ МУЗЫКА
Дүниежүзін жаулаған хиттер мен қазақстандық танымал орындаушылардың тректерін тыңда. Ұнаған тректерден өз плейлисіңді құр немесе талғамыңа қарай жасалған миксті тыңда. Ал егер ештеңе іздегің келмесе, қосымшада ондаған радиостанция бар
БОНУСТАР — IZI-ДІҢ ВАЛЮТАСЫ
IZI қосымшасында уақытты белсенді өткізген сайын, бонустар жиналады. Бонустарды мобильді байланыс қызметтеріне немесе серіктестеріміз ұсынған жеңілдіктерге оп-оңай айырбастауға болады. Қосымша экранынан бас алмай отырған уақытыңды нақты пайдаға айналдырамыз

Tired of juggling multiple remotes? Lost your Smart TV remote again? Upgrade your streaming experience with Smart TV, the most intuitive and feature-rich Smart TV remote app for your iPhone or iPad. Smart TV is the all-in-one solution for controlling your entire smart TV ecosystem — whether it's a standard Smart TV, Your TV, or any other connected device.
Its sleek, user-friendly interface puts all your favorite features at your fingertips, making navigation a breeze whether you're streaming on Your TV, adjusting settings, or browsing apps. Whether you're using it as a Smart TV remote control, a TV channel manager, or a smart remote for screen mirroring — this app has you covered.
Key Features
- Universal Smart TV Remote: Control virtually any Smart TV from your iPhone or iPad. This remote app works with a wide range of Smart TV models.
- Quick Search: Find your favorite shows and movies faster with integrated voice search and virtual keyboard. Simply speak or type your query to search across your TV channels.
- Smart TV Screen Mirroring: Stream photos, videos, and music from your phone or tablet directly to Your TV. Enjoy your content on the big screen with seamless screen mirroring.
- Smart TV Channel Manager: Easily manage channels. Add new ones, switch between them, and launch favorites like Netflix, Hulu, or HBO Max with a single tap.
- Automatic Device Detection: Smart TV remote app auto-detects compatible devices on your WiFi network, making setup simple and fast.
Advanced Remote Control Features
- Intuitive Touchpad and Keyboard: Navigate your Smart TV effortlessly with a responsive touchpad and easy-to-use keyboard.
- Favorite Channels: Save your most-watched TV channels for quick access.
- Voice Search: Use voice commands to search across all available content and channels.
- Convenient Widget: Access essential controls directly from your home screen with the included widget.
Works with All TVs: This remote app is compatible with most Smart TV brands, making it a truly universal solution.
This Smart TV remote app is designed to work seamlessly with a wide range of television models and streaming devices, offering a universal solution for all your remote control needs — all without the clutter of multiple remotes.

It is a must-have app for organizations who need to regularly update their team with new product features, success stories, sales pitches, sales collateral, marketing offers, sales initiatives, etc.
Mindtickle enables sales enablement managers, sales managers, and trainers to share track-able files like videos, slides, documents, audio files, etc., packaged in the form of lightweight and mobile-friendly 'Quick Updates.'
As a team member, you can easily view these Quick Updates on MindTickle mobile app.
*MindTickle learner account is required for this app.
Key features:
• View all Quick Updates on mobile.
• Get notified when a new Quick Update is published.
• Sign in/Sign up using Salesforce/ Google/ your organization's SSO or simply use your business email id.
• Earn points for viewing content, and grow your knowledge score.
• Save content files for offline viewing.
• Securely view and store all content files.
• Bookmark important content files.
• Easily search Quick Updates and content files.

bluejetty:00187147:ios.description:
Banking services for anytime and everywhere!
TebMobile is an electronic service, through which, clients have access to their accounts and other bank products, at any time and everywhere. TebMobile is user friendly, secure and an effective service which is offered to all clients. It is available for non-customer as well, offering different features. 
The chance of staying competitive in the market will be even higher through TebMobile services since the cross selling of different products such as accounts, loans, credit cards, payments, standing orders will increase. 
TebMobile will be available in two languages: English & Albanian
TEB Customers have these features available in TebMobile:
 Dashboard
 • View total assets
 • View total debts
 • View future debts in calendar
 • Define standing order in calendar
 • View account in diagram
 • View credit card in diagram
 • View loan in diagram
 Accounts
 • View account transactions
 • View account balances
 • View account details
 • IBAN extract 
 Credit Cards
 • View credit card transactions
 • View credit card debt
 • View credit card details
 • Apply for new credit card
 • Apply for supplementary card
 • Apply for credit card limit increase
 • Change payment date for credit card
 • Change payment method for credit card
 • View credit card statement
 • Pay credit card debt/another person
 • Invoice payment with credit card
 Loans
 • View loan payment plan/details
 • Send loan payment plan via email
 • Apply for loan
 Payments
 • Invoice payment with barcode reader
 • Make institution payments from account or credit card
 • Make payment for pre-paid services (IPKO)
 • Make mobile top-up refill (IPKO, VALA, ZMOBILE)
 Transfers
 • Quick transfers
 • Transfer between my accounts
 • Transfers to TEB accounts
 • Transfers to other banks
 Investments
 • View rates
 • Foreign exchange (buying/selling)
 Non - Customers have these features available in Teb Mobile:
 • View Branch/ATM locator
 • View Campaigns
 • Calculator for different currency (GBP, CHF, USD), deposit, loan
 • View News & Events
 • Apply for Loan
 • Apply for Credit Card
 • Contact Us
 • New User Application
Security 
TebMobile uses SmartKEY for authetication. This technology uses multi-factor mechanism with the latest cryptographic methods to protect your transactions for a higher security. It provides a strong and transparent technology with a simple user experience to the users for mobile application and e-banking authentication. Also, TebMobile combines this technology with Touch ID to provide seamless user experience with finger print.

bluejetty:00023527:ios.description:
This GPS Navigation and Route finder app provide a bunch of functionalities including finding exact route, Direction, Navigation, Nearby Places and many more with Voice functionality.
This app will help you to find exact direction, find rout, and show exact timing to reach towards your destination. This app is multi-function app, which can easily show you all the related things including nearby places, real time navigation with voice input and many more. Now you can get exact direction turn by turn with best possible rout through this Map navigator with voice support. 
If you are driving somewhere, and you don’t know exact location you just have to enter your destination and pick your current location from the app, the app will draw the best possible route and will show you’re the time you need to reach your destination with voice. 
If you are somewhere and want to know you nearest place like, petrol pumps, cash and carry, malls, coffee shops etc, you just have to check nearby places in your app and it will show you all nearby places in you app. 
The app will save your search history, if you need to find which places you have visited, or you need to visit the same location again, you just need to check your history. 
How to use the app?
The app is simple, just open the app and wait to load the Navigator and app
The app will ask you to turn on your GPS if its not already on
On the index page it will show you the features like, navigation, route direction, nearby places etc
For finding a route you just need to press on the navigation and map, input your destination , the app will draw and plan you best route with estimated time

bluejetty:00150558:ios.description:
Send, receive, and store all your digital assets in one easy-to-use Web3 wallet. As a non custodial wallet, your crypto and private keys are entirely under your control. Omni features best-in-class encryption, biometric authentication, and a unique 12-word secret phrase for added security. 
The app is not just for storage, but it’s also your gateway to Web3. Explore dApps, DeFi protocols, and DAOs, and discover new projects from a single multichain wallet.
MULTI-CHAIN SUPPORT
Say goodbye to juggling a different wallet for each blockchain. Securely store 10,000 coins and tokens from an ever-growing list of supported Layer 1 and Layer 2 networks, including:
- Akash
- Arbitrum
- Avalanche C Chain
- Binance Smart Chain
- Celo
- Cosmos
- Ethereum
- Fantom
- Gnosis Chain (xDai)
- Harmony
- Juno
- Kava
- Moonriver
- Near
- OKX Chain
- Optimism
- Osmosis
- Persistence
- Polkadot
- Polygon
- Solana
- Stargaze
- Sushi
- Tezos
- The Graph
ZERO HIDDEN FEES
Move coins, tokens, and NFTs easily to external Web3 wallets with no extra fees (network fees still apply).
SWAP, BRIDGE, GO
Swap tokens natively and bridge across major EVM-compatible networks and leading Layer 2s.
3-TAP STAKING, YIELD VAULTS, AND LENDING
Put your idle coins and tokens to work and earn yields directly inside Omni. Stake, lend, or deposit your digital assets into yield vaults to collect high APR rewards. The streamlined flow helps you start earning in just three taps. Plus, you can withdraw your crypto any time, no questions asked.
STORE AND MANAGE NFTS
Manage your collection and even personalize your NFT wallet by setting your collectibles as your wallpaper and avatar. Omni is compatible with NFTs from Ethereum, Solana, and other blockchains.
IMPORT WEB3 WALLETS INTO OMNIi
No complex setup needed to import all of your existing crypto wallets and funds from MetaMask, Phantom, Rainbow, and other platforms.
HARDWARE CRYPTO WALLET COMPATIBILITY
Want to move your digital assets offline? Omni is the solution. Simply sync your Ledger with the Omni non custodial wallet and transfer your crypto to cold storage.
MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT
The Omni multichain wallet can be accessed in six different languages, with more coming: 
English
Chinese
Turkish
Spanish
Vietnamese
Korean
Thai
24/7 CUSTOMER SERVICE
For feedback or feature requests, email us at support@omni.app or on X/Twitter at @omnidotapp. Our (hu

A community-led free & open source maps app based on OpenStreetMap data and reinforced with commitment to transparency, privacy and being not-for-profit.
‣ Simple and Polished: essential easy to use features that just work.
‣ Offline-focused: Plan and navigate your trip abroad without the need for cellular service, search waypoints while on a distant hike, etc. All app functions are designed to work offline.

bluejetty:00041319:ios.description:
Omnipemf devices feature a multi-coil structure and intuitive gesture controls, making them some of the most user-friendly PEMF devices on the market. They help guide the body and mind toward a desired state by emitting scientifically supported frequencies through electromagnetic fields.
These frequencies provide rhythmic stimulation that the body and brain can naturally respond to. This may help promote relaxation, enhance focus, energize the body, support better sleep, deepen meditation, or contribute to overall physical wellbeing.
Through the thoughtful positioning of multiple coils inside the device, electromagnetic fields are distributed in a way that allows the surrounding space to be gently filled with targeted frequencies. This enables users to benefit from PEMF exposure in different everyday situations such as relaxing at home, working, meditating, or preparing for sleep.
The effectiveness of Omnipemf technology has been explored in independent double-blind, placebo-controlled studies and is supported by a growing body of scientific literature related to PEMF and frequency-based stimulation.

• Kredi kartı bilgilerinizi, ekstrelerinizi, dönem içi harcamalarınızı, provizyonda bekleyen işlemlerinizi, gelecek dönem taksitlerinizi gözlemleyebilir, kart borcunuzu ödeyebilir, nakit avans/taksitli nakit avans kullanabilir ve daha önce tek çekim olarak gerçekleştirdiğiniz harcamalarınızı sonradan taksitlendirebilir, kredi kartınıza bağlı olarak sanal kredi kartı oluşturabilirsiniz.

• Enpara dışına yabancı para transferi (SWIFT) yapabilirsiniz.

• Ücretsiz olarak cep telefonu numarasına para transferi yapabilirsiniz. 
• Enpara dışına yabancı para transferi (SWIFT) yapabilirsiniz. 
• Ücretsiz olarak anlaşmalı olduğumuz vakıf ve derneklere “Kalpten transfer” (bağış) yapabilirsiniz. 
• Fatura, başka banka kredi kartı, vergi, trafik cezası, SGK ve şans oyunu ödemelerinizi yapabilirsiniz. 
• Ücretsiz olarak cep telefonuna TL yükleme işlemi yapabilirsiniz. 
• En Hızlı ile daha önce kaydettiğiniz transfer ve ödeme işlemlerinizi çok hızlı bir şekilde gerçekleştirebilirsiniz. 
• Para transferi, fatura ödeme, cep telefonuna TL yükleme, Enpara.com kredi kartı, vergi, SGK ve İstanbulkart ödemeleriniz için düzenli veya tek seferlik talimat oluşturabilirsiniz. 
• 7/24 USD, EUR, Altın ve Gümüş alıp satabilirsiniz.
• BIST hisse senetlerini, TEFAS ve Enpara’ya özel yatırım fonlarını kolayca alıp satabileceksiniz.
• Kasko ve trafik sigortası yaptırabilir, mevcut poliçelerinizi görüntüleyebilir ve ihtiyaçlarınıza uygun sigorta tekliflerini inceleyebilirsiniz.
• Karekod ile kartınız yanınızda olmasa bile QNB ATM’lerini ücretsiz olarak kullanabilirsiniz.

bluejetty:00153986:ios.name: Zen Mahjong: Classic Tiles
bluejetty:00153986:ios.summary: Zen Mahjong, a unique puzzle game focused on tile matching, perfect for relaxation and brain exercise. Download & enter a world that combines classic gameplay with modern innovations. It features large, clear tiles and a smooth interface op
bluejetty:00153986:ios.description:
Zen Mahjong, a unique puzzle game focused on tile matching, perfect for relaxation and brain exercise. Download & enter a world that combines classic gameplay with modern innovations. It features large, clear tiles and a smooth interface optimized for both ipads and iphones. Designed specifically for older adults, it provides a relaxing and engaging gaming experience.
Zen Mahjong is a game that helps you relax and think. It is great for all ages, especially older adults who want fun and a mental workout. Whether you know mahjong well or are just starting, Zen Mahjong gives you many hours of fun and challenges.
At FLYYES, we have many games that help you relax, think quickly, and have fun. People of all ages can enjoy them. Our games includes,Daily Solitaire, Color Block Blast, all crafted to enhance well-being and provide joy through simple yet engaging gameplay.
How to play Zen Mahjong:
The gameplay is simple: clear all the tiles on the board by matching pairs of identical tiles. Simply tap or slide two matching tiles to remove them from the board. Only tiles that are not blocked by others can be matched. The game wins when all tiles are cleared. Can you complete each level?
Features of exclusive Zen Mahjong solitaire game:
- Classic Mahjong Solitaire: Enjoy the traditional solitaire mahjong experience with thousands of challenging levels.
- New Gameplay Elements: In addition to classic tiles, we’ve added special tiles that introduce fresh challenges to the game.
- Large, Readable Tiles: Designed with easy-to-read text and large visuals, making the game accessible and comfortable for players of all ages.
- Mind-Boosting Mode: A special feature to help sharpen memory and improve cognitive function with progressively challenging puzzles.
- No Timers, No Pressure: Enjoy a stress-free experience with no countdowns—just play at your own pace.
- Combo Rewards: Make consecutive tile matches to unlock exciting bonuses and special experiences.
- Helpful Props: Use free in-game props like hints, undo, and shuffle to overcome difficult puzzles.
- Daily Challenges: Complete Zen puzzles to collect trophies and boost your mahjong skills over time.
- Offline Play: Enjoy Zen Mahjong anytime, anywhere, without an internet connection.
Zen Mahjong is the perfect blend of relaxation and mental exercise, designed to provide hours of enjoyable and exciting gaming experience. Download Zen Mahjong today and start your tile-matching adventure!
Welcome to our Facebook Club: 
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zenmahjong
Stay updated on game news, connect with players worldwide, and share your passion for Zen Mahjong! 
Let Zen Mahjong bring fun and relaxation to your day!

bluejetty:00120947:ios.description:
Drag a shape in, fill a line, watch it go off in colour.
Color Cube is the block puzzle you already know how to play, rebuilt bright. Shapes arrive at the bottom, you slide them onto the grid, and every row or column you complete bursts and clears.
BRIGHT, NOT BROWN
Every piece is its own colour and the board is clean. No wood grain, no beige, no quiet little thud.
ONE RULE, NO TUTORIAL
Fill a line and it clears. That is the whole game.
CHAIN THEM TOGETHER
Set the board up so one piece clears a row and a column at once, then do it again. The scores that matter come from planning ahead, not from playing fast.
NO TIMER, EVER
Nothing counts down. Put the phone down mid game and come back to the same board.
PLAYS WITH NO SIGNAL
Works on the plane, on the underground, in the hills with one bar of nothing.
A board lasts as long as you keep it open. Fill a line and see.

*** 220,000+ businesses *** Trusted by professionals around the world ***
HeyDrop: The Ultimate Digital Business Card for your iPhone. Create, manage, and grow your network.
HeyDrop is the all-in-one business card app for modern professionals who want to go digital, share faster and build stronger business networking results. Create a digital business card, replace paper business cards and keep every company business card ready to share. With HeyDrop, your electronic business card or virtual business card are always available when new connections matter most.
SHARE IN SECONDS
Keep your digital business card in Apple Wallet and your wallet so your details are always ready at meetings, conferences, trade shows, expos and daily networking. Share with QR codes, AirDrop, links, NFC and messaging apps. HeyDrop app helps you exchange contacts instantly, so your business cards and company business cards can be shared without printing, reordering or manual updates. Use AI Contact Scanner to turn physical business cards and event badges into digital contacts in seconds. HeyDrop makes lead capture faster and simpler, helping teams and individuals collect more connections and reduce manual entry. This business card wallet helps you organize cards, grow contacts and improve business networking at every event. From one meeting to a full conference, HeyDrop app turns every company business card, badge and business card wallet workflow into a digital lead engine.
BUILT FOR INDIVIDUALS AND TEAMS
Create professional business cards with your logo, colors and brand style. Manage multiple cards for different roles, brands or businesses. HeyDrop supports business cards management with centralized control, consistent branding and flexible sharing. Whether you need one digital business card or many professional business cards, HeyDrop app makes every company business card easier to manage. Use your business card app for yourself or 
roll out branded business cards across your team.
SYNC, SAVE AND STAY ORGANIZED
Sync contacts with your iPhone contacts and CRM, export data and keep every electronic business card, virtual business card and digital business card working together in one simple workflow. HeyDrop helps turn new connections into organized contacts, faster follow-up and better business networking outcomes. Keep your cards in Apple Wallet, store your company business card in your wallet and use one business card wallet to support every contact and connection.
WHY HEYDROP?
- business card app built for Apple Wallet
- digital business card sharing in seconds
- electronic business card and virtual business card for every role
- AI scanning for business cards and event badges
- business cards management for teams
- business card wallet for modern networking
- professional business cards with branding
- smarter contacts, cards, wallet and connections.

bluejetty:00086144:ios.description:
Циан — ведущий сервис в России для поиска, аренды, покупки и продажи недвижимости.
Мечтаете купить квартиру в новостройке, снять уютный загородный дом на выходные или выгодно продать коммерческий объект? В приложении Циан собраны миллионы актуальных объявлений. Наша главная задача — сделать любую сделку с жильем простой, прозрачной и безопасной.
Все операции с недвижимостью в одном месте
• Покупка и продажа: огромный выбор объектов на первичном и вторичном рынках. Изучайте детальные планировки квартир от застройщиков или подбирайте готовые частные дома для всей семьи.
• Долгосрочная аренда: находите квартиры, комнаты, таунхаусы и коттеджи напрямую от проверенных собственников.
• Посуточный съем и отдых: планируйте отпуск или командировку. Бронируйте квартиры в центре города или арендуйте загородные виллы и дома посуточно для праздников и выходных.
• Коммерческий сектор: удобный поиск офисов, складов и торговых площадей для вашего бизнеса.
Почему пользователи выбирают Циан?
100% модерация данных: все объявления проходят строгую проверку, что гарантирует актуальность цен и защиту от фейков.
• Умный ИИ-помощник: поручите рутинный поиск искусственному интеллекту. Задайте критерии, и бот сам пришлет подходящие варианты, сэкономив ваше время.
• Глубокая аналитика: бесплатно оценивайте рыночную и кадастровую стоимость объектов, изучайте историю изменения цен и текущие арендные ставки.
• Точный поиск: используйте интерактивную карту и более 80 умных фильтров, чтобы учесть инфраструктуру района, этажность, отделку и срок сдачи ЖК.
Быстрая ипотека без лишних визитов
Заполните всего одну анкету прямо в приложении и отправьте её сразу в 7 ведущих банков. Получите персональные одобрения за 2 минуты, сравните условия с помощью встроенного ипотечного калькулятора и выберите самую выгодную ставку.
Скачивайте Циан — сервис, где легко найти свой идеальный дом!

bluejetty:00016700:ios.description:
Long ago, a great Dragonmaster named Dyne, with the aid of his faithful companions, defended the goddess Althena from a terrible evil. Time has passed, and those great adventurers have become the stuff of legend, but the world of Lunar is now threatened by a shadowy figure known as the Magic Emperor. In a humble village, far removed from the turmoil, lives a young man named Alex. Idolizing the legendary Dyne, Alex dreams of one day becoming a renowned Dragonmaster and matching the achievements of his lifelong hero. Encouraged by his childhood friend Ramus, Alex sets out with his companion Nall and his adopted sister Luna on a seemingly trivial quest, unaware that it would prove to be the first step in an epic adventure whose outcome will determine the fate of the entire world.
Following the critically-acclaimed iOS port of the Japanese roleplaying game Vay, SoMoGa has returned to bring you Lunar: Silver Star Story, now with numerous enhancements for iOS! A traditional, turn-based Japanese RPG, this port offers:
- Nearly a full hour of animated cut scenes
- Remastered soundtrack with high quality music and voice tracks
- A completely updated interface designed specifically for iOS devices
- Retina artwork and widescreen gameplay
- GameController support

bluejetty:00018751:ios.summary:
Picnic is the online supermarket for busy families. Order all your groceries easily in the app and get everything delivered to your door 100% free. No more heavy lifting – we bring the supermarket straight to your home.
Online grocery shop
bluejetty:00018751:ios.description:
Picnic is the online supermarket for busy families. Order all your groceries easily in the app and get everything delivered to your door 100% free. No more heavy lifting – we bring the supermarket straight to your home.
Online grocery shopping without the stress
With the Picnic app, you can quickly organise your shopping list, weekly planner and weekly menu. Add products to your planner, discover helpful recipes and order food whenever it suits you. No queues, no walking around busy stores – just smart grocery shopping with a supermarket app.
Meals for the whole family – ready in 20 minutes
No inspiration for cooking? Discover hundreds of recipes and healthy meals, specially created for families with children. From quick pasta dishes to tasty oven meals and creative cooking ideas. Many dishes are ready in under 20 minutes. Use our meal planner and weekly planner to plan your weekly menu and reduce mental load.
Quality like a fresh market
Alongside well-known brands you’d find at major supermarkets, Picnic offers a unique range with products from local bakers, greengrocers and sustainable producers. Discover special products you won’t find in every supermarket – similar to premium fresh markets, but all in one complete online supermarket.
Delivered free, always
Picnic delivers your groceries to your door for free. No delivery fees like takeaway or food ordering platforms. Simply order your groceries and food and choose a delivery time that works for you. Perfect for busy families who want to save time.
Everything in one easy app
The Picnic app combines supermarket, planner, shopping list and recipes in one clear and easy-to-use app. Add ingredients directly from recipes, complete your shopping list and order instantly. Whether you’re looking for cooking inspiration, healthy meals, weekly menu ideas or just want to sort your groceries quickly – Picnic makes it easy.
Sustainable & smart
We deliver electrically and work with sustainable producers. That way, you’re not only shopping easily, but also responsibly.
Picnic is more than a supermarket. It’s the smart way to shop for groceries for families who want to save time and enjoy great food. Download the app and discover how easy grocery delivery can be.

bluejetty:00018916:ios.description:
This game is similar to the classic ROOK® card game*.
Play the classic trick-taking game you remember, with the rules you grew up playing.
Bid for the chance to call trump, work with your computer partner to take point cards, and make your bid without getting set.
PLAY YOUR WAY
Start with Kentucky Discard or Western Wyoming rules, or customize the game to match the way your family plays. Blackbird supports a wide variety of rule options, including:
• 1s worth 15 points
• Low, high, or 10.5 Blackbird
• Playing without the Blackbird
• Allowing the Blackbird to be played at any time
• Winning bidder leads
• Red 1 worth 30 points
• Adjustable winning score
• Bonus for taking the most tricks
• Different nest and bidding rules
• And more
CHOOSE YOUR CHALLENGE
Play against computer players at Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty. You can even choose separate difficulty levels for your opponents and your partner.
Easy players make some of the mistakes a beginner might make. Medium provides a balanced challenge, while Hard uses a more advanced strategy to think through possible hidden cards before bidding and playing.
The computer plays by the same information you do. It doesn't peek at hidden cards.
LEARN AS YOU PLAY
New to the game or need a refresher? Helpful tips introduce the game as you play and explain what's happening without getting in your way.
TRACK HOW YOU PLAY
See detailed statistics for your games, with results tracked separately by difficulty level. Complete achievements and see how your play develops over time.
Whether you grew up playing with family, learned at church, or just love trick-taking card games, Blackbird lets you play the version you remember.
* This app is not endorsed by or affiliated with Hasbro, Inc. ROOK® is a registered trademark of Hasbro, Inc.
