Play the classic trick-taking game you remember, with the rules you grew up playing.

Bid for the chance to call trump, work with your computer partner to take point cards, and make your bid without getting set.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Start with Kentucky Discard or Western Wyoming rules, or customize the game to match the way your family plays. Blackbird supports a wide variety of rule options, including:
• 1s worth 15 points
• Low, high, or 10.5 Blackbird
• Playing without the Blackbird
• Allowing the Blackbird to be played at any time
• Winning bidder leads
• Red 1 worth 30 points
• Adjustable winning score
• Bonus for taking the most tricks
• Different nest and bidding rules
• And more

CHOOSE YOUR CHALLENGE

Play against computer players at Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty. You can even choose separate difficulty levels for your opponents and your partner.

Easy players make some of the mistakes a beginner might make. Medium provides a balanced challenge, while Hard uses a more advanced strategy to think through possible hidden cards before bidding and playing.

The computer plays by the same information you do. It doesn't peek at hidden cards.

LEARN AS YOU PLAY

New to the game or need a refresher? Helpful tips introduce the game as you play and explain what's happening without getting in your way.

TRACK HOW YOU PLAY

See detailed statistics for your games, with results tracked separately by difficulty level. Complete achievements and see how your play develops over time.

Whether you grew up playing with family, learned at church, or just love trick-taking card games, Blackbird lets you play the version you remember.


* This app is not endorsed by or affiliated with Hasbro, Inc. ROOK® is a registered trademark of Hasbro, Inc.

Capture information

bluejetty:00121236:ios.description:
Join 12 million players worldwide in this EPIC MMORPG for FREE!
=== Featured by Apple as: What we are playing, Featured Online Game ===
Feel bored with the brainless tapping game?
Empire Online is a completely unexplored fantasy world which has a lot of legendary monsters! Classic turn-based game style, making a good strategy against your enemies, finish over 1000 epic missions to save the world will give you the true fun of a MMORPG on iOS!
Be Afraid to spend a lot in this game?
Don’t be!
Empire Online provided the best equipments from our missions and from players’ empires.
Characters are based on classes but not limited on them! You can learn skills cross classes. Combine with over 6000 equipments, the power of your character is only based on your imagination! 
We will hold events from time to time in game to make new challenges and provide new equipments for you for free!
And you can trade with others to get items you need or even to earn money! 
So, it might be a good classic MMORPG, but why it is called empire online?
Good question! It is called “Empire Online” because you can build empires in game with other players!
We have a very completed empire system which is not like any other game. You can build buildings to sell skills and equipments to other players and make profit from them and you can declare a war against other empires to raid them! 
A might empire can be built only based on a group of good friends which you made in game. We always agree that making new friends is the greatest fun!
Meanwhile, to be a role in empires will let you experience a life you have never experienced. Can anything else be more excited?
Are you still seeking for a real online game on iOS? This is it!
Check our user reviews and rankings! Make a download and have a try! 
I bet you will love this!
--------------------------------
USER REVIEWS
“The perfect iPod game. A classic MMO. If you're looking to pass the time, get this game. It's great as long as you have Internet.” -BFTank
“This is the mmo I've been waiting for! A must have!” –Xephirion
“Great mmo f2p, easy to learn, make friends on, and enjoyable. Recommend if you like RPGs or MMOs.” -Delta dad
“I love this mmorpg it's one of the best mmo I have played on iPad/iPod/iPhone it's really great you should try it out :)” 
“I am not the type who usually plays mobile MMO's, but after playing this game I was shocked. It's amazing how many RPG elements can fit inside this game. It's a must-get!” -PCarnage

bluejetty:00045744:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00045744:ios.description:
Speak real-life Korean, one scene a day.
Koppa gives you one real Korean scene every day: ordering at a café, catching the last train, meeting your partner's parents. You learn what people actually say in that moment, then you say it yourself.
MEET YOUR TUTOR
Your Korean tutor has a personality straight out of a K-drama. He walks you through every scene line by line, listens as you speak, and celebrates with you when you get it.
Easy for complete beginners: every lesson starts from zero, so your first day needs no Korean at all.
START FROM ZERO
• New to Korean? The Hangul tab teaches the alphabet from the first letter: write each one stroke by stroke with your finger, hear how it sounds, and find it in real words.
• Forty letters in four short sets, with your progress on a chart and a time estimate for what is left.
ONE SCENE A DAY
• Understand: every line explained, so you know what it means, how it's built, and when to say it. New to hangul? Romanization is one tap away.
• Speak: say every line out loud and polish your Korean pronunciation.
• Rehearse: put the conversation back together and talk your way through the whole scene.
• Casual: say the scene again the casual way, the Korean you hear in dramas and between friends.
PRACTICE OUT LOUD
• A course of everyday Korean phrases, grouped by situation: at the airport, at the bank, ordering coffee, making friends.
• Say each phrase out loud and get a score with word-by-word notes, so you know which word to work on next.
• Short rounds, and your best recording kept for every phrase, so a few minutes still moves you forward.
Made for K-drama and K-pop fans, for your next trip to Korea, and for anyone who wants to say a Korean sentence out loud and know it landed.
KEEP WHAT YOU LEARN
• Every word you meet is saved to your vocabulary list, free, to review anytime.
• Build a daily streak, one scene at a time.
GO DEEPER WITH KOPPA PREMIUM
• Speaking practice on every phrase in the course, after the free phrases you start with.
• Missed-day review, so a busy week doesn't cost you your progress.
Whether you want to learn Korean for a trip to Seoul, follow a K-drama without subtitles, sing along to K-pop, or talk with someone you love, Koppa teaches Korean conversation you'll actually use.

bluejetty:00073734:ios.name: Pedi STAT
bluejetty:00073734:ios.summary:
Pedi-STAT is a rapid reference for RNs, paramedics, physicians and other healthcare professionals caring for pediatric patients in the emergency or critical care environment. 
************************************
 Reviews
************
bluejetty:00073734:ios.description:
Pedi-STAT is a rapid reference for RNs, paramedics, physicians and other healthcare professionals caring for pediatric patients in the emergency or critical care environment. 
************************************
 Reviews
************************************
Among "The Best Drug Reference Apps for Emergency Physicians" - Emergency Physicians Monthly
5 STARS - "Simple interface provides rapid access to critical data needed when managing a critically ill pediatric patient"
5 Stars - "Very useful for treating kids in high pressure situations with precision."
*****************************
Pedi-STAT features include:
- Rapid results for airway interventions including endotracheal tube sizes, depth, intubation medication dosages, ventilator settings, and sedation
- Cardiac resuscitation data including weight specific dosages for resuscitation medications, cardioversion, and defibrillation
- Access to age and weight specific pediatric equipment including foley catheters, airway management, chest and NG tubes, peripheral and central line sizes, and more
- Seizure medication dosages
- Management of hypoglycemia including age specific dextrose concentrations
- Reference of age specific normal vital signs
- Procedural sedation dosages including single dose meds and infusions, as well as reversal agents
- Calculated pain management medications
- Medical management of allergic reactions and anaphylaxis
Users can quickly access critical information accurately, without having to rely on memory or cumbersome textbooks. 
With just a few taps, users have access to all the necessary data to care for a pediatric patient in the emergent setting, including weight-based and age specific medication dosages and equipment sizes.
Since many of the patients present with minimal known information, all the results can be calculated rapidly with only a known age, date-of-birth, weight, length, or height. Simply enter the known variable and the data is instantly calculated. 
Developed by an Emergency Physician, this app minimizes the risk of medical errors allowing the provider to spend more time caring for the patient, and less time looking up and calculating doses. 
It is a critical companion for any physician, nurse, paramedic, or medical trainee involved in the care of critically ill pediatric patients.

bluejetty:00183429:ios.description:
Craving something delicious? Whether it's pizza, tacos, or your favourite fast food from Burger King and KFC, Bolt Food delivers straight to your door.
WHY CHOOSE BOLT FOOD?
- Real-time tracking: track your order and courier’s location from the restaurant to your doorstep.
- Convenient scheduling: plan ahead and order food or groceries in advance.
- Pickup options: prefer to grab your meal yourself? Use our pickup feature for easy collections.
- Takeaway deals and discounts: save on your favourite meals and snacks.
- Seamless payments: pay effortlessly using Google Pay, Apple Pay, or credit/debit cards.
HOW TO GET STARTED:
1. Set your delivery address.
2. Browse and pick meals, groceries, or snacks from your favourite local restaurants or stores.
3. Place your food order and pay securely.
4. Track your order in real-time.
5. Sit back and enjoy!
DISCOVER LOCAL AND GLOBAL FAVOURITES:
Explore a culinary world at your fingertips with Bolt Food. From beloved local restaurants to renowned fast food chains like McDonald's, get meals from your favourite restaurants delivered to your door.
*BOLT MARKET - QUICK GROCERY DELIVERY:
Need groceries or essentials delivered? Bolt Market brings everyday items like milk, bread, and coffee, as well as speciality products like pet supplies, cosmetics, or alcohol, right to your doorstep. Forget the long supermarket queues and shop smarter with Bolt Market.
*BOLT PLUS
With Bolt Plus, you can access exclusive benefits that save you time and money. For example, you can enjoy priority delivery for your orders, even during the busiest hours.
*GO OUT AND SAVE WITH DINEOUT
As convenient as it is to get food delivered to your door, some moments are worth making the trip out for. Find tables at nearby DineOut restaurants and get a discount off your meal. Just open the app, search for what you crave, and switch to the DineOut tab for in-restaurant offers. 
Bolt Food was created by the European super-app Bolt. It’s challenging the efficiency of the food and grocery delivery industry while helping restaurants and stores get more orders and enabling couriers to earn money.
Become a Bolt Food Courier partner:
Have a car, bike, or motorbike? Earn money delivering meals with Bolt Food: https://bolt.eu/en/food/courier/.
Partner with Bolt Food:
Are you a restaurant or grocery store? Boost your sales by joining Bolt Food: https://bolt.eu/en/food/partner/.
Get in touch with us via food@bolt.eu
Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/boltfood.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
*Only available in selected markets.

bluejetty:00127267:ios.description:
Recommended by Katie Couric as an APP-solutely fabulous baby app for moms! Help your baby relax, stop crying, and sleep better. Includes perfectly looped sounds that your baby will love such as taking a car ride, classical music, conch shell, and doppler ultrasound of the womb.
Need to quiet your baby while out in public? Try our baby rattle that includes complex shapes and fun sounds that will be sure to entertain. Need our sleeping sounds to activate when baby starts crying? Our Baby Monitor will do just that. White Noise Baby has so many great features, requested from parents like you, for your baby to enjoy!
Features
- Perfectly looped ambient sounds and music to help your baby sleep
- Background audio support so you can use other apps while sound continues to play
- Baby monitor plays sound when crying is detected
- High Contrast Baby rattle with touch and shake controls to quiet a fussy baby
- Download new sounds for free using the White Noise Market companion app
- Baby mode notification to reduce interruptions
- Sound shutoff timer (fades volume to silence) with baby monitor restart
- Event log of noise detection helps discover your baby's sleeping cycle
- Tips to help your baby sleep great
- Safety tips from the US Consumer Product Safety Commission
- iPhone 5, SE, 6, 6+, 7, 7+, and iPad Air with Retina display support
- Optimized for longer battery life. No ads!

- Air Conditioner
- Car Ride
- Train Ride
- Truck Ride
- Conch Shell
- Doppler Ultrasound
- Hair Dryer
- Fan
- Vacuum Cleaner
- Blue Noise
- Gray Noise
- Pink Noise
- Brown Noise (aka Red Noise)
- Violet Noise
- White Noise
- Dripping Water
- Water Rumble
- Grandfather Clock
- Heartbeat
- Wind Chimes
HD Classical Music Tracks

bluejetty:00173051:android.name: Lose weight with no stress
bluejetty:00173051:android.summary:
The Opti-fit Method is a revolutionary way to achieve ideal weight and body sculpting for both women and men — without hunger, grueling workouts, calorie counting, or diets.
This android app is your personal fat loss and weight management
bluejetty:00173051:android.description:
The Opti-fit Method is a revolutionary way to achieve ideal weight and body sculpting for both women and men — without hunger, grueling workouts, calorie counting, or diets.
This android app is your personal fat loss and weight management assistant. It helps you quickly and efficiently achieve your goal, whether you’re looking to simply lose weight, trim your belly, or get ripped, achieving a minimal body fat percentage.
Information and food lists
What to eat to lose fat?
The app features a list of simple fat-loss foods. Discover which foods to eliminate from your meal plan to activate your internal fat burner, and as a result, quickly reduce weight and permanently say goodbye to excess fat.
The app will explain which foods to keep for proper nutrition, which for cutting, and what to exclude from your diet to activate the maximum fat-burning mode.
Intermittent fasting and fractional eating
Develop the habit of maintaining a healthy eating regimen and stick to it with a meal reminder.
Intermittent fasting and fractional eating are excellent ways to lose weight without feeling hungry and to complete a stress-free weight loss program of any duration.
If desired, the app will remind you of the times for meals and water intake, so you can even better maintain your chosen meal plan.
Lose fat with Opti-fit
Download this app — start your journey to a healthy and happy lifestyle!
Attention!
The proposed methods and nutritional recommendations are based on the reports of the World Health Organization (WHO), dedicated to healthy lifestyles and fighting obesity. The effectiveness of the "Opti-fit Method" is confirmed by numerous positive reviews, including from users of the previous version of the app - "Opti-fit: Fat Burner."
Nevertheless, do not take the information provided in the app as the only correct solution to the problem of obesity that will suit everyone. Do not neglect medical diagnostics, doctor consultations, and other specialized professionals.
Disclaimer
Your weight loss result* may vary depending on health conditions, individual body parameters, and other circumstances.
• The Opti-fit Method is especially effective for people with a body fat percentage of more than 25%.
• Fitness form levels can be reached

bluejetty:00126985:ios.description:
The all-in-one professional route planner for deliveries, logistics, and travel management.
Veema - Route Planner helps you plan, organize, and navigate your routes smarter than ever. 
Designed for drivers, couriers, and teams managing daily logistics, it combines route creation, optimization, and reporting in one intuitive app.
Create, manage, and export everything — from routes and locations to contacts and items — as professional PDF or CSV files.
Plan complete delivery or travel routes with unlimited stops. Each route can include multiple contacts and items — all organized in a clear structure.
Use the built-in optimization engine to automatically find the best route order to minimize travel time and distance. Customize optimization by setting start and end points or prioritizing stops.
Save detailed Locations with attached Contacts and Items.
Each Contact can include multiple phone numbers, emails, and custom information fields.
Items represent goods or materials linked with Locations or Routes for easy tracking and delivery management.
Attach images directly to any file for better visual reference.

All exported PDFs now feature a unified grayscale layout with improved readability and a professional appearance.

Create folders, copy or move files, and export data as PDF or CSV.
Collaborate easily through Teams by sharing routes, locations, and files — all synchronized through iCloud for seamless teamwork.

bluejetty:00040913:ios.summary: Tarotoo combines traditional tarot symbolism with modern AI to create personalized tarot readings for entertainment and self-reflection. Ask a question, choose a spread, and select your cards. Tarotoo generates an interpretation based on yo
bluejetty:00040913:ios.description:
Tarotoo combines traditional tarot symbolism with modern AI to create personalized tarot readings for entertainment and self-reflection. Ask a question, choose a spread, and select your cards. Tarotoo generates an interpretation based on your question, the cards, their positions, and symbolic meanings.
Explore love, career, relationships, and personal growth through animated tarot cards, classic spreads, and AI-generated interpretations. Basic features are available free, while an optional subscription unlocks additional content and unlimited access.
KEY FEATURES
ANIMATED TAROT DECK
Explore animated cards inspired by the Rider–Waite–Smith tradition. Access the Major Arcana free, or subscribe to unlock the complete 78-card tarot deck, including the Minor Arcana.
AI TAROT READINGS
Type a question and receive an AI-generated interpretation connected to your cards and reading context. Rather than showing only fixed tarot card meanings, Tarotoo considers your question, the selected cards, and their spread positions.
TAROT SPREADS
Choose from classic tarot readings:
• One Card Draw – daily reflection and focus
• Yes or No Tarot – a concise symbolic perspective
• Past, Present, Future – explore patterns and possible directions
• Situation, Obstacle, Solution – consider a challenge from three perspectives
• Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities – subscriber feature
• Love Tarot – subscriber feature for relationship themes
• Celtic Cross Tarot – subscriber feature for an in-depth reading
SUBSCRIBER FEATURES
An optional subscription unlocks the full tarot deck, advanced spreads, unlimited AI tarot readings, expanded interpretations, and unlimited “Psychic Chat” conversations. Subscription options and prices are shown before purchase.
TAROT COMPANION
Own a physical tarot deck? Take or upload a photo of your spread. Tarotoo uses AI image analysis to identify visible cards and generate a symbolism-based interpretation. Unlimited Tarot Companion interpretations are available to subscribers.
CRYSTAL BALL – REFLECTIVE PROMPT TOOL
Ask a yes-or-no question and receive a short reflective prompt. The Crystal Ball does not predict outcomes; it offers a playful way to consider possibilities and approach a question from another perspective.
“PSYCHIC CHAT” – AI SPIRITUALITY CHAT
Have personalized AI conversations about tarot, astrology, numerology, zodiac signs, spirituality, dream symbolism, and related topics. Ask for another perspective, encouragement, or journaling prompts.
“Psychic Chat” is the name of an AI feature. It does not involve a human psychic or claim psychic or supernatural abilities. Basic sessions are available free, with optional subscription access to unlimited conversations.
FOR BEGINNERS AND EXPERIENCED READERS
Use Tarotoo as an AI tarot card reader, tarot learning companion, daily reflection tool, journaling prompt, or source of inspiration alongside your own interpretation.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when purchase is confirmed. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled before renewal. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Cancellation prevents future renewals but does not automatically refund the current subscription period. Refund requests are handled by Apple, subject to its policies and applicable law.
Terms of Use: https://tarotoo.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://tarotoo.com/privacy-policy
Need help? Contact [hello@tarotoo.com](mailto:hello@tarotoo.com).
DISCLAIMER
Tarotoo is provided for entertainment, informational, self-reflection, and personal exploration purposes only. Tarot readings and AI conversations are symbolic, subjective, and may be inaccurate. Tarotoo does not predict the future, reveal objective truths, or guarantee any outcome. It is not a substitute for medical, legal, financial, psychological, mental health, or other professional advice. You must be 18 or older to use the app.

Presentation Creator is a presentation maker for your iPhone and iPad. Open a PowerPoint file, edit every slide, present from your device and export back to PowerPoint or PDF. No design experience needed.
WORKS WITH POWERPOINT
• Open a .pp
bluejetty:00126220:ios.description:
Presentation Creator is a presentation maker for your iPhone and iPad. Open a PowerPoint file, edit every slide, present from your device and export back to PowerPoint or PDF. No design experience needed.
WORKS WITH POWERPOINT
• Open a .pptx file and edit it as real slides, not a flat picture
• Text, images, shapes, charts, layouts and theme colours come through
• Export the finished deck back to PowerPoint (.pptx)
• Charts come back out as real charts, with their data table intact
• Element animations come out with the file and play in PowerPoint
• .pptx files are supported. The older .ppt format is not
PRESENT FROM YOUR IPHONE OR IPAD
• Play your slides full screen with one tap
• Step through with on-screen controls, and see where you are in the deck
• No laptop needed to show your deck
A REAL SLIDE EDITOR
• Start from a designed template or a blank slide
• Change fonts, colours, images, shapes and layouts with simple controls
• Add charts and diagrams to show your numbers
• Add photos from your Photos or from the built-in photo library
• Remove a photo background in one tap
• Add, duplicate and drag slides into a new order
• Open a PDF and edit its pages in the same editor
ANIMATE YOUR SLIDES
• Fade, slide, zoom, bounce, flip, rotate and more
• Set one animation for a whole slide, or a different one per element
• Play them in present mode, and take the element ones with you into PowerPoint
TEMPLATES FOR EVERY KIND OF DECK
• Corporate overview and business proposals
• Financial reports and project updates
• Sales and marketing presentations
• Training and development decks
• Lecture notes, student assignments and classroom presentations
Every template is included. There are no locked templates.
AI THAT HELPS YOU FINISH
• Draft or rewrite the text on a slide
• Generate images for your slides using AI credits
BRING IN WHAT YOU ALREADY HAVE
Import from your iPhone or iPad, from Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive, or straight from your Photos.
• PowerPoint (.pptx) and PDF files
• Adobe Illustrator (AI) and SVG artwork
WORK TOGETHER
• Share a deck with your team or your class
• Share a workspace so everyone edits the same decks
• Brand kit: save your fonts and colours once, then apply them to every slide
ON EVERY DEVICE
Start a deck on your iPhone and finish it on your iPad or computer. Presentations sync automatically.
EXPORT AND SHARE
• PowerPoint (.pptx)
• PDF, with a print-ready option
• PNG, JPG and SVG
• Share a link so other people can view the deck
• No watermark on your files
WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE PRESENTATION CREATOR
• A real slide editor that opens and saves PowerPoint files
• Present from the phone in your hand
• Templates built for decks, at slide size
• Every template is free
PLANS
Presentation Creator is free to download and use, and every template is included free. Starter, Business and Scale plans raise the allowances and add AI credits, storage and team seats. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Service: https://desygner.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://desygner.com/privacy
PowerPoint is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation. Presentation Creator is published by Desygner Pty Ltd and is not affiliated with Microsoft.
Built in Australia.

bluejetty:00088242:ios.summary:

Easily
bluejetty:00088242:ios.description:
Join the more than 200,000 users Australia-wide paying their bills with the Sniip app. 
There’s a reason we’ve become the go-to for bill payments. With Sniip, you take back control of your bills and choose the way YOU want to pay!
Easily keep track of your bill payments and receipts, schedule a payment, set-up an instalment plan or create recurring payments. You can even have your emailed bills delivered automatically to the Sniip app and receive a push notification when it’s ready for payment. Never miss a bill again!
So, whether it’s your tax bill, school fees, rent, rego, membership renewal, phone bill, health insurance, car insurance, general insurance, body corporate, rates, water, utilities (or whatever bill you’ve got to pay) - if it’s one of the more than 60,000 Australian bills with a BPAY Biller Code on it, you can pay it with Sniip!
Plus, we’ve partnered with Apple Pay! You’ll see your Apple Pay wallet in the Sniip app and you can pay your bills with the click of a button. Simple!
Whether it’s your tax bills, superannuation, school fees, rates, insurance or any other bill that offers a BPAY Biller Code and Reference Number, paying with Sniip earns you FULL POINTS!
Connect your Virgin Australia Business Flyer account to Sniip and earn Velocity Points for your business on your bill payments with Sniip at no extra cost. 
HOW IT WORKS
Does it really take less than 20 seconds to pay a bill with Sniip? Yep, sure does!
• Use Sniip app to scan the BPAY Biller Code
• Enter the amount you want to pay
• Select the debit or credit card you want to pay with
• Pay securely with Touch ID, Face ID, or a four-digit pin. Done!
PROCESSING FEES
Paying from a bank account has a processing fee FREE in the Sniip app.
Debit cards incur a 0.65% processing fee, and prepaid cards incur a 0.85% processing fee.
We offer both personal and business processing fees for American Express. Personal Amex payments (not including ATO/superannuation/business billers) receive a 1.29% processing fee - the best rate in the market! Our business rates are tiered based on the payment amount from 1.75% +GST. 
Diners, Citibank and other credit cards (Visa and Mastercard) incur a 1.5% processing fee (international cards are 3%).
NOTE: There are no subscription fees, fixed-fees per transaction or any other hiddens fees in the Sniip app. The processing fee is the only fee you pay for our service and this fee is paid once only on your card, through the Sniip app. There are no additional fees for your transaction.

bluejetty:00145731:ios.summary:
- SEND AND RECEIVE FAXES WITH EASE
FireFax makes faxing simple, fast, and reliable right from your iPhone or iPad. Send contracts, signed forms, scanned documents, or handwritten notes in just a few taps, and receive important faxes in the
bluejetty:00145731:ios.description:
- SEND AND RECEIVE FAXES WITH EASE
FireFax makes faxing simple, fast, and reliable right from your iPhone or iPad. Send contracts, signed forms, scanned documents, or handwritten notes in just a few taps, and receive important faxes in the same app.
- SEND AND RECEIVE WITH A DEDICATED FAX LINE
Get a dedicated fax number in FireFax and use that fax line for both sending and receiving faxes. Your personal phone number is not used for faxing.
- NEVER LOSE YOUR PROGRESS
Drafts keep your work safe while you are in the middle of preparing a fax. Close the app and come back later to continue exactly where you left off.
- STAY SYNCED ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
Sign in with Apple lets you access the same account on your devices, so your fax activity and progress stay with you.
- SEND FAX ANYWHERE
Send faxes instantly to domestic and international numbers. FireFax keeps you connected wherever you are.
- MULTIPLE FORMAT SUPPORT
Just add your file and we'll send it. FireFax supports PDFs, DOCs, JPEGs, and many more formats.
- CAMERA-TO-FAX
Use your camera or the built-in document scanner to capture paper documents and fax them instantly.
- PREVIEW BEFORE SENDING
Review your fax before sending to make sure everything looks right.
- EASY FOR EVERYONE
Whether you are a business professional, student, freelancer, or just need to send a quick fax, FireFax keeps the process simple.
Powerful faxing features built for real use
FireFax is more than a basic fax sender. It helps you send, receive, organize, and continue your work without friction.
- SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS:
FireFax offers subscription options tailored to your needs. For detailed pricing, please refer to the subscription section inside the app or visit the App Store. All subscriptions are auto-renewable, ensuring uninterrupted access to our services. You can manage your subscription preferences in your iTunes Account settings, where you can also turn off auto-renewal.
By using FireFax, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

bluejetty:00077085:ios.name: Marriage Card Game
bluejetty:00077085:ios.summary: Marriage game is mostly known as of the rummy card game. This card tricking game is played with 3 decks of cards. The cards are distributed among 2 to 5 player; the players get 21 cards each. Marriage game is also considered as a tricky car
bluejetty:00077085:ios.description:
Marriage game is mostly known as of the rummy card game. This card tricking game is played with 3 decks of cards. The cards are distributed among 2 to 5 player; the players get 21 cards each. Marriage game is also considered as a tricky card game, because of its gameplay and number of cards played.
The marriage card game itself has multiple variants of the gameplay. Currently, there are 3 different versions of the game. Each variant is just a little different from the others. The rules are the most similar to the rummy games; the arrangement of sequences, sets and triplets are closely similar. Apart from the similarities, what makes Marriage different is the way the joker (maal) is shown. You can only know the joker cards once you have submitted the first set of cards.
How to Play
Playing Marriage Card Game is pretty simple. In the first half, you have two options: show three Sets or show seven Dublees. The option to show Dublees is only available when you are playing with 4 or more players. You can either show three sets/sequence/triplets or show seven pairs of the twin cards. The twin cards have the same face and same card value. Since the game is played with 3 sets of cards, chances are high that you already have a few of the twin cards. Arranging the cards to form three Sets or seven Dublees is up to you. After you have shown your cards for the first round, you can see what the joker (Maal) card is.
The second half of the Marriage Card Game depends on what cards you showed in the first half. If you had shown seven Dublees, you only have 7 cards on hand. To declare the game you need one more Dublee cards. If you had previously shown three sets, you now have 12 cards on hand. You have to arrange the cards into three Sets. You can use the joker (Maal) cards to make the Sets. The rule that explains which cards are marked as jokers is quite different in this rummy variant. Once you have the 4 sets ready, you can declare the game
Winning the Marriage Game
Unlike like the Indian rummy variant, the person who declares the game doesn't necessarily win the game. The rules of winning are a bit closer to that of Nepalese variant. The game automatically calculates the points for each player based on the value of Maal the player holds, and the number and values of unarranged cards in hand. Calculating the points manually is pretty hards, so the beginners are intimidated by it.
The game is still in development, and we are seeking feedback from people who are already playing marriage in the real world with their friends. Tell us how the game is, and how it can better match your expectations.
Thank you for playing the Marriage Game.

The rules are the most similar to the rummy games; the arrangement of sequences, sets and triplets are closely similar. Apart from the similarities, what makes Marriage different is the way the joker (maal) is shown. You can only know the joker cards once you have submitted the first set of cards.

How to Play

Playing Marriage Card Game is pretty simple. In the first half, you have two options: show three Sets or show seven Dublees. The option to show Dublees is only available when you are playing with 4 or more players. You can either show three sets/sequence/triplets or show seven pairs of the twin cards. The twin cards have the same face and same card value. Since the game is played with 3 sets of cards, chances are high that you already have a few of the twin cards. Arranging the cards to form three Sets or seven Dublees is up to you. After you have shown your cards for the first round, you can see what the joker (Maal) card is.

The second half of the Marriage Card Game depends on what cards you showed in the first half. If you had shown seven Dublees, you only have 7 cards on hand. To declare the game you need one more Dublee cards. If you had previously shown three sets, you now have 12 cards on hand. You have to arrange the cards into three Sets. You can use the joker (Maal) cards to make the Sets. The rule that explains which cards are marked as jokers is quite different in this rummy variant. Once you have the 4 sets ready, you can declare the game


Winning the Marriage Game


Unlike like the Indian rummy variant, the person who declares the game doesn't necessarily win the game. The rules of winning are a bit closer to that of Nepalese variant. The game automatically calculates the points for each player based on the value of Maal the player holds, and the number and values of unarranged cards in hand. Calculating the points manually is pretty hards, so the beginners are intimidated by it.


The game is still in development, and we are seeking feedback from people who are already playing marriage in the real world with their friends. Tell us how the game is, and how it can better match your expectations.

Thank you for playing the Marriage Game.

With instant step-by-step solutions, interactive learning tools, and thousands of high-yield practice questions, this is the smartest way to study.
AI Tutor & Homework Solver (24/7):
Take a photo or type in your question—math, biology, chemistry, physics, psychology, organic chemistry, and more—and get instant, detailed solutions with explanations. Our AI goes beyond giving you the answer: it teaches the concepts so you actually understand them. No more guesswork, no more Googling. Just real-time learning that sticks.
KOTC Classroom – Smarter, Personalized Studying:
Upload notes, PowerPoints, textbooks, images, or PDFs—and watch our AI transform them into flashcards, summaries, and multiple-choice questions. It organizes everything by subject and topic, giving you a study tool built from your own materials. Perfect for lecture review, exam prep, or last-minute cramming.
Built for the MCAT. Perfect for the NCLEX and USMLE too:
With over 5,000 MCAT-style practice questions and passage-based reasoning, our question bank covers every section: Biochemistry, Physics, General Chemistry, Biology, Behavioral Sciences, and Organic Chemistry. Detailed explanations break down every answer so you understand the reasoning behind it. Preparing for the NCLEX or USMLE? You’ll find custom study tools, adaptive practice, and clinical-style reasoning questions too.
Gamified Study Modes to Stay Motivated:
Boost retention through competitive, engaging study modes. Race friends in multiplayer quizzes. Earn points, unlock streaks, and rise up the leaderboard. Studying doesn’t have to be boring—and with King of the Curve, it never is.
Predictive Scoring & Smart Analytics:
Track your performance in real time and see where you stand. Our adaptive learning engine predicts your future MCAT score and shows your strengths and weaknesses by subject. Users who study with KOTC average a 515+—and many crush 520+.
Flashcards, Quizzes, and Adaptive Learning:
Use smart flashcards powered by spaced repetition to drill tough concepts. Build your own quizzes or let the app do it for you based on your progress. Whether you’re reviewing a specific lecture or reinforcing a weak area, KOTC keeps your study focused and efficient.
Join the Study Revolution – Classrooms Built for You:
Collaborate with classmates by joining or creating private and public classrooms. Share content, contribute questions, and keep each other accountable. Track group progress and make studying social, competitive, and supportive.
Fast, Reliable, and Built by Students Who’ve Been There:
We’re a team of MCAT scorers, med students, and pre-health pros who built the platform we wish we had. Every feature, every tool, and every update is built with one mission: helping you succeed.
Perfect for:
MCAT prep (CARS, Chem/Phys, Bio/Biochem, Psych/Soc)
NCLEX review and question practice
USMLE Step 1-style studying
AI-powered biology, chemistry, and physics homework help
Pre-med, nursing, and allied health students
Anyone who wants better grades, smarter tools, and faster results
Download King of the Curve for FREE today.
Study smarter. Learn faster. Score higher. Whether you're aiming for a 528 or need help passing your next class, King of the Curve is your AI-powered shortcut to success.

bluejetty:00115609:ios.description:
** Welcome to Simple Art Coloring Book ASMR! **
Looking for a cozy, antistress, and relaxing way to spend your time? This cute and calm coloring book is your companion for comfy days, digital meditation, and peaceful creativity. Whether you're new to coloring or a seasoned artist, Simple Art Coloring Book ASMR offers the ideal coloring experience for all moods and skill levels.
** Aesthetic, Calm & Cozy Design ** 
Every picture in our coloring book is carefully crafted with a cute and cozy aesthetic. We use bold solid lines and large white areas that make coloring feel easy, accessible, and incredibly satisfying. It’s all about comfy coloring – no stress, no mess, just soft shapes and sweet moments to brighten your day.
** Quick & Simple Coloring Sessions ** 
Each artwork is designed to be completed quickly, great for short pauses, like waiting in a queue, riding the subway, or just taking a break from your day. The simple and calm layout makes this game good for antistress and color therapy.
** Good for Stress Relief & Self Care ** 
This coloring book is more than a casual game. It’s your pocket-size stress relief tool. Dive into drawing therapy and relax your mind while filling pages with color. Our users describe it as nice for:
# antistress drawing and calm meditation
# mood support through color therapy
# mindful, cozy moments in a busy day
# happy coloring that brings joy and balance
** Offline? No Problem ** 
While some content may require internet connection, most of the pictures are available offline. Whether you're flying in airplane mode or relaxing in a no wifi zone, Simple Art Coloring Book ASMR lets you enjoy coloring without distractions.
** No Subscription Needed to Enjoy the Fun ** 
You can enjoy a large selection of cute drawings without needing any subscription or extra payments. This makes our coloring book accessible and easy to dive into from the start. Great for casual players, teens, or adults looking for a cozy drawing game.
** Hand-Drawn Art Only ** 
All illustrations are made by professional artists with over 8 years of experience creating coloring games and drawing apps. There is no AI art here – just soulfully crafted pictures full of warmth, charm, and personality. Each coloring page brings cozy energy and emotional comfort.
** Optimal Coloring Tools for Everyone ** 
Whether you're just starting your coloring journey or already love to experiment with texture, shading and color effects, we’ve got you covered. Use soft pastel palettes, aesthetic brushes, and gentle ASMR-style fill tools. Create stunning results in minutes with our mindful and comfy system.
** Adapted for All Ages & Skills ** 
This coloring game is designed for all kinds of users:
# Beginners will love how easy it is to paint beautiful, colorful drawings with no effort.
# Advanced users can use special brushes to create gradients, lighting, and shadows.
# Great for teens and adults alike.
** Welcome to CozyHub – Your In-App Community ** 
Our unique CozyHub feature gives you a space to share your finished artworks and get inspired by others. Publish your favorite pieces, get likes, and explore a world of cozy, creative energy. It’s like a little art club inside your coloring book!
** Why You’ll Love Simple Art Coloring Book ASMR **
# Aesthetic and cute design for cozy gameplay
# Antistress experience through coloring, drawing, and painting
# Great for calm moments, self care, and color therapy
# Good as a girl game, casual game, or stress relief tool
# Offline coloring available – play without wifi
# Supports mindful, relaxing, and sweet moods
# Pastel and colorful themes to match your vibe
# Kawaii, comfy, and super satisfying visuals
Whether you enjoy art games, coloring for adults, or cozy girl games, this coloring book is made to help you relax in the simple painting.
Terms of Service: https://abovegames.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://abovegames.com/privacy-policy

NITNEM, EVERY DAY
- Japji Sahib, Jaap Sahib, Tav Prasad Savaiye, Chaupai Sahib, Anand Sahib, Rehras Sahib and Kirtan Sohila

SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI
- Read all 1,430 Angs with transliteration and English translation
- Search Gurbani and save the lines that speak to you
ASK SIMRAN
- Ask anything about Sikhi or Gurbani, privately and without judgment
- Answers grounded in Gurbani, with sources
SIMRAN AND SANGAT
- Guided Waheguru Simran and a jaap mala counter
- Share an Ardas and read reflections from the Sangat
WHY SIMRAN
- One app for your whole daily Sikh prayer routine
- Calm and reverent by design, with no ads
- Private: we never sell or share your personal data
Begin each day with Waheguru.

这是一款好玩、萌酷、有挑战性的实时对战休闲竞技游戏。在这个球球的世界里，每个人都化身为一颗独特的球球，大球吃小球，努力生存下来就是唯一目标。嘿，成为一个“球球巨无霸”是每个球球的梦想呢！
游戏玩法
1.大球吃小球是这个世界的真理！
2.变大变胖是这个世界民众的梦想！
3.只要合理控制球球的运动路径就可以吃掉沿路的小球球，变大变胖变强！
4.小球不要沮丧，飞毛腿的你，只要不停的吃，终有一天你也会成为无敌的胖纸呢！
5.大球也不要轻心，身为胖纸的你，横行霸道的时候千万小心暗器噢~
游戏特色
1.“戳戳戳”的懒癌操作
厕所里“戳戳戳”，电梯里“戳戳戳”，被窝里“戳戳戳”， 是的，即使你是一枚懒癌男（女），也只需要动用一根食指慢慢悠闲的“戳戳戳”，就可以控制球球的路径进行游戏了呢！
2.“快乐有趣”的策略战斗
“躲进灌木丛就不会被发现了呢”“分裂一次就能把它吃掉了吧！”“跟在大胖纸身边，好像会安全一些啊”对战的策略就在你的指尖，而小小的快乐生在你的心尖喔。
3. “我就是我”的独特形象
每个球球都可以自定义外观和名字。“嘿，快到碗里来！” “看见你，我就忍不住流口水了呢！”哈哈，你没看错，这些都是球球的名字喔！快来为自己起个霸气的名字吧！

跨房间，跨楼层，跨年龄层，跨地域，在这款游戏里，你遇见谁都是有可能的喔。斗智斗勇吧，把朋友吃掉，把邻居吃掉，把陌生人吃掉……咦，怎么听起来有点邪恶呢，但真的很好玩啊！哈哈哈！

bluejetty:00138852:ios.description:
The My Challenge: Diet Plans app is your go-to solution for making low-carb living effortless. From the very start.
We provide a streamlined, ultra-personalized, and user-friendly no-carb challenge program to help you achieve the body and health you deserve.
With the My Challenge: Diet Plans, every plan is uniquely crafted just for you. We tailor your plan based on your lifestyle, health, age, individual preferences, and nutritional needs to ensure you achieve the fastest results. Your needs, your body, your plan.
Our app is designed by professional nutritionists and behavioral scientists to help you lose weight in the safest way possible. 
Let us do the science and planning so you can focus on what matters most – changing your life for the better.
Low-carb living is not just a diet. It's a recipe for a healthy life:
- Fast weight loss
- Improved heart health 
- Lower blood pressure
- Clear and sharp mind
- Lower blood sugar 
- More energy
- Better mood
- Improved sleep
- Hormone balance
My Challenge: Diet Plans Features:
Meal Planner
Knowing what and when to eat can make or break your no-carb success. We make meal planning simple for you. Get carb-free, easy-to-prepare recipes for your breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks with ingredients you love.
- 10,000+ delicious recipes 
- Easy customization
- Basic ingredients 
- Shopping list
- Vegetarian recipes included
Macronutrient Tracker
Keep track of your macros with ease. We will take care of the complicated calculations for you. Whether you eat the meals we provide, we will account for all your daily macros.
Progress Tracker
We offer an intuitive, all-in-one tracking solution so you can follow your no carbs diet with confidence. Let us guide you step by step to a healthier and fitter life.
- Weight tracker
- Step tracker
- Water tracker
- Smart reports and insights 
Effective Workouts (Paid Feature)
Powerful, personalized, and effective workouts to help you get active, lose weight, and burn fat faster. Just 10–30 minutes a day is all it takes to start seeing results fast.
- Workouts that are best for your body
- Simple video instructions
- Developed by fitness experts
Guidance From Experts
Stay on track with nutrition experts, dedicated customer support, and daily recommendations right in your pocket. If you have any doubts or need a motivational boost, our team is just a click away.
- Daily tips to keep you on track
- Nutritionists just a click away 
- 24/7 customer support
Thriving Community
Losing weight is easier when you do it with like-minded people. We have united thousands of enthusiasts, professionals, and wellness experts in a community to inspire transformations around the globe. Join the fun!
- 60,000 active members
- Ask questions and help others
- Inspire and be inspired
Join the fun! 
App integrations:
We use HealthKit to collect step activity data.

The Holy Bible in Russian offers a clear and meaningful translation of Scripture for Russian-speaking believers, allowing them to engage deeply with God’s Word. It carries a long tradition of faith and scholarship that supports spiritual understanding.
Modern editions continue to serve as a guide for prayer, study, and daily reading, helping individuals strengthen their faith and connection with God. It remains a trusted source for spiritual growth and reflection.

Features -

Daily Verse: Set reminders to receive daily Bible verse notifications.
 
MY LIBRARY: Access your highlighted verses, notes, and bookmarked Scriptures in one place.

Old & New Testaments: Read both the Old and New Testaments within one app.

Verse Editor: Create beautiful Bible verse posts using different backgrounds and share them with others.

Nearby Churches: Discover churches near your location.

Books: Explore a collection of Christian eBooks.

Wallpapers: Browse a beautiful collection of inspiring wallpapers.

Videos: Watch videos on Jesus, hope, wisdom, motivation, gratitude, healing, and more.

Festive Calendar: Explore Christian festivals and feast days.

Popular Verse: Discover Bible verses by topics such as love, fear, peace, and more.

Customise Your Bible: Personalise your reading experience by adjusting fonts and text colours.

1000 Praises: Explore a devotional collection celebrating God's names and attributes.

Bible Quotes: Share Bible quotes in both image and text formats.

Bible Quiz: Test your knowledge of the Bible through engaging quizzes.

Bible Stories: Explore timeless and inspiring Bible stories for readers of all ages.

Help Desk: Submit support requests and attach photos to provide additional details.

Dictionary: Explore a searchable, Bible-based dictionary for easy reference.

Dream Meanings: Discover Biblical and Christian perspectives on dream meanings.

Word Highlights: Highlight specific words or letters for deeper reflection.

App Activity: Track your reading streaks, time spent, refreshes, and overall app usage.

Search: Quickly find Bible verses, chapters, and topics.

Products: Explore Bible-related products available within the app.

VerseBot: Get AI-powered explanations of Bible verses with convenient copying and sharing options.

Bible Verse Clips: Enjoy short, inspirational Bible clips shared by the community.

Prayer Request: Submit prayer requests and receive support from the community.

Nearby Events: Discover Christian events and gatherings near your location.

Chapter-Wise Video Learning: Watch videos that help you gain a deeper understanding of individual Bible chapters.

Bible Clips: Watch short, inspiring Biblical clips shared by the faith community.

Bible Streaks: Maintain your daily Bible reading streak and build consistency in Scripture reading.

Mark as Read – Quiz: Take quizzes based on the Bible verses you have read.

Audio Bible – Speed Control: Adjust audio playback speed to listen faster or slower according to your preference.

Worship Songs: Praise God and strengthen your connection with Him through uplifting worship songs and lyrics.

Audio Bible Experience: Listen to reading plans with text-to-speech narration and soulful background music.

Fasting Tracker: Track your fasting days, maintain spiritual discipline, and stay consistent with your fasting and prayer commitments.

Church Fathers: Submit prayer requests, discover nearby events, and explore upcoming events to stay connected with your faith community.

Journey Tracker: Follow your spiritual journey, monitor your progress, and build consistent habits in Bible reading, prayer, and faith.

Character Explorer: Discover Bible characters, explore their stories, and learn valuable lessons from their faith, challenges, and experiences.

bluejetty:00187251:ios.summary:
Business Card Scanner App | Scan Business Cards Using QR Code | Scan Conference Badges - Capture More Leads at Events, Conferences and Tradeshows
Scan cards and badges in seconds or submit tricky cards for 100% accurate human transcription
bluejetty:00187251:ios.description:
Business Card Scanner App | Scan Business Cards Using QR Code | Scan Conference Badges - Capture More Leads at Events, Conferences and Tradeshows
Scan cards and badges in seconds or submit tricky cards for 100% accurate human transcription!
**Latest additions to ScanBizCards – Scan QR code, and save as contact in the app**
ScanBizCards app users can now create a shareable profile within the app with contact details such as name, job title, company name, emails etc. This profile can be shared through the ScanBizCards share code (similar to a QR code). ScanBizCards app users can also scan the ScanBizCards share code using the default camera app on their device and save it as a contact within the app. If a user does not currently have the ScanBizCards installed and scans the ScanBizCards share code, they are navigated to a webpage on their iPhone/iPad’s browser and can download contact info as a .vcf file and store it on their native address book.
KEY BENEFITS - BUSINESS CARD & CONFERENCE BADGE SCANNING APP
* Unlimited business card scans
* Export directly to Hubspot and Outlook (limited to 10 card exports - unlimited on the Premium app).
* Easily add contacts to iPhone address book
* Create new contacts or merge scans with existing records
* Scan both sides of the card--never lose a note!
* Scan in any direction--it detects text automatically
* Human transcription available for hard-to-read cards
ADDITIONAL FEATURES
* Add notes to each contact
* Forward contacts to colleagues (text, image and VCard)
* Send instant email and your VCard to new contact
* Search and sort cards with cover flow 3D view
* Compatible with ScanBizCards Enterprise (available on the Salesforce AppExchange)
LITE (FREE VERSION) BUSINESS CARD & CONFERENCE BADGE SCANNING APP LIMITATIONS
* Add unlimited business cards to the address book (USA users only)
* One-time credit of 2 card exports to Salesforce
* No assigning contacts to groups
Install ScanBizCards Premium for instant access to unlimited business card saves, full calendar integration and CRM integration, group creation, email signature import and much, much more.
AWARDS AND REVIEWS
“Pretty amazing stuff” [Apple Gazette]
“Bringing order to the chaos of business card collection” [New York Times]
Winner of the 2011 MOBI Award [Sept 21, 2011]
Featured on ABC TV
LANGUAGE SUPPORT (21 languages)
Czech, Danish, English, German, Finnish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Lithuanian, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Slovakian, Spanish, Serbian, Swedish, Turkish, Vietnamese
MORE
ScanBizCards is the favorite business card app reader with reviewers because it doesn't just scan cards into the address book (better than other apps) - but goes much beyond, offering over 27 premium features not included in ANY other business card scanner app.
For more information please visit https://support.scanbizcards.com/ or email us at support@scanbizcards.com

bluejetty:00026942:ios.name: Store Cards・Loyalty Programs
bluejetty:00026942:ios.summary:
Store Cards – Your Loyalty Cards, Organized and Always with You!
Say goodbye to bulky wallets and forgotten reward points. Store Cards helps you digitize and manage all your loyalty cards, passes, and card-style documents – all in one sleek
bluejetty:00026942:ios.description:
Store Cards – Your Loyalty Cards, Organized and Always with You!
Say goodbye to bulky wallets and forgotten reward points. Store Cards helps you digitize and manage all your loyalty cards, passes, and card-style documents – all in one sleek, intuitive app.
New in Recent Versions:
• Beautiful, highly customizable widgets for your Home Screen, Today View, and Lock Screen – your favorite cards are just a tap away.
• Enhanced barcode display for faster, more reliable scanning on iPhone and Apple Watch.
• Refined design, improved performance, and thoughtful details throughout the app.
How It Works:
1. Select your loyalty card from a library of ready-to-use templates.
2. Display the barcode at checkout.
3. Or pre-add your card to Apple Wallet and use it with ease.
4. Scan, earn, and enjoy your rewards!
What Are Card Templates?
Templates include logos, card images, and direct links to information about loyalty programs, promotions, coupons, vouchers, gift cards, and more.
You’ll find cards from major brands across 40+ countries, including the USA, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Canada, India, Australia, and many more.
Want to go beyond loyalty cards?
You can also:
• Create custom virtual cards
• Add user-defined fields
• Store secure documents like ID cards, driver's licenses, or badges
• Personalize cards with your own layout and details
Available in Your Language
The app interface is fully localized in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Georgian, and Russian.
Private by Design
We value your privacy. Store Cards requires no registration and asks only for essential permissions.
Battery-friendly: the app runs only when you use it – no background drain.
Key Features:
• No sign-up, no subscription required
• Works offline – perfect for travel or weak signal
• Full Apple Watch support
• Add cards to Apple Wallet (Apple Wallet passes are for display only and do not store balances or discounts)
• iCloud backup & restore
• Password protection for your data
• Wi-Fi export/import of card data
• Dark mode support
• Interface customization
• Barcode recognition via camera
• Voice command support and Siri Shortcuts
• Auto-align photos to card frame
• In-depth Help section with searchable instructions
• Supports a wide range of barcode formats (full list in Help)
Free vs. PRO – Know the Limits
The Free Version lets you add up to 15 loyalty cards: 8 instantly, and 7 more by watching optional reward videos.
To unlock the full power of Store Cards, go PRO and enjoy:
- Unlimited card slots
- Unlimited Apple Wallet support
- 100% ad-free experience
All version details are clearly explained in the app's Help file.
Why Choose Store Cards?
Our mission is simple: help you save time and stay organized. Whether you’re collecting points, redeeming offers, or just streamlining your digital life, Store Cards is your smart wallet – always at your fingertips.
Questions, feedback, or suggestions?
We’re here to help! Email: storecards.iosapp@gmail.com
Additional contact info available in the Help section.
Stay Connected
Follow us for news and updates:
• Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/storecards/
• X (Twitter): https://twitter.com/storecardsapp

bluejetty:00090789:ios.description:
FTAXI is a service for booking easy rides that enables you to get transport to any destination including airport whenever you want. The app works Worldwide. Request taxi ride service and enjoy your trip!
FTAXI - high technology
Once you request ride to airport or any other destination, you can check the distance between you and your taxi driver.
FTAXI - safety
All our drivers are certified and have permits to take rides and providing you the best service everytime.
FTAXI - reliable taxi drivers
We keep under control all documentation of our drivers. We cooperate with licensed car drivers who have permits to operate cab rides. We take care of your safety seriously. You can rest assured that our taxi provides safe and reliable rides. All drivers are constantly trained to deliver excellent car service to our clients.
FTAXI - affordable rides
Our wide fleet of cars suits every customer. Want to ride locally or take a break and go on an outstanding trip? You got it!
FTAXI - get your car service:
- Confirm your current location and destination point
- Get information about your taxi driver, as well as his or her car
- Monitor your ride progress during your trip
FTAXI - other benefits
- Fast car service. The nearest car will pick you up anywhere Worldwide, so you don't have to wait for a very long time after you request taxi.
- You can always rate your ride, which helps us improve taxi service we provide.
- Save your favorite places for easy booking next time.
Contact us:
https://www.ftaxi.app/
support@ftaxi.app

bluejetty:00022120:ios.name: Oz Weather Plus

bluejetty:00022120:ios.description:
Designed for maximum clarity and ease of use and optimised for latest iOS releases - All the essential Australian weather information from the Bureau of Meteorology - presented quickly, clearly and elegantly - plus powerful and unique new features!
BASIC FEATURES:
► Forecasts - so you know what to expect for the week ahead, in beautifully colourful, clear and readable presentation
► Current Weather - so you know what is happening now (for ALL your nearby locations)
► Animated Radar - so you know where it is raining, and whether it is heading your way (with animated radar image loops), also now fully zoomable, with crosshairs centred on your own location
► Tide data and graphs
 - For hundreds of primary and secondary tide sites around Australia
► Widget on the Notifications screen - with 4 in-app options for forecast format
► Watch app with complications
► Further details...
 - 7 day forecasts for more than 500 official forecast locations
 - Detailed local observations for more than 800 locations, typically updated every 10 mins
 - Each forecast location includes up to 10 nearest official observation locations, accessible by side-scrolling action.
 - 50+ rain radar locations around Australia
PREMIUM FEATURES - !!!NEW - THESE ARE NOW AVAILABLE TO ALL USERS!!!
These more advanced features are now available to all users (additional in-app purchases no longer required).
► Hourly Forecasts - hour by hour forecast of temperature, wind and probability of rain
► Recent Weather - graphs and tabulations of most recent 72hrs (3 days) of weather history
► Push Notifications
 - Local warnings alerts
 - NEW and UNIQUE to this app - Weather Alarms!!!
 - For example when the temperature crosses any threshold, like 35C
 - Or the windspeed, or amount of rain, or humidity level, etc...
► Lots More Features (just some of many..!)
 - Graphs and tabulations of weather observations history over past 3 days
 - Weather maps showing national capitals forecasts, local observations, detailed colour-coded regional observed temperatures, and capital city observations
 - Option to preload radar images for faster access
Terms of Use: https://www.ozpda.com/terms/ozweather.pdf
Privacy Policy: https://www.ozpda.com/privacy/ozweather.html
NOTE:
 - This application contains weather data *only* for Australian locations. It is offered to overseas users only for those who want to keep an eye on Australian weather.
 - Your feedback is welcomed, and the application includes an email link on its About screen for that purpose (ozweather@ozpda.com)

iPeriod® – Period & Cycle Tracking Since 2008
Trusted by millions of women, iPeriod makes it easy to track your period, understand your cycle, recognize patterns, and keep your personal health information private.
“A must-have Personal Assistant” – MSN
“Top iPhone App for Busy Women” – Forbes
“Simple yet ingenious” – Popular Science
“What’s Hot” – App Store
PRIVATE. PERSONAL. EASY TO USE.
Your cycle information is personal. iPeriod has never sold or shared your private health data, and we never will.
Whether you’re tracking periods, planning for pregnancy, following fertility signs, or simply learning more about your cycle, iPeriod gives you powerful tools without unnecessary clutter.
WHY WOMEN CHOOSE iPERIOD
• Trusted since 2008 with millions of downloads
• Track periods, cycles, fertility signs, moods, symptoms, weight, and more
• More than 80 symptoms and tracking options
• Personalized period and fertile-window predictions
• Beautiful, intuitive calendar
• Extensive customization
• Reports you can export or print
• Sync across your Apple devices
• Discreet “iP” app icon
PRIVACY YOU CAN TRUST
Your health information is your business.
• We never sell or share your private health data
• Password protection helps keep your information secure
• Secure backup and syncing options help protect your history
TRACK WHAT MATTERS TO YOU
Keep everything in one place:
• Periods and cycle history
• Fertility signs and fertile-window estimates
• Ovulation information
• Symptoms and moods
• Weight and wellness information
• Basal body temperature
• Notes and personal observations
See graphs and trends over time to better understand your own cycle patterns.
SMART REMINDERS
Create reminders for the things that matter to you, including:
• Upcoming periods
• Fertile windows
• Medications
• Breast self-exams
• Custom cycle reminders
Planning a vacation or important event? iPeriod can help you see when your next period is expected.
REPORTS & HISTORY
Create clear reports from your tracked information and export or print them when you want to review your history or bring it to an appointment.
APPLE HEALTH
Integrate supported information with Apple Health, including menstrual data, steps, calories, weight, and other wellness information.
PREMIUM
Support our small family-run business and unlock additional iPeriod features.
Since creating iPeriod in 2008, we’ve been committed to providing useful women’s health tracking tools while respecting the privacy of the people who use them. Your subscription helps us continue developing and supporting iPeriod.

bluejetty:00074024:ios.name: ReGain - Couples Therapy
bluejetty:00074024:ios.summary:
Get support for your relationship from a licensed therapist specializing in relationship therapy. Connect with a therapist on your own terms - individually or alongside your partner.
-------------------------------------------
REGAIN – FEA
bluejetty:00074024:ios.description:
Get support for your relationship from a licensed therapist specializing in relationship therapy. Connect with a therapist on your own terms - individually or alongside your partner.
-------------------------------------------
REGAIN – FEATURES
-------------------------------------------
• Get therapy on your own or with your partner
• All therapists are licensed, trained, accredited and highly experienced in providing relationship support
• Complete a short survey to be matched with a therapist who best fits your needs
• Unlimited private communication with your therapist
• Schedule live sessions with your therapist or use the secure messenger
PROFESSIONAL HELP, PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Relationship problems can be painful and challenging. Support and guidance from a professional therapist has been shown to make big, positive changes. We created Regain so anyone can have convenient, discreet, and affordable access to professional help.
Common relationship problems people seek help for are difficulty communicating, high levels of conflict, disagreement over finances, children, or in-laws, and problems with infidelity, to name just a few.
LICENSED AND TRAINED THERAPISTS
All therapists on Regain have at least 3 years and 1,000 hours of hands-on experience. They are licensed, trained, experienced and accredited psychologists (PhD/PsyD), marriage and family therapists (MFT), clinical social workers (LCSW), licensed professional counselors (LPC), or similar credentials.
All of our therapists have a Master’s Degree or a Doctorate Degree in their respective fields. They have been qualified and certified by their state professional board and have completed the necessary education, exams, training and practice.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
After filling out our questionnaire, you will be matched with a licensed therapist based on your needs and preferences. You and your therapist will get your own secure and private “therapy room” where you can message your therapist at any time, from any internet-connected device, wherever you are. Your partner will be invited to this room as well if you decide to try therapy together. You can also schedule a session so speak live with your therapist over video or phone.
You can write or talk about yourself, the things going on in your life, ask questions and discuss the challenges you’re facing and your therapist will provide feedback, insights and guidance. This ongoing dialogue is the foundation of your work with your therapist.
If you choose to try therapy on ReGain with your partner (either at the start of therapy, or if you choose to invite them later), your dialogue would be between all three of you: you, your partner, and your therapist. Together you will work towards making a positive change in your relationship and accomplishing your goals.
HOW MUCH DOES IT COST?

bluejetty:00070854:ios.name: Unicorn Games for Kids FULL
bluejetty:00070854:ios.summary:
Full Version *no additional purchases required*
Unicorns are magical and mythical creatures that have captured the hearts of little girls and boys everywhere, and if your little one loves unicorns they will adore the Unicorn Games for Kids
bluejetty:00070854:ios.description:
Full Version *no additional purchases required*
Unicorns are magical and mythical creatures that have captured the hearts of little girls and boys everywhere, and if your little one loves unicorns they will adore the Unicorn Games for Kids app! With a unicorn running game, spot the difference games, tap sounds, flashcards, and a count with unicorns book your little ones will delve into their magical filled world and have a blast playing and learning with unicorns! This fun and imagination evoking app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play, and features original sweet unicorn artwork, including flying unicorns.
Unicorn Magic Games
Run straight into excitement with the unicorn magic games! With four different magical worlds including princess, clouds, fairyland, and under the sea your little ones will have a blast jumping to collect different fun objects. The trick is to learn to jump at the right times so you don’t fall off the path, so as well as entertaining this game will also teach hand eye coordination and cognitive skills. 
Tap Sounds and Flashcards
Little fingers love to tap, tap, tap, and the tap sounds are super fun and exciting because they get to tap and reveal a hidden unicorn! The first screen will appear with just one object, like a sea shell, heart, or diamond and every time you tap it another cute item will appear that goes along with the cute theme. Each object that appears is interactive fun because when they tap the objects, such as a dolphin in the under the sea tap sound, they will hear the sound it makes and see that object change color. And then when the hidden unicorn pops out the page turns into an interactive flashcard, with the words appearing beside everything that appeared, and when you tap it now it will say the what it is. It’s a creative and fun way to learn through play and teach letter and word recognition!
Unicorn Spot the Difference Games
The unicorn spot the difference games are very entertaining and cute! They match the themes of the tap sounds and each theme has over six games. Your little ones will have to look really closely to see one difference for every game, some harder to find then others. And when they find the right one and tap it a magical circle will appear around it and they go to the next game. Similar to hidden pictures this interactive game will keep your little ones guessing and having fun!
Count With Unicorns Book
Your little one will adore counting with unicorns and learning their numbers with this fun and interactive book! Featuring all the unicorns in the app they will be counting to twenty, and the fun part is hearing the number and then counting the unicorns on each page. Learning through play is easy with Count With Unicorns and you’ll love the rewarding feeling little ones get when they are really counting!
Fly into unicorn fun with the Unicorn Games for Kids app and explore creativity, imagination, and learning with magical unicorns. With regular updates this app will grow with your child and keep them happy playing and learning with unicorns!

bluejetty:00062506:ios.description:
AI is getting smarter. What about you?
AI can answer almost anything, but the decisions that matter are still made in your own head, with what you actually remember. NeuraCache is a learning system for the AI era: it turns what you read, watch and study into flashcards, then uses spaced repetition to bring each one back right before you'd forget it. Your first brain, kept sharp.
FLASHCARDS FROM THE NOTES YOU ALREADY WRITE
Connect the tools you use and your notes become flashcards automatically:
 • Notion
 • Kindle
 • Obsidian
 • Markdown
 • Evernote
 • Logseq
 • Bear
 • CSV
 • Roam Research
 • and many more via markdown (e.g. Craft)
No note app? Create flashcards right inside NeuraCache.
USE AI TO LEARN, KEEP THE KNOWLEDGE YOURSELF
Ask AI about any card to have it explained simply, checked for mistakes or taken deeper. Rewrite or polish a card, or photograph a page and get flashcards from it. Then the knowledge goes where it belongs: into your memory, with spaced repetition doing the scheduling.
WHY SPACED REPETITION WORKS
Ever finish a book or a course only to forget the details weeks later? Spaced repetition works with your brain's natural memory systems, so what you learn actually sticks. NeuraCache pairs it with active recall, the two most proven learning techniques there are, and handles the scheduling for you.
FOCUS ON WHAT MATTERS NOW
Studying for an exam or getting ready for a trip? Pick its decks as a focus, and Home and Today's Queue follow them, with the rest of your library one row below. (Premium)
TURN KINDLE HIGHLIGHTS INTO FLASHCARDS
Sync your Amazon Kindle highlights and every book becomes a flashcard deck, with covers, authors and your margin notes. Pick individual books or your whole library, and re-sync anytime to pull in new highlights. With Premium, each highlight can appear as a quote card colored by its book's cover. Syncing runs through a Safari extension that can only read your Kindle notebook page: your Amazon password never touches NeuraCache, and your highlights stay on your device.
SEE YOUR MEMORY
Home shows your memory now, how it moved since yesterday and where it's heading, the cards due over the next seven days, and Today's Queue in one panel. Every card has a forgetting curve, and the Review Calendar shows your month a bar a day. (Curve and Review Calendar: Premium.) Home Screen widgets keep your next cards one glance away.
FLASHCARDS ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
NeuraCache is built for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with your cards kept in sync through iCloud. Review on the go, study at your desk: your decks are always up to date.
YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS
No sign-up required: install and start learning. Your notes stay on your device and sync only through your own private iCloud. AI features send a card's text to the AI service only when you use them.
—————
Try NeuraCache Pro Free for 7 Days
The annual plan comes with a 7-day free trial. If you decide to subscribe, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and auto-renewal will occur 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel auto-renewal through your App Store settings at any time.
Privacy Policy: https://neuracache.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://neuracache.com/tos
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00123212:ios.description:
The top-rated tax app for employees, trainees, students and pensioners. Get your taxes done with Steuerbot (Welfenstraße 19, 70736 Fellbach) - your personal tax app!
Get an average tax refund of €1,172. Complete your tax return in 20 minutes for 2025, 2024, 2023 and 2022 with simple questions in Steuerbot Chat and submit it via ELSTER.
// What does Steuerbot cost?
Until the submission, Steuerbot is completely free for you. So you can enter your tax return without any risk and then decide for yourself, based on the calculated refund, whether the tax return is worth it for you. 
The cost of filing a tax return is €39.99.
// Chat
Answer understandable questions in the app, without any tax knowledge needed. Many tips and simple help texts support you with your tax return in the app or on the web.
// Quick and easy
With Steuerbot you can do your taxes in minutes. On average, our users only need about 20 minutes for the complete tax return.
// Live calculation
As you answer questions about your tax return, Steuerbot will constantly update your refund based on your answers. At the top of the chat, you will always see your current refund.
// Refund
In a few weeks you will receive your tax assessment notice. The average refund is €1,172.
Supported tax years
---
- Tax return 2025
- Tax return 2024
- Tax return 2023
- Tax return 2022
- Tax return 2021
- Tax return 2020
- Tax return 2019
- Tax return 2018
- Tax return 2017
- Tax return 2016
- Tax return 2015
Data security
---
Your data is safe. We strictly adhere to the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We use the data of our users only encrypted and only to improve Steuerbot constantly!
All your data is securely transferred to the tax office via the official ELSTER interface. Our servers are located exclusively in Germany. There all tax data of our users is stored encrypted.
What happens to your tax return data after ELSTER submission? We are legally obliged to keep the data of the submitted tax returns for at least 5 years.
NOT supported tax cases
---
- Income from self-employment or freelance work
- Foreign wage income
- Agriculture or forestry
- Maintenance payments
- Other income (e.g. parliamentary allowances)
Give us feedback!
---
We are looking forward to your feedback and appreciate any positive feedback :) Convince yourself and get your taxes done in a few minutes!

---

◆ Twitter: https://www.twitter.com/steuerbot
◆ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/steuerbot
◆ LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/steuerbot

bluejetty:00160626:ios.summary:
