bluejetty:00160626:ios.description:
Scrub In Without Screwing Up the CST Exam
So, you’ve chosen a career where you pass sharp objects to over-caffeinated surgeons, keep the sterile field from becoming a biohazard, and make sure no one leaves a clamp inside the patient. Good choice. Now it’s time to conquer the CST exam.
That means diving into anatomy, memorizing more surgical instruments than a med student on caffeine pills, and mastering sterile technique like your certification depends on it, because it does. Fortunately, you don’t need to suffer through dusty textbooks or forums run by someone’s cousin who “totally passed last year.”
EZ Prep’s Certified Surgical Technologist (CST) Study App is the fastest, smartest, and least soul-crushing way to prep for the NBSTSA® exam. Built for future techs who are already knee-deep in the OR grind, our app gives you everything you need to pass, without the fluff, filler, or fear.
Whether you're at clinicals, hiding in the locker room, or mentally recovering from a 6-hour orthopedic case, you can study on the go with expertly written questions, straight-to-the-point explanations, and a platform that still works even when the OR lounge Wi-Fi gives out.
Built by actual CSTs and surgical educators (not bots or bored anatomy majors), all content follows the 2026 NBSTSA® guidelines, so you’re reviewing what actually matters, not just guessing what surgical pharmacology might mean under pressure.
__ Exam Topics Covered Inside:
Preoperative Preparation – From gowning and gloving to avoiding an infection control disaster
Intraoperative Procedures – The art of passing instruments and keeping your cool in the splash zone
Postoperative Procedures – Cleaning up without screwing up
Administrative & Personnel – Chain of command, ethics, and not getting fired
Equipment Sterilization & Maintenance – Because a rusty scalpel is never the right choice
Anatomy & Physiology – Know your organs, or get called out by a very loud surgeon
Principles of Microbiology – Bacteria: tiny, terrifying, and on the test
Surgical Pharmacology & Anesthesia – What goes in, what knocks them out, and what you better not mess up
__ App Features That Won’t Break Sterile Field:
• Adaptive Difficulty – If you're crushing it, we make it harder. If you're struggling, we dial it back
• Full-Length Practice Exams – Just like the real deal, minus the sterile gloves and existential dread
• Progress Tracking & Study Goals – See your score climb faster than a surgeon’s blood pressure when the cautery fails
• Instant Feedback – No guessing, no delays, just clear explanations you’ll actually remember
___ Our 100% Pass Guarantee
We’re so confident in the quality of our material that we offer a PASS GUARANTEE: a 100% money-back guarantee if you don’t pass your exam. Plus, we’ll give you free access to the app until you do. (See our terms and conditions for the fine print.)
Ready to ace your CST exam and stop second-guessing your clamp technique?
Visit the official site: NBSTSA CST Certification
Then download EZ Prep and study smarter, not harder.
Terms of Use: https://www.eztestprep.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.eztestprep.com/privacy-policy
Support: support@eztestprep.com
EZ Prep is not affiliated with the NBSTSA®, but we fully support their mission to make sure nothing is left behind. Especially your test score.

bluejetty:00180605:ios.description:
Add NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college sports, TV schedules, school calendars, and US holidays directly to your existing calendar and never update them manually again.
Calendar apps only show the events you create. But your life is shaped by hundreds of real-world events you can’t control: game times, federal holidays, school breaks, concert dates, weather alerts, TV broadcasts, and more.
We keep all of these events up to date in your calendar automatically. Add a topic once. We handle everything — new events, schedule changes, postponements, and updates.
Our calendar data also powers top calendar apps like Fantastical and Calendars by Readdle. If you happen to use one of those, you’re already covered. If not, then this app keeps your sports, holidays & events updated automatically.
This app contains the following calendars to which you can subscribe:
► HOLIDAYS WORLDWIDE
Holidays calendars for 250 countries and 360 regions. A must have at home and indispensable when travelling. Never miss a foreign festival or banks closed day again.
► SPORTS SCHEDULES
We cover more than 31 sports and 600+ competitions, including real-time results, scorers, lineups, substitutions, referee, tables (if and when available). This way you’re always up to date on your favourite sports (team).
Available sports/competitions:
- Football/Soccer: MLS, NASL, NWSL, Premier League, Primera Division, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, etc
- F1, Nascar, Indy, DTM, etc
- MotoG
- American Football: NFL, NCAAF, CFL, etc
- Basketball: NBA, NCAAB, etc
- Hockey: NHL, AHL, etc
- Cricket
- Curling
- Cycling
- Rugby
- Tennis
- Volleybal
- And more
► TV SHOWS
Never forget an episode again. TV listings, including show details like episode descriptions, cast lists and premiers/reruns are automatically added to your calendar 14 days ahead.
► 14-DAY WEATHER FORECASTS
Weather forecasts always 14 days ahead available for 150.000 cities, including details like temperature, wind speed, precipitation, sunset/sunrise and uv index. 
► COMPANY EVENTS
Financial calendars available for 28 indices and 2000 companies. Calendars include GSMs, publications, results and details like company information, presentations and webcasts.
► LIFESTYLE
Moon Phases, Name Days and Week Numbers.
Do you have any questions or comments? You can send us a message from within the app, send an email to support@schedjoules.com or tweet us @SchedJoules. We’re here to help.
----------------------------------------------------
► Access to all available calendars for 1 year
With a yearly subscription you get full and ongoing access to all available calendars including (live) updates in your calendar. A subscription always starts with a one-month free trial, so you can try before you buy. 1 year subscriptions for SchedJoules costs $4.99. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and after the 1 month free trial. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current 1 year period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.
Find the full terms and conditions, and our privacy policy, at http://www.schedjoules.com/app-terms-of-service/ and http://www.schedjoules.com/privacy-policy/ respectively.

bluejetty:00106429:android.summary: Kogama is an online universe that lets you play, create and share games alone or together with friends. Dive into racing, pvp action, or simply join a hang-out game to kick back with friends. Feeling creative? Invite your friends to start c
bluejetty:00106429:android.description:
Kogama is an online universe that lets you play, create and share games alone or together with friends. Dive into racing, pvp action, or simply join a hang-out game to kick back with friends. Feeling creative? Invite your friends to start creating the next big game hit!
Already have an account? Log in with your existing Kogama account and play for free!
MILLIONS OF FREE GAMES
Explore millions of games created by users like yourself. Each game presents new challenges, goals and experiences! Play anything from action racing to laid back exploration games!
CRAFT YOUR LOOKS
Super hero, angel or zombie broccoli? Build any avatar you want or browse a vast marketplace of avatars created by other users. There's even new accessories every day to spice up your creations!
NEW GAMES EVERY DAY
Our users work together to create new games every single day. From Kogama classics to the latest and greatest, there's always something new to check out! Maybe your game is the next to attract thousands of players?
FREE TO PLAY
Kogama is absolutely free to play, but players can also purchase Gold to spend on avatars and accessories. Gold is also available completely for free, simply by playing the game.
We are always working on improving Kogama. Got any questions or feedback? Don't hesitate to get in touch!
Thank you for playing!
NOTE: Avatar/game creation requires a mouse and is currently only available in the desktop version of Kogama.
SUPPORT
https://www.kogama.com/help/
PRIVACY POLICY
https://www.kogama.com/help/privacy-policy/
TERMS OF USE
https://www.kogama.com/help/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00116575:ios.description:

Cloud Backup & Restore (Coming Soon) – Securely back up and restore your financial data to Google Drive, ensuring your information is always safe.

Account Management – Create and manage multiple accounts with detailed information. Import accounts from your contacts for quick setup.
Search & Filtering – Quickly find specific accounts or transactions.
Transaction Management – Add transactions directly from the ledger for a streamlined workflow.
Contact Book Integration – Import account details from your contacts.
Multiple Access – Access The Cash Book from your computer or laptop.
Security – Password-protected access keeps your financial data secure. A password reset option is available via WhatsApp.
Multiple Languages – Available in Arabic, Catalan, Dutch, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Korean, Russian, and Thai.
Shareable Ledgers – Share complete ledger entries when needed.
Local Backup – Use the built-in backup manager for local backups.
Shortcut Icons – Quickly access transactions and accounts.
Call Functionality – Call account parties directly from the app.
Free to Use – Download and use The Cash Book completely free.

Improved backup and restore functionality with a dedicated backup manager.
Added support for multiple languages.
Enhanced user interface for better navigation.

bluejetty:00090673:ios.name: DWARFLAB
bluejetty:00090673:ios.summary:
DWARFLAB smart telescope, empowered by advanced technology, opens up a world of diverse perspectives for users, capturing the wonders of life. No guidance or experience needed, it's ready to use out of the box.
Wireless Connection
Use the
bluejetty:00090673:ios.description:
DWARFLAB smart telescope, empowered by advanced technology, opens up a world of diverse perspectives for users, capturing the wonders of life. No guidance or experience needed, it's ready to use out of the box.
Wireless Connection
Use the App to connect wirelessly with DWARFLAB smart telescope, enabling not only precise control but also making the shooting process more flexible and efficient.
Astrophotography
The App features an in-built star atlas, allowing you to simply tap on the celestial you desire to proceed with automatic star tracking and enjoy real-time image stacking. You can also adjust the astro curves and personalize the color grading to create your own 4K astronomical images.
In-App Post Processing
Capture, select, stack, and enhance — all in one seamless workflow for astrophotography. Supports both onboard stacking and cloud-based processing, with multi-format export options to make every astro image crisp and brilliant.
Motion Tracking
You can freely select the target to track on the shooting interface, enjoying the flexibility of manual selection; or you can use the telescope's automatic recognition function, which intelligently identifies tracks, and starts recordings, easily capturing dynamic scenes such as bird predation, flights, and sports close-ups.
Gigapixel Panorama
Simply set the shooting range and tap to start — with one-click stitching, you can create extremely detailed and vast panoramic images, supporting deep zoom and experiencing an unprecedented level of detail richness.
Time-Lapse Photography
Capture the flow and changes of time, recording the hustle and bustle of traffic, the blooming and wilting of flowers. Combined with astronomical tracking functions, it can also record the trajectory of the sun, solar/lunar eclipses, and the star trails.

bluejetty:00063825:ios.description:
Step into the theater of the mind. Whether you are a long-time fan of the Golden Age of Radio or a newcomer discovering these audio treasures for the first time, our app is your time machine.
We have unlocked a massive vault containing over 710+ classic shows and a staggering 63,000+ episodes.
Why This is the Only OTR App You Need:
1. The Largest OTR Library: We don't just have a lot of shows; we have the best organization in the industry. Our library is expertly categorized into 30+ genres. From the shadows of Noir to the dust of the Wild West, find exactly what you want instantly.
2. Be a Historian (Exclusive Feature): Go beyond the audio. We are the only app that provides rich historical context for over 60,000 episodes. Read quick one-liner teasers or dive into detailed, two-paragraph summaries covering plot points and character arcs. Immerse yourself in the story before you even press play.
3. Blazing-Fast Performance: Don't wait for the curtain to rise. Our advanced content delivery network ensures lightning-fast streaming. Even lengthy 20-minute episodes load in the blink of an eye (2-3 seconds), ensuring your immersion is never broken.

bluejetty:00153274:ios.name: Avocado: AI Ally & Wellbeing
bluejetty:00153274:ios.summary:
Take control of your emotional wellbeing with Avocado – your 3D AI Companion for self-awareness and balance.
Avocado is an AI-powered wellness app featuring Avo, your interactive 3D emotional companion that listens, reflects, and helps you
bluejetty:00153274:ios.description:
Take control of your emotional wellbeing with Avocado – your 3D AI Companion for self-awareness and balance.
Avocado is an AI-powered wellness app featuring Avo, your interactive 3D emotional companion that listens, reflects, and helps you understand yourself better — just like a mindful friend who’s always there for you.
Talk to Avo in real time, share your thoughts out loud, and receive intelligent, empathetic responses designed to guide you through reflection, relaxation, and personal growth.
Avocado combines emotional intelligence with practical self-care tools — from mood tracking to guided breathing — to help you develop healthier habits and a more balanced mind.
Key Features
• Live 3D AI Companion
Meet Avo — a lifelike, animated 3D character that you can talk to naturally through speech. Avo listens, remembers, and responds in real time with warmth and emotional awareness. Whether you need to vent, reflect, or find focus, Avo helps you connect with your inner world in a deeply human way.
• Daily AI Support Chat
Engage in open, empathetic conversations. Avo provides reflective prompts, grounding techniques, and emotional insights based on your tone, mood, and needs — available anytime, anywhere.
• Emotion Tracker & Insights
Log and visualize your emotions over time. Discover patterns, triggers, and progress as Avo helps you reflect on what shapes your emotional landscape.
• Relaxation & Focus Tools
Practice guided breathing, mindfulness, and calming soundscapes to reset your energy and improve focus. Avo can suggest the right exercise depending on your state of mind.
• Personalization & Memory
Avo grows with you — remembering your moods, habits, and previous reflections to provide more meaningful interactions and continuity over time.
• Private & Secure
Your emotions stay yours. All data is encrypted, ensuring a safe, confidential environment for your self-discovery.
Why Avocado is different
Unlike other mental wellness apps, Avocado makes emotional care visual, interactive, and human-like.
Instead of typing into a chatbot, you can see, hear, and feel your AI companion respond — making reflection and self-awareness an immersive, empathetic experience that fits seamlessly into your daily life.
Avocado is your safe space to talk, reflect, and grow.
With the help of your 3D companion Avo, you can practice mindfulness, strengthen emotional intelligence, and build lasting habits for a calmer, more centered life.
Disclaimer:
Avocado is designed for emotional wellness, mindfulness, and self-improvement. It is not a medical or therapeutic service. If you’re experiencing serious emotional distress, please reach out to a licensed professional.

bluejetty:00162889:ios.name: White Noise: Sleep Sounds
bluejetty:00162889:ios.summary: White Noise is an application designed to calm crying young children. Many of us have already discovered this magical way of calming children by turning on a vacuum cleaner or hairdryer. Your baby spent 9 months in the womb hearing similar
bluejetty:00162889:ios.description:
White Noise is an application designed to calm crying young children. Many of us have already discovered this magical way of calming children by turning on a vacuum cleaner or hairdryer. Your baby spent 9 months in the womb hearing similar noise. Therefore, the hairdryer sounds and vacuum cleaner sounds helps the child calm down and feel safe. However, you don't have to carry a hairdryer or vacuum cleaner everywhere. All you have to do is download our White Noise machine which generates the noise you selected for a specified time and gently fade out at the end. This application works similar to the the popular toy white noise generator called "Whisbear", with the difference that you can choose from a wide variety of sounds and noises that will help calm your child.
The white noise generator is not only intended for children but also helps you sleep better. If you have trouble falling asleep, you can turn on the selected noise, set the timer and the played white noise will put your mind in a state of deep relaxation. Even when you are tired, your brain may have problems calming down and relaxing. White noise is often used to treat insomnia, as well as for concentration, learning or studing problems.
Application benefits:
- It helps to relax, calm down and feel safe
- Very easy to use. Just one click to start the selected noise
- 12 different relaxing sounds with white noise
- A timer system that gradually reduces noise at the end (Fadeout)
- Reduces stress and tension by using relaxing sounds
- Baby sleep without problems
- Background play
- Pure white noise machine generator
Sounds you will find in the White Noise application:
- Pure white noise sounds
- Sleep sounds
- Hairdryer noise
- Whisbear
- Waterfall
- Fan
- Air conditioner
- Vacuum cleaner
- Car driving
- Engine sounds
- Blowing wind
- Train ride
- Washing machine 
- Sea waves
- Mountain river 
- Night nature sounds
- Rain and Thunderstorm
- Birds and Chimes
In the application preferences, you can customize many settings to your needs, such as: default noise duration, fade out time, adding additional minutes with one click and many more.
Don't wait any longer. If your child wakes up in the middle of the night crying or has trouble with sleeping, download and try the White Noise generator applications. You and your child will sleep without any problems.

Maze Defenders is a fantasy tower defense like the classics. Craft advanced mazes for the enemies to travel, deploy your arsenal of over 17 Towers and cast mighty spells with your Builder.
During the each game, enemies will try to break your defences, your task is to defend the kingdom at all cost. Upgrade your towers with talent-trees, craft powerful runes and combine tower effects for the best firepower!
The most powerful tool is mazing, create long mazes for your enemies to travel. Utilise the best strategy in this tower clash and defend the kingdom from the raging tower wars!
Maze Defenders - Main Features
- Free Tower-placement, create your own maze!
- 20+ unique Towers to deploy.
- 3D fantasy world. 
- Craft specialised runes that allows you to build powerful builds for your Towers.
- Builder your tower-defence! Epic tower defense madness awaits.
- Deploy powerful royale builders, each builder has its own powers.
- Fans of Warcraft td games will love this.
- Boss rush tower defense levels and endless td levels will challenge you
Your td skills will be put to the test on every map in this indie tower defence strategy adventure. Plan your base defence, build towers and rain down fiery spells upon orcs, undead and other evil forces.
You are the tower-defender so you need to apply the very best strategy in order for your defence to hold.
Inspired by old games of the genre, where we found or love for td games, this is a game for any true tower defense fan!
Combine mazing, tower-synergies and strategic decisions to beat the levels. In this offline td game you wont find any pre-determined tower-slots! 
Customise your towers according to your play-style: You'll have access to runes, talents and different builders that all affect how your towers perform.
Compete on Ranked maps where your td skills will be compared to other td players, big rewards are given to the best players in this royale game! 
This offline game is for any td fan - Epic battles and madness awaits in this 3D fantasy world.
Your journey in this TD will take you into multiple fantasy worlds in your quest to free the kingdom of the invaders!
See what your td skills are worth in this 3D RPG strategy game.
Play offline! NO internet connection needed.
Developed by Johan

bluejetty:00084325:ios.description:
Experience holistic well-being with just one app.
Discover our comprehensive range of services tailored to your individual fitness and wellness goals. From HIIT, strength training to yoga, Pilates, meditation and much more. Choose from over 1500 workouts and 60 different fitness and well-being programs.
TRAIN WHENEVER AND WHEREVER YOU WANT
Gymondo makes it easy for you to integrate training into your everyday life. The platform is intuitive and clearly laid out, so you can get started without any detours. Each workout is available on-demand and allows you to train at your own pace.
MOTIVATING COACHES
With our certified coaches, physiotherapists, and fitness stars like Team Harrison, Lola Weippert, and Sarah Engels, every workout becomes an experience that strengthens and inspires you!
INSPIRING COMMUNITY
Join an inspiring community, share your progress, and receive support from like-minded individuals who are pursuing similar goals.
HEALTHY AND DELICIOUS RECIPES
At Gymondo, we understand that fitness and achieving fitness goals involve more than just training. Let our healthy recipes and practical tips inspire you, as they can be easily integrated into your daily routine and sustainably enhance your well-being.
TAKE YOUR TRAINING TO THE NEXT LEVEL WITH GYMONDO PLUS!
Gymondo Plus is the new membership from Gymondo that offers additional content and features to enhance your fitness experience.
Look forward to new workouts, innovative programs, and exciting challenges that will keep you motivated and bring variety to your routine. 
PERSONALIZED TRAINING
Whether you want to make faster progress or change your focus, Gymondo Plus continuously adjusts to your needs so you achieve the best results. Imagine having a personal trainer, nutrition advisor, and motivator all in one — that's exactly what Gymondo Plus offers you.
GYMONDO PLUS PODCAST
In the Gymondo Plus podcast you will learn the latest training methods, practical nutrition tips and inspiring mindset strategies for maximum success. 
NEW CATEGORIES
Our new categories Meditation, Prevention and Women's Health support you on your way to more balance, health and quality of life. Discover specific programs dedicated to the special needs of women in different stages of life. From pregnancy, post-partum, menopause to cycle-oriented training, we combine effective training with valuable tips on emotional well-being for your perfect balance.
AI-FOOD SCANNER
With our AI-powered food scanner, you can scan your groceries in no time, adjust them, and find out how they perfectly fit into your nutrition plan. Additionally, Gymondo Plus also offers a variety of new recipe and cooking videos as well as step-by-step instructions to prepare delicious, goal-oriented meals — making healthy eating simple and delicious.

To deactivate the automatic renewal, visit the settings of your Apple account. Unused portions of the free trial period will be forfeited once a paid membership is activated.

bluejetty:00015391:ios.name: Learn Spelling 3rd Grade
bluejetty:00015391:ios.summary: Congratulations! You're about to give your kids everything they need to master 3rd grade spelling skills, all on their own. By combing the world's first AI-teachers, short lessons, and adaptive practice, children can now catch up and get ah
bluejetty:00015391:ios.description:
Congratulations! You're about to give your kids everything they need to master 3rd grade spelling skills, all on their own. By combing the world's first AI-teachers, short lessons, and adaptive practice, children can now catch up and get ahead, all on their own. Start a 7 day free trial to see first hand how much your kids can learn, risk free. We recommend asking your children to complete 5 lessons a day. A little practice every day is the best. Feel free to pursue your passions and dreams (or nap) while students learn. 
Our spelling-bee-style adaptive practice has a "secret sauce" learning algorithm, based on the 'spaced repetition learning theory'. It helps knowledge truly stick.
Why learn spelling? Developing spelling skills is a highly effective way of improving a child's reading and writing abilities. 
Bonus: When you start a membership for this app, you unlock all 10+ apps by Class Ace covering 2,500+ skills, and 20+ innovative AI tools. There's no better investment. 
Features:
• 70+ simple read-assist lessons
• Effective, adaptive practice. Each student sees a different set of questions that get harder over time. When they make mistakes, the questions change in real-time to maximize learning and minimize frustration, following the ‘spaced repetition’ learning theory.
• Text to speech. Tap on any word to have it read out loud. 
• Auto-play. Sit back and enjoy the whole lesson read to you.
• Separate student profiles.
• Teacher View: Look at charts of useful metrics. See where students are struggling, and jump in to help. 
• Gamification. Incredible landscapes, progress bars, and uplifting interfaces motivate students to do their best.
Watch your child's grades improve with just a few minutes of regular practice.
Learn Spelling was developed by a team of veteran teachers, technologists, and student testers. The app is designed by an ex-Google Product Manager to maximize learning and retention.
=======
Learn Spelling is a member of the Class Ace family of apps. One subscription in any Class Ace app unlocks all 15+ apps, over 2,500+ lessons covering K-6 subjects, and 20+ innovative AI tools.
Subscription Info:
• Unlimited access to this and all Class Ace apps, tools, and features is $14.99 per month after a 1 week free trial and includes 5 student profiles.
• Cancel Anytime: You won't be charged if you cancel before the end of the trial period.
• Renewal: Auto-renewal may be turned off anytime from your Apple Subscription Manager.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless they are turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in account settings. Renewals are charged within 24-hours preceding the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions are managed by the user. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to Learn Spelling by Class Ace, where applicable.
You can access Learn Spelling without a subscription, but will be limited to 20 free questions per day, and your medals will be lost on leaving the app.
No parent wants to see their child fall behind. Yet over 50% of 4th graders weren't proficient in 4th grade common core standards in the US in 2017. Our own kids were struggling to keep up. We built Learn Spelling for them, and now they are excelling on their own. Your kids can too.
=======

Contact us at support@classace.io

bluejetty:00063404:ios.description:
*** PLAY FRENCH TAROT ON YOUR IPHONE, IPOD AND IPAD ! ***
Play the popular French Tarot card game, against opponents simulated by an high-level artificial intelligence or with your friends.
All official rules are handled :
- Play at 3, 4 or 5 players.
- Declare Handful.
- Declare Misere.
- Lead one trump to the last trick.
- Announce a slam.
*** SEVERAL GAME MODES INCLUDING MULTIPLAYER *** 
- Play alone against AI players. 
- Play Online through Game Center : Invite your friends, or let the Game Center find players for you. 
- Play on LAN with your friends, via WiFi or Bluetooth. 
- Play with a friend on the same device, each in turn. 
*** HD GRAPHICS *** 
Easy to use, the game is very fast and responsive, with card animation for a more realistic gameplay, and hd graphics.
Two visual themes available. 
*** AN HIGH-LEVEL ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE ***
Your opponents and teamates are simulated by an high-level artificial intelligence, that knows the common strategies used in tarot card game. Therefore the game is very realistic, close to game with real players, and the challenge is high.
*** A CUSTOMIZABLE APPLICATION ***
- Play counter-clockwise or clockwise
- Play with or without misere.
- Play with or without Small contract.
- Change the player's name.
- Change the speed of the game
- Visual theme.
- And many more...
*** AN APPLICATION THAT WILL MAKE YOU BECOME BETTER ***
A section with statistics is included in the application, allowing you to monitor the evolution of our performances. And you can distinguish yourself thanks to Game Center Achievements and Leaderboards. 
For beginners, rules of French Tarot are also included into the application.
Finally, you can at the end of the round see all the tricks, and replay the round if we want, to train and try new strategies.
For any question regarding the application : support.tarot@eryodsoft.com
Have fun playing Tarot !

bluejetty:00099122:ios.description:
Ever wondered how beautiful you could be when you're older? Curious about what you might look like at 50? Or perhaps you're up for a little friendly prank to see your friend's appearance in 40 years? Let's dive into the exciting world of FutureFace and discover your Future Face Machine! 
Getting started with Future Face Machine is a breeze! Simply snap a photo with your phone or choose one from your album. In just a few seconds, you'll unveil your Future Face Machine, and the results can be quite surprising and delightful. 
Want to take a trip down memory lane and see yourself 20 years ago? Or perhaps you're curious about your lover's youthful appearance? Future Face Machine has you covered!
Craving an anime-style portrait? Let Future Face Machine work its magic and automatically generate captivating cartoon or vector-style portraits.
You can save your transformed pictures with just one click or easily share them with your friends for loads of fun and laughter! It's an entertaining way to explore the possibilities of the future.
Aging Booth - Peek into the Future! 
Have you ever been curious about your future appearance? What about your friends and family? With Future Face Machine, you can take a glimpse into the future using our aging booth and witness the magic of aging!
Time Machine - The Aging Filter 
Starting with Future Face Machine is a breeze. Simply take a photo or pick one from your gallery, adjust the markers on your picture for the most accurate results, and then click once more to see your aged self! You can even share your results instantly with friends and family in any way you prefer. Plus, you can apply some hilarious face filters for added fun!

bluejetty:00090505:ios.description:
About Alula
At Alula, we believe that the best security solution is provided by the professional security dealer. And we know that today’s security customer expects more than just basic security. In order to deliver the best experience for the needs of today’s modern security customer, you need to design and develop the hardware, software, and services for a complete, end-to-end professional security system for the professional security dealer.
The thoughtful technology in our products are designed to keep up with a changing world. Intuitive. Reliable. Innovative. Simplifying your business while saving you money. It’s what you deserve and what people expect. And we’re only scratching the surface of possibilities. Keeping people and property safe is your business. At Alula, creating the tools and support you need to do that, is in our DNA.
It’s your home, you set the rules.
The Alula App gives you what you deserve, reliability and control. Set rules for real-time notifications. Know instantly when doors and windows are opened or when motion is detected.
Technology at your pace
With event based “Scenes” and “Recipes”, your smart devices can support your way of life. Adjust the entire atmosphere in your home based on your day to day routines. Lights, cameras, garage doors and thermostats can adjust to great you in the morning or when you arrive back home in the evenings.
Alula Home Security Zone Configurations
Alula uses zones in coordination with armed modes and zone configurations to determine how your security system responds when a sensor or detector is triggered. Customize your own zone configurations.
Cloud Video Services
Alula Cloud is an easy-to-use and affordable cloud video solution designed for businesses and homeowners. Now your customers can keep an eye on their home or business with the comfort of knowing their video is securely stored and can be retrieved from anywhere.
- Cost Effective: Why purchase expensive hardware storage, especially if there are multiple sites that need surveillance. Easily manage all camera from one platform.
- Easy to Use: Built for users who do not want to bother with complicated and expensive systems, with simple setup for dealers.
- Flexible Camera Support: Alula Cloud video works with the largest number of leading IP Cameras. Select the right camera for each customer.

bluejetty:00035194:ios.name: Turnip Boy Robs a Bank
bluejetty:00035194:ios.summary: Turnip Boy is ready to commit more felonies in this comedic action-adventure game with roguelite elements. This time the career criminal is teaming up with the fearsome Pickled Gang to plan and execute the weirdest heist of all time! Shake
bluejetty:00035194:ios.description:
Turnip Boy is ready to commit more felonies in this comedic action-adventure game with roguelite elements. This time the career criminal is teaming up with the fearsome Pickled Gang to plan and execute the weirdest heist of all time! Shake down hostages, steal precious valuables, and explore the deep, dark depths and history of the Botanical Bank. 
To pull off the perfect heist, you’ll need to purchase an array of dangerous and wacky tools from the dark web, including a diamond pickaxe, C4, and a radio jammer. However, bank robbing isn’t easy, so be prepared for intense shootouts with security guards, the police, elite swat teams and more. 
Features: 
* A thrilling single-player adventure full of bank robbing, dark web browsing, and fuzz fighting.
* Roguelite elements to turnip the action.
* A big ol’ bank to explore and loot.
* An array of wacky weapons found in the bank.
* Take on whoever the bank throws at you in intense shootouts, from security guards to elite veggie swat teams!
* A large cast of quirky food-based characters, including some familiar faces and new citizens with their own stories and problems.
* Earn collectable hats to wear & cassettes with new banger tracks to blast.
* Discover a deeper history of Turnip Boy’s world and how it became what it is.
* Play in 4:3 like the original game, or in fullscreen!
Turnip Boy adventures are fun, so to make sure everyone can enjoy the game, you can change some settings in the game including:
- 4 different enemy outline colors
- 4 different interact outline colors
- A god mode so Turnip Boy becomes invincible!
- Damage boost up to 200% or a damage nerf to 50% if you dare!
- An aim laser to help you in fights
- Autoaim to help you aim on touchscreens!

This time the career criminal is teaming up with the fearsome Pickled Gang to plan and execute the weirdest heist of all time! Shake down hostages, steal precious valuables, and explore the deep, dark depths and history of the Botanical Bank. 
To pull off the perfect heist, you’ll need to purchase an array of dangerous and wacky tools from the dark web, including a diamond pickaxe, C4, and a radio jammer. However, bank robbing isn’t easy, so be prepared for intense shootouts with security guards, the police, elite swat teams and more. 

Features: 
* A thrilling single-player adventure full of bank robbing, dark web browsing, and fuzz fighting.
* Roguelite elements to turnip the action.
* A big ol’ bank to explore and loot.
* An array of wacky weapons found in the bank.
* Take on whoever the bank throws at you in intense shootouts, from security guards to elite veggie swat teams!
* A large cast of quirky food-based characters, including some familiar faces and new citizens with their own stories and problems.
* Earn collectable hats to wear & cassettes with new banger tracks to blast.
* Discover a deeper history of Turnip Boy’s world and how it became what it is.
* Play in 4:3 like the original game, or in fullscreen!

Turnip Boy adventures are fun, so to make sure everyone can enjoy the game, you can change some settings in the game including:
- 4 different enemy outline colors
- 4 different interact outline colors
- A god mode so Turnip Boy becomes invincible!
- Damage boost up to 200% or a damage nerf to 50% if you dare!
- An aim laser to help you in fights
- Autoaim to help you aim on touchscreens!

bluejetty:00160665:ios.name: Game Master's Toolkit 5e
bluejetty:00160665:ios.summary:
Game Master’s Toolkit 5e allows GMs to generate random content for their tabletop roleplaying games! Designed for the world's most popular roleplaying game, but highly compatible with other fantasy TTRPG systems. 
Using this app, you can:
bluejetty:00160665:ios.description:
Game Master’s Toolkit 5e allows GMs to generate random content for their tabletop roleplaying games! Designed for the world's most popular roleplaying game, but highly compatible with other fantasy TTRPG systems. 
Using this app, you can:
– Browse over 2,000 monsters and filter by CR, terrain, creature type, and source book.
– Create NPCs and cities to bring your world to life.
– Generate random events, quests, treasure, and villains to add danger and adventure to your game. 
– Challenge your players with fully fleshed-out dungeons, and traps.
– Generate random magic items, such as weapons, armor, potions, and scrolls.
– Use the Quick Generator to create names, taverns, shops, rumors, and more! 
– Save all your favorite randomly generated content for later use. 
All with the click of a button! 
Game Master’s Toolkit 5e also includes a number of other tools to help you run your game. 
– Use the Party Cheat Sheet to track your players’ damage and other important stats. Add monsters to your initiative tracker for easy combat prep.
– Incorporate puzzles and mini games to challenge and entertain your players.
– Includes a simple dice simulator for easy rolling.
– Browse through common 5e rules such as conditions and concentration.
Upgrade to the premium version for even more control over the items you generate! With the full version, you can: 
– Sort saved items into different campaigns
– Edit and add notes to your saved items.
– Edit and add notes to items as you generate them.
– Add, remove, edit, and rearrange city elements to make it truly your own. 
– Add your own homebrew puzzles and mini games for later reference.
– Export items to Google Drive, Dropbox, email, notes, iMessage, Discord, social media, and any other apps you have on your phone. 
This app also includes a built–in library of over 100 sounds and songs for you to incorporate into your game. Browse different song categories including Combat, In a Dungeon, In the City, and more! The music plays in the background, allowing you to use other apps or lock your screen without interrupting the song. Create a list of your favorite songs for easy reference.
All completely offline! No ads, no signups, no hassle. Simple and easy to use.

bluejetty:00128155:ios.description:
The development of technologies like steam engine, railway, ships have filled the world with new opportunities.
Unsatisfied with the colonial arrangements of the Old World, the rising empires are gearing up to compete. Inevitably, war becomes the outcome of conflicting interests.
The whole world did not expect the war to grow to such a large scale.
Could military geniuses such as Hindenburg, Ludendorff, Pétain, Foch, Haig and others end the war?
【CAMPAIGN】 
 *** More than 150 famous battles in 10 chapters
Civil War, Attack of Eagle, Eastern Front, Decline of the Ottoman, Marine Overlord
Dual Monarchy, European Powder Keg, Balkan Lion, Dawn of Victory, Rise of Apennines
 *** Choose your generals and promote their ranks and titles
 *** Train the special units, such as Hungarian Air Gun Solider, German Firebat, British Tank and so on
 *** Build a palace and get the princess of each country
 *** Train your army and improve their skills
【CONQUEST】 
 *** Build military facilities and train the units
 *** Develop cities to increase income, upgrade the national technology
 *** Build a military academy to study various military tactics
 *** Historical events will affect the situation on the battlefield
 *** Building wonders will bring various advantages to the entire country
 *** The diplomatic system can allow allies to join the war as soon as possible, or delay the enemy’s declaration of war on us 
Declare war on any country or assist allies at any time, or end the whole battle directly through negotiations
 *** Choose strong or weak countries to challenge different difficulties
Win with less time to get higher scores, rank with other players in Game Center
 If you reach 『A』you can get a special reward
【CHALLENGE】
*** Win the victory within the specified conditions, which will test your commanding skills
【MULTIPLAYER】
 *** Players can battle each other by using Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
*** Cooperative Mode allows players to resist powerful enemy together
【Features】
*** Cloud archives support players to change their devices without losing archives
 *** Using a new engine to improve the game graphics
 *** 300 portraits of generals are redrawn and introductions are added
 *** 150 historical battles in 45 countries, including Battle of Gettysburg, Tannenberg, Marne, Somme.
 *** More than 200 units from different countries and various styles of buildings
 *** 45 technology and more than 120 items
 *** Support Wi-Fi Battle
 *** Conquest mode supports ranking on Game Center

bluejetty:00033819:ios.description:
Delta Chat is a reliable decentralized instant messenger that is easy and fun to use for friends, family, groups and organizations. Delta Chat is developed by a dedicated FOSS contributor community that jointly releases refinements and new features several times a year, across many stores and platforms world-wide.
Features at a glance:
• Private. Instant on-boarding without a phone number or other private data.
• Friends & Family: Only chat with people you know. Unknown users cannot message or follow you without mutual consent.
• Flexible. Supports multiple chat profiles and is easy to setup on multiple devices.
• Reliable. Works under bad and adversarial network conditions.
• Secure. Audited End-to-End encryption safe against network and server attacks.
• Sovereign. Can be run with your own e-mail address or server.
• FOSS. Fully Open Source/Free Software, built on Internet Standards.

- Large-Scale Reasonable Motion
Kinn AI utilizes a 3D topaz spatiotemporal joint attention mechanism, better modeling complex spatiotemporal motions to generate heygen video content with significant motion while adhering to motion rules.
- Up to 2 Minutes of Video Generation

- Simulate Physical World Characteristics

Bellissimo Pizza — горячая пицца за 35 минут или промокод в подарок!
Быстро, выгодно и полностью прозрачно: заказывайте любимые блюда от Bellissimo Pizza в удовольствие.
БЕСПЛАТНАЯ ДОСТАВКА ЗА 35 МИНУТ*
Мы ценим ваше время. Заказывая в приложении, вы наслаждаетесь бесплатной гарантированной доставкой. Это означает, что если мы не успеем привести заказ в гарантийное время, дарим вам промокод на бесплатную пиццу размером в 30 см*! 
ТРЕКИНГ В РЕАЛЬНОМ ВРЕМЕНИ
Никакого стресса! Следите за каждым шагом приготовления и доставки пиццы, прямо на экране телефона. 
КЭШБЕК И БОНУСЫ*
Выгоднее некуда! Регистрируйтесь в Bellissimo Club и копите 2% кэшбека с каждого заказа. Накопленные беллкоины (внутренняя валюта программы лояльности Bellissimo Club) можно использовать для оплаты до 100% будущего заказа. 
ПЕРСОНАЛЬНЫЕ ОФФЕРЫ
Псс, пусть этот секретик останется между нами! Пользователи приложения получают эксклюзивные промокоды и офферы, а также первыми узнают о вкусных акциях.
ДОСТАВКА И САМОВЫВОЗ
Горячая пицца для всех: для тех, кому нужна доставка быстрым курьером, и для тех, кому удобнее забрать пиццу самому. Просто выбрите опцию “самовывоз” и добавляйте вкусняшки в корзину! 
ПИЦЦА КОНСТРУКТОР
Никаких “оставшихся” маслин или болгарских перцев. Найдётся пицца даже для самых избирательных, ведь вы можете собрать собственную пиццу в конструкторе пицц! 
ОПЛАТА ПО КАРТЕ И ИСТОРИЯ ЗАКАЗОВ
Тык-тык и готово! Сохраняйте карту и молниеносно оформляйте заказы. 
МЕЖДУНАРОДНЫЙ БРЕНД ИЗ УЗБЕКИСТАНА
Bellissimo Pizza — сеть пиццерий №1 в Узбекистане по числу ресторанов и доставок.В 2025 году открыла первые пиццерии в Казахстане, в городах Астана и Алматы.
Bellissimo Pizza – радость в каждом кусочке (и в каждом тапе!)
*Условия акций и время доставки зависят от города и зоны покрытия.

bluejetty:00178211:ios.name: Roxsyn Guitar Synthesizer
bluejetty:00178211:ios.summary: Introducing a revolutionary new way to turn your guitar or bass into a fully featured polyphonic synth: Roxsyn, the world’s first metamorphic guitar synthesizer. Expressive, fast and responsive to every nuance, it is a league apart from all
bluejetty:00178211:ios.description:
Introducing a revolutionary new way to turn your guitar or bass into a fully featured polyphonic synth: Roxsyn, the world’s first metamorphic guitar synthesizer. Expressive, fast and responsive to every nuance, it is a league apart from all other guitar synths to date.
Unhappy with cold and temperamental guitar-to-MIDI synths that dominate the market, we developed a completely new approach to guitar synthesis. Our all-original technology synthesizes your guitar directly, without the use of MIDI notes. Rescued from being a poor keyboard substitute, your guitar suddenly becomes an integral part of the synth. It's alive!
There is no pitch tracking involved. There are no pitch estimation errors, octave glitches, or garbled chords. There is no over-complicated G2M between your guitar and synth to destroy everything human about your playing. Instead, Roxsyn’s metamorphic sound generation technology retains all the personality of your sound: vibrato, slides, bends, dynamics, even extended technique. The result is a polyphonic synthesizer that is as fast and accurate as it is richly expressive.
No need for special MIDI pickups or hardware, either: just plug into your favorite Lightning/USB audio interface, and start synthing!
::Powerful Synth Engine::
Roxsyn’s big synth heart is its three metamorphic signal generators (AKA oscillators). Each generator offers 5 unique waveforms, and has a 4+ octave range to cover a wide spectrum of frequencies. They also feature stereo panning, and can route into either of Roxsyn’s dual filter banks. You can even dial in your guitar directly into the synth engine for even bigger sounds.
::Dual Filter Banks::
Each containing four custom virtual-analog filter types and dedicated envelopes, the filter banks help sculpt the synth generators in countless new ways. The envelopes are specially designed for the guitar, and are driven by a fully adjustable automatic trigger generator controlled by your playing dynamics. Envelopes offer original features like finite-duration sustain stages, as well as the ability to receive or ignore trigger-off messages. They can also be triggered externally via MIDI controllers like an expression pedal.
An additonal envelope controls the amplitude of the signal, giving you even more options in creating synth sounds.
::Arpeggiator::
Instantly transform sustained guitar notes into fast (or slow), complex patterns with Roxsyn’s powerful yet easy to use arp. There are 8 stepping algorithms to choose from, as well as settable note value, swing, and note repeats. You can even route the arp to any combination of the 3 voice generators — enabling you to layer a non-arpeggiated sound with an arp pattern. What's more, the arp can send trigger signals into any of Roxsyn’s 4 envelopes, and even reset the LFOs. So it’s also a handy rhythmic / trance tool as well!
::Modulation & FX::
Roxsyn’s user friendly modulation matrix lets you manipulate parameters (pitch, amplitude, filters, etc) using its two LFOs and mod envelope. Add subtle vibrato, even glide simulation, or go full-on berserk. LFOs each have 9 waveforms, and feature beat syncing. Each matrix row can take LFOs or the mod envelope as a modulator or control, and can even use external control sources.
And if you like your synths on the spicy side, Roxsyn comes with top-notch stereo FX specially developed to evoke extra synthiness: Powerful algorithmic reverb with the sound of countless rooms, phasing, modulating, 2-channel delay, and graphic EQ.
::Pro Features::
500+ factory presets with bass, lead, pad, arp sounds & more. Easily create & share your own presets. Audio Unit v3, Ableton Link. Native 64-bit processing at up to 96kHz. 160+ MIDI controllable parameters; MIDI learn & map save/share; tapedeck (in the standalone app), so you can record, loop & share your ideas on the go, and many more handy features.

bluejetty:00014314:ios.summary: Investify puts the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) in your pocket. Follow the live KSE-100 index and PSX share prices, read company announcements in plain words, catch Pakistan business news in English or Urdu, track your stock portfolio and
bluejetty:00014314:ios.description:
Investify puts the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) in your pocket. Follow the live KSE-100 index and PSX share prices, read company announcements in plain words, catch Pakistan business news in English or Urdu, track your stock portfolio and dividends, and talk stocks with other investors.
Featured by The Express Tribune, TechJuice and ProPakistani as a must-have PSX app for investors.
MARKET AT A GLANCE
• KSE-100, KSE-30, KMI-30, KSE All Share and every other PSX index, each with charts, technicals and a discussion
• Market breadth: how many stocks advanced, held or declined today
• PSX Fear & Greed Index, updated every trading day, with the signals driving market sentiment
• Top movers: most active stocks, gainers and losers
• Dollar rate and other currencies against the rupee (USD/PKR, GBP, EUR and more)
• Gold rate in Pakistan (24K and 22K per tola) and silver
PSX STOCK LIST AND SCREENS
• Every PSX-listed company, sorted by gainers, losers, volume, price or change
• Filter by sector or index, including the Shariah indices KMI-30 and KMI All Share
• Quick screens for today's top gainers, top losers and most active stocks
EVERY PSX STOCK, IN DEPTH
• Live share price, day range, 52-week range and circuit breakers
• Line or candlestick charts with volume, from 1 day to 5 years
• Technical summary from 32 indicators: RSI, MACD, stochastics, moving averages, Bollinger Bands and pivot levels
• Fundamentals explained in plain words: EPS, P/E, PEG, return on equity, debt to equity, dividend yield and book value
• Company profile, leadership, free float and competitors
• Shariah-compliant stocks are marked
COMPANY ANNOUNCEMENTS, SUMMARISED
• Every PSX filing from every listed company: results, dividends, bonus and right shares, board meetings and more
• Key findings for each announcement, with the original PDF a tap away
• Filter by financials, insider dealings, material information, corporate actions and meetings
BUSINESS NEWS IN ENGLISH AND URDU
• Top stories from Dawn, The Express Tribune, Business Recorder, Mettis Global, Profit and the Investify News Desk
• Investify News Desk briefs with "At a glance" and "Why it matters" sections
• A News tab on every stock with the coverage about that company
• Switch a story between English and Urdu
STOCK COMMUNITY
• A discussion for every PSX stock and index
• Share a bullish, bearish or neutral view, like and reply
• See the price at the moment each comment was posted
• Get notified in the app when someone replies to you or mentions you
• Moderated, with community guidelines, reporting and blocking
• Verify your phone number for a verified badge
PORTFOLIO TRACKER
• Record buy and sell trades with commission
• Live market value with day's and total profit and loss
• Add dividends, bonus shares (with tax withheld for filers and non-filers) and stock splits
• Realised gains and dividend history for every holding
• Synced to your account on all your devices
• For tracking only: Investify never buys or sells shares for you
WATCHLIST AND NOTIFICATIONS
• A watchlist with live prices, quick filter and drag-to-reorder
• Add stocks in one tap, remove them in edit mode, and undo if you change your mind
• Portfolio updates, market open and close, and business news notifications on a schedule you choose
FOR NEW AND ACTIVE INVESTORS
• New to the stock market? Fundamentals, technicals and filings are explained in plain words
• Active investors get candlestick charts, technical analysis, PSX filings and a live portfolio in one app
BUILT FOR EVERYDAY INVESTORS
• Sign in with Apple, Google or your email
• One search for stocks, indices, sectors and screens
• Dark mode
REMOVE ALL ADS
An optional auto-renewing subscription (monthly or annual) removes all ads. It renews unless cancelled 24 hours before the period ends; manage it in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.investify.pk/privacy

Your virtual neighbourhood Pilates Studio, practice high quality Pilates from the comfort of your own home and join a beautiful supportive community. Feel-good, online pilates to fit your life. Move mindfully with Lottie and thousands of neighbours worldwide. All for less than the price of one London studio session.

Start with a 7 day free trial and then it’s a single membership that provides access to an ever expanding library. When you join LMP you get all classes across all levels, all challenges and collections, as well as new content added regularly. Choose from a growing library of on-demand classes, challenges and programmes. Short sessions. Longer sessions. Gentle days and stronger days.

Everything is included in your membership. You decide how and when you move.

INCLUDED IN YOUR SUBSCRIPTION

> 450+ on demand classes.

> assess to all our previous challenges as well as new ones!

> curated monthly Pilates guides

> approachable, real, experienced teaching with a high attention to detail.

> practice anywhere, anytime and at your own pace.

> live classes.

> create your own playlists.

> no wifi required, sync your videos to watch offline.

> access to our wholesome supportive community feature.

MEET LOTTIE

Lottie Murphy has been teaching Pilates for over a decade and has gained so much experience teaching around the U.K and the world. Lottie has made it her life's work to teach Pilates, to help make is accessible to all, to help people move better, feel better and be free in mind and body. With a huge online following and a popular YouTube channel, Lottie Murphy Pilates has over 412k viewers. Her classes are technical, mindful but also creative and fun. Lottie is continuously educating herself further and helping people discover how incredible Pilates can be not only physically but mentally. Training with Lottie is a joy and you'll never look back.

- Already a Member? Sign-In to access your subscription.

- New? Try it for free! Subscribe in the app to get instant access.

Lottie Murphy Pilates offers auto-renewing subscriptions with a Free Trial.

You'll receive unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your Account at confirmation of purchase. Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. After the free trial, subscription automatically renews at the monthly rate unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial period. Cancel anytime in Account Settings.

For more information see our:

-Terms of Service: https://studio.lottiemurphy.com/ pages/termsofservice

-Privacy Policy: https://studio.lottiemurphy.com/pages/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00132351:ios.name: Rogue with the Dead: Idle RPG
bluejetty:00132351:ios.summary:
Rogue with the Dead is an original roguelike RPG where you command and power up troops on an endless, looping journey.
What kills you makes you stronger.
An innovative game from room6, the team that has brought you such successes as Unreal
bluejetty:00132351:ios.description:
Rogue with the Dead is an original roguelike RPG where you command and power up troops on an endless, looping journey.
What kills you makes you stronger.
An innovative game from room6, the team that has brought you such successes as Unreal Life and Gen’ei AP.
◆Defeat the Demon Lord
Your mission is to lead an envoy of soldiers for 300 miles, in order to defeat the Demon Lord at the end.
Completing quests and killing monsters will earn you coins that you can use to make your troops stronger.
They fight automatically, and you can choose to either wait and watch them have at it or join the battle yourself.
Soldiers respawn after they’re killed, but you don’t. You’ll lose all soldiers, money, and items, except for artifacts, and you’ll have to start over.
To stand a chance against the powerful bosses impeding your progress, you’ll need to collect as many artifacts as you can. Defeating them, in turn, will grant you more artifacts.
◆Many different playstyles
・Power up soldiers, defeat monsters, and clear dungeons
・An endless loop of dungeons
・Hire healers, summoners, magicians, and more to fight for you
・Focus on knights for close-range attacks or upgrade your wizards to crush enemies long-range? The choice is yours
・Defend yourself from the incoming enemies in true tower defense fashion
・Power up quests to earn more coins automatically in idle mode
・No annoying controls required as most of the game can be played while idling
・Find even stronger soldiers to defeat tough bosses
・Collect many useful artifacts
・Gather ingredients to cook meals to enhance your soldiers’ powers
・Compete with other players in the online leaderboard
・Roguelite mechanics, making you stronger every time you start over
◆A beautiful pixel art world
Travel through a fantastic world and its story drawn in beautiful pixel art. Enjoy the journey to the Demon Lord’s castle together with your troops and your guide Elly.
Little by little, you’ll find out about what happened before your arrival, and Elly might know more than she lets on...
◆Watch the numbers grow
At first, you’ll deal 10 or 100 points of damage. As you progress with the upgrades, the numbers will grow in the millions, billions, trillions... Enjoy the exponential growth of your power.
◆A varied roster of soldiers
Swordsman
A basic warrior unit with high health who fights on the front line to protect other soldiers.
Ranger
An archer that can attack from afar. However, it is slower and has less health than warriors.
Pigmy
A tiny warrior with low health and weak attack, but very fast movement. It can quickly sneak close to enemies to attack them directly.
Sorcerer
A magician that deals high damage to enemies within an area. However, it is slow and rather fragile.
...and many more.
◆Artifacts that power you up
・Increase attack by 50%
・Protect magicians from 1 attack
・Increase all coins earned by 50%
・1% of all soldiers' attack is added to the tap attack
・Soldiers have a 1% probability of spawning at giant size
・Necromancers can summon 1 additional skeleton
...and many more
◆If you’re tired, just idle
If you want to take a break, just close the game. Quests will still continue even while you’re not playing the game. When you come back, you’ll have more coins to power up your soldiers and defeat that boss that has been giving you trouble.
You can play for a few minutes at a time, so it’s perfect to fill in those little pockets of time throughout the day.
◆You’ll probably like this game if...
・You like idle games
・You like “clicker” games
・You want something to do in your spare time
・You like strategy games
・You like RPGs
・You like pixel art
・You want the game to progress while you're afk
・You like tower defense games
・You like roguelike or roguelite games
・You like playing online
・You like endless dungeon exploration games
・You like seeing numbers grow exponentially
・You go hard

 ** Three Pro
bluejetty:00036253:ios.description:
**iSafeCharge - Phone Security Alarm**
 • Turn your iPhone into a powerful anti-theft alarm. Whether you're charging at a café, studying at the library, or just keeping your phone safe at home – iSafeCharge has you covered.
 ** Three Protection Modes:**
 • Motion Detection – Alerts you when someone picks up or moves your phone
 • Cable Detection – Triggers if someone unplugs your charger (also detects power outages!)
 • Both – Maximum protection with motion AND cable monitoring
 **Smart Features:**
 • Intruder Photos – Automatically captures photos when someone unlocks your phone to stop the alarm
 • Adjustable Sensitivity – Fine-tune motion detection to prevent false alarms
 • Force Max Volume – Siren plays at full volume even if your phone is muted
 • Works in Background – Protection continues even when screen is locked
 • Battery Indicator – See your charge level at a glance
 **Perfect For:**
 • Charging in public places
 • Protecting your phone on your desk
 • Monitoring power outages overnight
 • Catching nosy friends or family!
 * Simple to use: just tap ARM and walk away. Only you can stop it by unlocking your phone.

bluejetty:00062934:ios.name: Moonshiner Tycoon
bluejetty:00062934:ios.summary:
Welcome to the ultimate alcohol-making simulator.
Have you ever dreamed of owning your own brewery, distillery, or wine cellar? Now you can start from fruit in your backyard and build your very own beverage empire, all in one immersive game
bluejetty:00062934:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate alcohol-making simulator.
Have you ever dreamed of owning your own brewery, distillery, or wine cellar? Now you can start from fruit in your backyard and build your very own beverage empire, all in one immersive game.
Ferment. Age. Sell. Conquer the market.
Learn how to produce beer, wine, vodka, tequila, and over 130 unique drinks. Whether you’re a curious beginner or a seasoned homebrewer, this is your chance to master the art of alcohol-making.
Total freedom, full control.
Build your own production facility from scratch. Choose what to make, how to make it, and when to release it. Will you aim for premium craft beverages or mass-market production? The decision is yours.
Collect recipes, experiment, and create your own legacy.
Every drink you create is saved in your personal hall of fame. Follow real-world recipes or invent your own with bold combinations like spicy cherry schnapps or herbal citrus vodka. Creativity is your greatest asset.
Unlock secret ingredients and traditional techniques.
For years, large alcohol companies have kept their recipes hidden. Now it’s your turn to explore ancient knowledge, discover rare ingredients, and use traditional distilling methods passed down through generations.
Build and manage your own alcohol factory.
Operate five specialized production zones:
 • Fruit Press – turn fresh fruits into delicious juice bases
 • Mixing Room – combine ingredients and build your brew
 • Distillery – increase strength and refine your spirits
 • Aging Cellar – let time enhance flavor and value
 • Bottling Station – package your product for the market
134 unique drinks – unlimited creativity.
From cider and vermouth to absinthe, liqueurs, and infused vodkas, every bottle you create has the potential to become a masterpiece.
Great packaging means bigger profits.
Use beautiful bottles, eye-catching labels, and stylish designs to boost sales and attract customers. A good look can make all the difference.
Share your passion and compete with friends.
Trade recipes, gift bottles, and challenge friends to see who can build the greatest drink empire. Whether you compete or collaborate, one thing is certain: the bar is set high.

Welcome to the ultimate alcohol-making simulator.
Have you ever dreamed of owning your own brewery, distillery, or wine cellar? Now you can start from fruit in your backyard and build your very own beverage empire, all in one immersive game.

Ferment. Age. Sell. Conquer the market.
Learn how to produce beer, wine, vodka, tequila, and over 130 unique drinks. Whether you’re a curious beginner or a seasoned homebrewer, this is your chance to master the art of alcohol-making.

Total freedom, full control.
Build your own production facility from scratch. Choose what to make, how to make it, and when to release it. Will you aim for premium craft beverages or mass-market production? The decision is yours.

Collect recipes, experiment, and create your own legacy.
Every drink you create is saved in your personal hall of fame. Follow real-world recipes or invent your own with bold combinations like spicy cherry schnapps or herbal citrus vodka. Creativity is your greatest asset.

Unlock secret ingredients and traditional techniques.
For years, large alcohol companies have kept their recipes hidden. Now it’s your turn to explore ancient knowledge, discover rare ingredients, and use traditional distilling methods passed down through generations.

Build and manage your own alcohol factory.
Operate five specialized production zones:
	•	Fruit Press – turn fresh fruits into delicious juice bases
	•	Mixing Room – combine ingredients and build your brew
	•	Distillery – increase strength and refine your spirits
	•	Aging Cellar – let time enhance flavor and value
	•	Bottling Station – package your product for the market

134 unique drinks – unlimited creativity.
From cider and vermouth to absinthe, liqueurs, and infused vodkas, every bottle you create has the potential to become a masterpiece.

Great packaging means bigger profits.
Use beautiful bottles, eye-catching labels, and stylish designs to boost sales and attract customers. A good look can make all the difference.

Share your passion and compete with friends.
Trade recipes, gift bottles, and challenge friends to see who can build the greatest drink empire. Whether you compete or collaborate, one thing is certain: the bar is set high.

bluejetty:00033757:ios.description:
Save More & Earn Rewards at Lucky! Download our app today to track and redeem Cash Back on groceries and Fuel Savings at Shell®, unlock digital coupons, browse weekly deals, and scan products to get the best prices—all in one place!
Earn Lucky Rewards every time you shop
• Earn 1 Lucky Rewards point for every $1 spent in-store or online on qualifying purchases, and redeem points for Cash Back on groceries and Fuel Savings at Shell. The more you shop, the more you save on your cart and at the pump.
Link Accounts to Earn Even More Fuel Savings
• Every 100 points = 10¢ per gallon in fuel savings at participating Shell stations (up to 20 gallons per fill-up). Points expire on the last day of the third month after you earn them. Just enter your registered phone number at the pump to redeem instantly. Then link Fuel Rewards® from Shell to stack even more savings from Fuel Rewards offers like tier status, dining, online shopping, rental cars, and more.
Clip Coupons & Save Big 
• Easily clip digital coupons in the app and redeem them at checkout by entering your registered phone number. Find offers tailored to your shopping needs and maximize your savings effortlessly.
Weekly Deals & Featured Ads 
• Stay updated with the latest deals and special promotions, including weekly ads and limited-time discounts.
Scan Products In-Store 
• Use your phone to scan any product for available coupons or check the price before you buy.
Get Notifications on Savings & Deals 
• Enable push notifications to receive updates on new coupons, fuel savings offers, exclusive discounts, and special promotions.
Order for Delivery or Pick Up (via Instacart) 
• Conveniently shop online and choose between pickup or delivery, making grocery shopping easier than ever.
Find Your Nearest Lucky 
• Quickly locate your nearest Lucky store and get directions with just a few taps.
Create & Organize Your Shopping List 
• Build a personalized shopping list by adding items manually, browsing the app, or scanning products. See which items have coupons or Rewards available to maximize savings.

bluejetty:00139985:ios.description:
Brain Code is a command-line-inspired puzzle game.
Read a level, type a command, and use the response to work out what to try next.
It’s a game about clues and logic, not a coding lesson.
Explore 50 handcrafted levels. Some clues ask you to think beyond the obvious answer. No programming experience is needed: curiosity and careful observation are enough to begin.
If you get stuck, optional in-game hints can give you a nudge. You can also leave a puzzle and return to it later. The levels can be played offline.
Ready to try a different way of thinking? Start with the first level and see where your next command takes you.

bluejetty:00096104:ios.description:
Tiles Master: Match & Puzzle - The Ultimate Tile-Matching Adventure!
Dive into the most addictive tile-matching puzzle game that will challenge your mind and keep you entertained for hours! With stunning visuals, smooth gameplay, and multiple exciting game modes, Tiles Master offers the perfect blend of strategy and fun.
 KEY FEATURES:
4 Unique Game Modes - Classic, Timer, Infinite, and Puzzle modes for endless variety
Beautiful Graphics - Gorgeous tile designs with smooth animations and particle effects
Strategic Power-ups - Undo, Shuffle, and Rotate tools to help you master challenging levels
Progressive Difficulty - From beginner-friendly to mind-bending expert levels
Customizable Avatars - Choose from 6 unique character profiles
Achievement System - Track your progress with detailed statistics and high scores
Offline Play - Enjoy the game anywhere, no internet connection required
 GAME MODES:
Classic Mode: Reach target scores to advance through increasingly challenging levels
Timer Mode: Race against time to achieve the highest score possible
Infinite Mode: Play endlessly and test your ultimate tile-matching skills
Puzzle Mode: Solve unique challenges with limited moves
 GAMEPLAY:
Match adjacent tiles by swapping them to create groups of 3 or more identical tiles. Watch as they disappear in spectacular fashion, creating cascading combos and earning you massive points! Use strategic power-ups to overcome difficult situations and achieve higher scores.
 PERFECT FOR:
Puzzle game enthusiasts
Players who love match-3 mechanics
Anyone seeking a relaxing yet challenging gaming experience
Fans of strategic thinking games
Download Tiles Master now and embark on your tile-matching journey! Can you become the ultimate Tiles Master?

bluejetty:00162163:ios.description:
Завантажуйте мобільний застосунок мережі магазинів «Фора» та відкривайте безліч можливостей: замовлення онлайн, доставка продуктів та їжі або самовивіз з найближчого маркету, а також вигоду картки лояльності — акції, знижки, кешбек-бонуси та персональні пропозиції.
ОСНОВНІ ПЕРЕВАГИ ЗАСТОСУНКУ ФОРА
ДОСТАВКА ПРОДУКТІВ ТА ЇЖІ
Швидка доставка продуктів та готової їжі прямо до ваших дверей або зручний самовивіз із магазинів Фора. Замовляйте все необхідне онлайн!
ЗНИЖКИ ТА АКЦІЇ
Усі актуальні знижки та акції супермаркетів Фора під рукою. Зручні фільтри допоможуть знайти вигідні пропозиції на овочі, фрукти, м’ясо, випічку, солодощі, напої та багато іншого, що є в нашому магазині.
ГОТОВА ЇЖА Й ВИПІЧКА
Піца власного виробництва, бургери, шаурма, свіжа випічка й готові страви з ФораCafe — їжа на будь-який смак. Замовляйте, як зручніше: доставка їжі додому або самовивіз із найближчого закладу мережі.
ПЕРСОНАЛЬНІ ПРОПОЗИЦІЇ
Ексклюзивні персональні пропозиції на основі ваших уподобань. Отримуйте спеціальні ціни, кешбек-бонуси, знижки на доставку та подарунки за покупки у наших супермаркетах!
КЕШБЕК БОНУСИ
Накопичуйте кешбек-бонуси та використовуйте їх для оплати покупок. Економія в кожному чеку!
СКАНУЙ ТА КУПУЙ
Сканер цін: дізнавайтеся про наявність і актуальну вартість товару в магазині або вдома. Просто наведіть смартфон на штрихкод! Ця фішка робить покупки простішими.
ФОРАПЕЙ
Це оплата одним дотиком на касах супермаркетів і швидкий шопінг. Скануйте товари своїм телефоном, одразу пакуйте їх і оплачуйте одним дотиком на касі. Швидко, зручно, сучасно!
ІСТОРІЯ ЧЕКІВ
Повний контроль над вашими витратами через застосунок Фора: переглядайте історію чеків і відстежуйте нараховані кешбек-бонуси.
КОПІЙКОВИЙ РАХУНОК
Забудьте про дрібні копійки! Перераховуйте всю решту на власний Копійковий рахунок при оплаті готівкою та використовуйте ці кошти для наступних покупок.
ЗБИРАЛОЧКА
Беріть участь у "Збиралочці" та отримуйте певні товари чи продукти в подарунок за покупки (наприклад, кожну сьому каву).
МОЇ ВПОДОБАННЯ
Зберігайте улюблені продукти в розділі "Обране" для швидкого замовлення доставки та повторних покупок.
СПОВІЩЕННЯ
Будьте в курсі всіх новинок у Форі, благодійних акцій та спеціальних пропозицій на доставку їжі, продуктів та ін.
СЛУЖБА ПІДТРИМКИ
Швидкий зв'язок із магазином, гарячою лінією та месенджерами Фора прямо з застосунку. Ми цінуємо ваші відгуки!
Завантажуйте застосунок Фора та отримуйте максимум вигоди від покупок: замовляйте доставку продуктів, їжі та піци онлайн або обирайте самовивіз, користуйтеся перевагами карти лояльності з персональними пропозиціями, акціями та знижками.

bluejetty:00149905:ios.description:

Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Endurance FCU app, you must be enrolled as an Endurance FCU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Real-Time Health Monitoring

Daily Health Management

Step Counter: Automatically track your daily steps and view insightful activity reports to encourage consistent movement and active living.
Intelligent Reminder System

Whether you’re a fitness enthusiast, managing a condition like hypertension, or simply someone who values proactive health habits, Health Keeper offers personalized, easy-to-use tools to support your journey toward a healthier, happier life.
Let’s take the next step—together.

Lake Ridge Bank’s Mobile Banking app lets you bank whenever, from wherever! Our mobile banking app is available to all Lake Ridge Bank Online consumer internet banking customers and uses your same username and password. Our easy-to-use app lets you: 
• View your current account balances and recent transactions
• Make deposits to your accounts using your smartphone
• Transfer funds between accounts
• View your account balances without even signing in using Instant Balance
• Receive text alerts about your account activity
• Pay Bills* 
• Check your credit score 
• Find Lake Ridge Bank locations and ATMs!
To get started, download the Lake Ridge Mobile Banking app to your smartphone and follow the easy on-screen instructions. For customers who are already enrolled in personal online banking, login using your current username and password. For more information about Lake Ridge Bank mobile services, please visit www.lakeridge.bank or call us at (608) 223-3000 for assistance getting started.
Our mobile banking app works great on tablets too! Download the Lake Ridge Bank mobile Banking app today. It’s a safe, secure, and convenient way to manage your banking needs.
All features may not be available in the tablet application.
*Customers must be enrolled in Lake Ridge Bank’s Online Bill Pay and have previously set up vendors to pay bills from the mobile application.

bluejetty:00079228:ios.description:
Do you want to build your own military base and rally powerful forces to battle enemies and become an army tycoon? 
Army Tycoon: Idle Base is an army simulation game. Here, you will play as a military base commander to help new recruits complete their training challenges and become special forces. As the supreme commander of the base, your job is to train more soldiers, expand your troops, and build your own empire of indomitable armies!
========Features========
• Build Your Training Facilities
A wide range of Training Grounds for you to unlock! Target Training, Obstacle Course, Target Range, Urban Combat Course, Boxing Training, Grenade Range, Artillery Course, Tank Course... You can find them all here. All you need to do is tap and upgrade them. Invest wisely and develop your base with your funds, unlock training programs, improve your reputation, expand your armies, and build a powerful military and business empire!
• Rally Your Forces
Choose any military units that you want and recruit new forces into your armies! Your job is to help them complete all the training courses and become stronger soldiers. Gather more forces to send into battles and complete military missions for you!
• Hire Your Instructors
Hire professional instructors to increase the efficiency of your units at the military base. Use their help to command and train extraordinary forces and conquer the world!
• Earn Idle Funds and Profits
Even if you are offline, your investment manager will auto-dispatch your idle troops. You can become a millionaire via an idle military base, or even a billionaire—like a real tycoon!
Download now if you:
•Want to develop a powerful military empire
•Want to train your own elite forces
•Want to become a millionaire with loads of cash and gold
•Want a casual idler to pick up and play anytime
•Want a casual idler or simulator that is worth your time
•Like to build, upgrade and manage in simulation games
