bluejetty:00185992:ios.summary: Turn your iPhone or iPad into an animated old style retro flip-flap Arrivals and Departures flight board for any airport in the world! mi Flight Board is designed based on the old departures board at the Grand Central Terminal Station in Ne
bluejetty:00185992:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into an animated old style retro flip-flap Arrivals and Departures flight board for any airport in the world! mi Flight Board is designed based on the old departures board at the Grand Central Terminal Station in New York City and has a beautiful old style retro feel.
Download mi Flight Board and view the departures and arrivals board at your favourite airports. View updated flight status information in real-time , the #1 travel app in over 35 countries.
FEATURES
• Old style retro-feel based on the old departures board at Grand Central Station in New York City
• Includes over 6,000 airports and 1,500 airlines worldwide 
• See the real-time status or use as a flight tracker to track any flight in the world
• Search for specific flights, by destination or airline 
• Efficiently switch between flight Departures and Arrivals boards 
• Enables you to answer the question:“I wonder what planes are arriving in Phoenix at the moment?” or “Has Dad’s plane arrived yet?”  
See our other flight tracker and flight radar apps.
mi Flight Tracker
mi Flight Radar
This app has an optional subscription to enable flight notifications pushed directly to your phone and extended time frames for the flight boards out to 24 hours. There is one subscription and three ways of paying, monthly (bronze), 6 monthly (silver), or yearly (gold). This is an auto-renewing subscription. This subscription unlocks premium services across all our apps, where available. Get updates on departure & arrival times, latest delays, gate & baggage reclaim changes. No commitment, you can cancel any time. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms and conditions: http://www.miflightsapp.com/terms_and_conditions.html
Privacy policy: http://www.miflightsapp.com/privacy_policy.html
Please note that some charter flights are not listed and that flight data may be delayed by up to 15 mins due to FAA regulations and that charter flights are not listed.

bluejetty:00019398:ios.description:
Play Seaport, a ship management and strategy simulator! Build your own city on an island and become a shipping tycoon! This is a relaxing trade sim and city builder which will make of you a wealthy tycoon of a marine empire.
Have you already reached your goal of becoming a train tycoon in the railway business? Trade in the train sim for a ship sim! Be a builder of a large fleet of vessels from small boats to large container ships.To become a shipping business tycoon you need to master the strategy and management of your fleet. Build your small town into a city and then to a large ship empire of your dreams. This ship simulator will let you experience the real ship trade, fleet management, and city building.
Build many buildings in your town including warehouse which is a container for all the goods you will trade with. In our game you don’t need a junkyard, all the ships will stay with you in the museum as your property. Establish your island megapolis in the company of other players.
Seaport Features:
▶ Enjoy a relaxing port-simulator strategy game and become a shipping tycoon
▶ Build a town with many different buildings such as Town Hall, Sawmill, or a Warehouse
▶ Train to become the best ship manager of all times
▶ Build shipping empire in your pocket & become the manager of sailing, steam and container ships. Build it now!
▶ Come up with your own strategy and get together a fleet that helps you grow your homeport city
▶ Expand your town by buying up land like a real estate agent and explore the waters around your island 
▶ Join the company of famous sailors and explorers like Christopher Columbus, Amerigo Vespucci and many more
▶ Don't leave your fleet idle too long but use it to trade various materials and commodities
▶ Play new events every month and earn generous rewards to boost your progress
▶ Trade various goods in the marine trade simulator
Do you have what it takes to be a builder of a successful port city? Don't let your ambitions of become a shipping tycoon be just idle dreams. Build it now in Seaport, the best ship and trade manager simulator!
The right strategy is important for a thriving business but you will never lose your property, not in a junkyard nor to any stealing pirates. Your empire will be always safe in your pocket.
PLEASE NOTE! Seaport is an online free simulation game to download and play that requires a network connection to play. Some in-game items can also be purchased for real money. if you don't want to use this feature please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. 
Do you have any suggestions or problems in your port? Our caring community managers would love to hear from you, visit https://care.pxfd.co/seaport!
Terms of Use: http://pxfd.co/eula
Privacy Policy: http://pxfd.co/privacy
Do you enjoy our ship tycoon simulation game? Follow @SeaportGame on social media to get the latest news and updates.

bluejetty:00160435:ios.name: Keet - Private Encrypted Chat
bluejetty:00160435:ios.summary: Keet is the chat app that knows nothing about you — a truly peer-to-peer way to connect. Your messages, files, and calls are shared directly between your devices, never through corporate servers. No central databases. No data mining. No one
bluejetty:00160435:ios.description:
Keet is the chat app that knows nothing about you — a truly peer-to-peer way to connect. Your messages, files, and calls are shared directly between your devices, never through corporate servers. No central databases. No data mining. No one in the middle. Whether you’re chatting with friends, family, or your team, Keet keeps your conversations private, fast, and completely under your control.
TRUE PRIVACY, BY DESIGN No servers. No data stored in the cloud. Messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted and travel only between participants. Not even Keet can access your conversations.
FAST, DIRECT CONNECTIONS P2P technology connects you device-to-device, reducing lag and server dependency. Built on next-generation distributed communication protocols.
MODERN CHAT FEATURES 1-to-1 and group conversations. HD audio and video calls. File sharing with direct device transfer. Cross-platform support on desktop and mobile.
WHY KEET IS DIFFERENT Other apps route your messages through remote data centers. Keet doesn’t. Your chats never touch a server - they stay between you and the people you trust.
Your conversations belong to you. Keet just makes them happen - privately, instantly, peer-to-peer. Download Keet and take back control of your communication.

bluejetty:00146411:ios.name: Argentum Camera
bluejetty:00146411:ios.summary:
Argentum Camera is a Red Dot Award-winning black & white camera app developed with street photographers in mind. It allows you to shoot high-quality black & white images without complicated adjustments or the need for post-processing. 
Arg
bluejetty:00146411:ios.description:
Argentum Camera is a Red Dot Award-winning black & white camera app developed with street photographers in mind. It allows you to shoot high-quality black & white images without complicated adjustments or the need for post-processing. 
Argentum Camera offers six filters, each aesthetically inspired by the classics of black & white photography, such as Ansel Adams, Henri Cartier-Bresson, Irving Penn, Garry Winogrand, Yousuf Karsh, and Dorothea Lange.
Want to bring your black & white photos to life? Try shooting Live Photos with Argentum.
All images (Live Photos and stills) are processed in real-time, so you can see an Ansel Adams inspired landscape treatment or Irving Penn inspired portrait tones right on your screen while you're still composing your shot.
Argentum Camera's interface is simple but functional, a balance between the modern sleekness and the classical forms. It is hardly noticeable and allows you to focus fully on composing the shot.
It is also the first camera interface that adapts to the shift in handling. In the landscape mode, the shutter button slides to the end of the panel, placing it right under your thumb.
FEATURE HIGHLIGHT
Real-time Processing
Argentum Camera processes images in real-time. The image you see while composing your shot is exactly the result you’ll get when you press the shutter button.
Two Additional Shooting Modes
Street shooting mode turns your whole screen into one large button. Tap it anywhere to take a shot. Double exposure mode lets you superimpose two different images in a single photo with real-time preview. Pro-tip: go for underexposure on both shots to compensate for exposing the sensor to light twice.
Live Photos
Bring your black & white images to life by turning the Live Photo mode on.
Instant Preview
This option lets you have a quick look at the photo you just took right after pressing the shutter button. No need to go all the way to the Gallery to check if you got the light or focus right.
Keep Original Photos
When this option is switched on original unprocessed photos will be stored in your Camera Roll.
JPEG, HEIC, TIFF and RAW
Save original and processed photos in JPEG, HEIC, or TIFF. Additionally, save the original photo in RAW.
Adaptive Interface Layout
In the landscape mode, the shutter button is shifted and placed right under your thumb.
Torch & Flash
In addition to the standard flash option, there is also a torch mode that provides continuous lighting for better control.
AF/AE Lock
Tap and hold on the screen to lock focus and exposure while composing the shot.
Rich Metadata
Argentum Camera saves your location and the filter you used in the EXIF, so you can always keep track of your best photos.
LEGAL

Privacy Policy: https://argentum.camera/legal/privacy-policy.html

Step into the delicious and colorful world of TruckFest: Cooking Game - a unique game that brings you to the extraordinary culinary challenge. With the theme of food trucks and festivals, the game is an exciting journey between culture and cuisine.
In TruckFest: Cooking Game, you will step into the shoes of Alice Water, a young girl passionate about cooking. She has inherited her father's food truck and embarked on her own culinary journey. This adventure will take you to different cities and countries around the world. There, you will learn new cooking skills, explore delicious dishes, and meet new people.
With TruckFest: Cooking Game, you will:
* Immerse the dynamic Food Truck World: 
Expand your creativity through unique food trucks. Become an outstanding chef, manage your food truck, and captivate customers with unique and delicious dishes.
* Join the Exciting Culinary Journey:
Explore diverse flavors from around the world. From street food to exquisite culinary delights, you will travel through culture and distinctive flavors.
* Diverse Cooking Challenges:
Confront unique and complex cooking challenges. Enhance your cooking skills and create new dishes, from clever chef to talented culinary artist.
* Experience Unique Culinary Festivals:
Participate in exciting festival events where you can showcase your cooking talent. Immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of the festival and win attractive bonus.
* Easy to Play, Hard to Forget:
With a user-friendly interface, TruckFest: Cooking Game provides an easy-to-understand yet relentlessly challenging gaming experience. Showcase your cooking talent and become a top chef in this culinary world.
Start your culinary adventure today with TruckFest: Cooking Game.
Download Now!

bluejetty:00062973:ios.description:
Audirvāna Remote App allows you to control the Audirvāna software running on your computer from your mobile device and enjoy your music more freely at home. Your albums, playlists, artists and HD streaming services are all accessible from the Audirvāna Remote, and the software running on your computer still guarantees optimal audio playback.
- Browse all music libraries accessible from the application.
- Create, rename and reorganize your playlists
- Choose the output audio device and precisely adjust the volume
- Check and adjust all your settings 
To use Audirvāna Remote:
- Open Audirvāna on your Mac or PC and install Audirvāna Remote on your iPhone or iPad
- Connect your computer and your phone or tablet to the same wifi network.
- Select your computer from the Remote app, and enter the code displayed on the screen.
- Enjoy the Audirvāna experience without moving from your couch.
 Audirvāna is a software for macOS or Windows 10/11 that accepts all audio formats and makes music a priority on your computer to make it a true high-fidelity audio source.

bluejetty:00176560:ios.name: Addons - Scripts & Adblock
bluejetty:00176560:ios.summary:
【Platform】
Addons supports seamless usage across all Apple platforms, allowing for data synchronization between iPhone, iPad, and iMac devices.
【Greasemonkey/Tampermonkey】
One of the highlights of Addons is its support for Greasemonkey/Tam
bluejetty:00176560:ios.description:
【Platform】
Addons supports seamless usage across all Apple platforms, allowing for data synchronization between iPhone, iPad, and iMac devices.
【Greasemonkey/Tampermonkey】
One of the highlights of Addons is its support for Greasemonkey/Tampermonkey scripts. With this feature, you can add custom scripts to your Safari to achieve more functionality, such as automatic pagination, harassment blocking, automatic expansion, webpage translation, and more. This feature is very powerful and can give your Safari unlimited possibilities.
【Resource Sniffing】
Resource sniffing is another standout feature of Addons. It supports automatically merging and converting m3u8 files to mp4. It also supports background playback and export of videos, allowing you to enjoy high-definition movies anytime, anywhere.
【Customized Ad Filter】
Addons not only helps you block annoying ads, but also speeds up webpage browsing and provides a better user experience. Similar to AdGuard and Adblock Plus, Addons' custom rule function allows you to control ad blocking accuracy more flexibly, meeting your personalized needs.
【Tagit Mode】
The ad filtering feature allows you to get rid of annoying ads while browsing web pages. Addons supports tagit mode, which allows you to remove web page ads while retaining useful content, making your browsing experience more pure and comfortable.
【Smart Search】
The smart search feature allows you to quickly switch Safari search engines by using [trigger word + space + keyword]. You don't need to manually change settings multiple times; it can be done with just one click.
【Web Dark Mode】
Finally, Addons also supports webpage dark mode, helping you better protect your eyes and avoid the frustration of overly strong white light at night.
In summary, Addons is a feature-rich and easy-to-use Safari extension that allows you to customize your Safari with more functionality and useful tools, giving your Safari unlimited possibilities! Come and experience it now!

bluejetty:00140042:ios.description:
►GOT BRAINS? 
Everyone’s worst nightmare has come true: things have gone nuclear, and the zombie apocalypse has arrived! With survivors few and far between, you’ll need to navigate between driving back the walking dead, building strongholds and bases, crafting supplies, and just plain survival! This idle simulator has it all, from the thrill of bashing in zombie heads to collecting resources.
►BRAINS OVER BRAWN
Start off by building a base that you can take refuge in, then venture out to take out these zombies, stalker style! Don’t forget about defense though – your survival depends on making friends with the other humans and adding them to your team so that someone always has your back. Together you’ll be able to craft, explore, and kick zombie butt till the cows come home!
Fun Features:
● Zombies Galore: As a lucky survivor, you’ve been thrust into a nightmarish world where the walking dead roam the land in overwhelming numbers. Armed with limited resources and unyielding determination, navigate the treacherous post-apocalyptic landscapes and fend off hordes of undead to both stay alive and defend your base. The sheer volume of zombies to kill ensures that you’ll get to experience both offense and defense in this exciting test of strategy and survival instincts.
● Get Crafty: As you navigate the simulator, you’ll have the chance to collect all sorts of resources that will come in handy for constructing buildings, healing yourself and team members, and driving out the zombie hordes. Thanks to the idle aspect of this game you’ll be able to take some breathers from the chaos and just focus on gathering items and stockpiling resources.
● Explore Some More: The world is your oyster, the only thing keeping you from sitting back to enjoy it are all these zombies! In driving them from their hideouts, you’ll get to explore tons of great locations and neat areas, as well as build various strongholds in them. Different locations offer up different resources too, so keep your eyes peeled for these and more as you explore.
● Great Storyline: This simulator was created with an open-ended storyline that just keeps evolving, meaning there are always fun new locations, and not so fun new zombies that want to eat your brains. Survival doesn’t have to be boring!
►WILL YOU SINK OR SWIM?
With the ability to build and defend strongholds, craft supplies, and form alliances with other survivors, every moment of survival is packed with both excitement and strategy. 
Download Last Stronghold today to dive into this exhilarating idle simulator and see if you’ve got both the brains and the brawn needed to survive the zombie apocalypse and rebuild society!
Only the toughest can make it through – can you?

bluejetty:00168930:ios.name: الملازم انس | امن الطرق
bluejetty:00168930:ios.summary:
ابدأ مسيرتك الأمنية برتبة جندي في لعبة "الملازم أنس"، وتدرج في الرتب عبر أداء مهام ميدانية حقيقية في بيئة مفتوحة تحاكي الواقع.
اللعبة تقدم تجربة فريدة لمحاكاة العمل الأمني بكل تفاصيله، بدءًا من التعامل مع المخالفين، مرورًا بتفتيش المركبات،
bluejetty:00168930:ios.description:
ابدأ مسيرتك الأمنية برتبة جندي في لعبة "الملازم أنس"، وتدرج في الرتب عبر أداء مهام ميدانية حقيقية في بيئة مفتوحة تحاكي الواقع.
اللعبة تقدم تجربة فريدة لمحاكاة العمل الأمني بكل تفاصيله، بدءًا من التعامل مع المخالفين، مرورًا بتفتيش المركبات، وصولًا إلى قيادة الفرق الأمنية في أكثر من قطاع متنوع.
انضم إلى قطاعات متعددة – اختر مسارك الأمني
في "الملازم أنس"، يمكنك اختيار الانضمام إلى عدد من القطاعات المختلفة، حيث يقدم كل قطاع أسلوب لعب ومهامًا خاصة به:
قطاع أمن الطرق: مسؤول عن الطرق السريعة، ضبط حركة السير، استيقاف الشاحنات والمركبات المشتبه بها.
قطاع الدوريات الأمنية: يعمل داخل المدن والأحياء، يتعامل مع البلاغات، ويقوم بجولات أمنية مستمرة.
قطاعات أخرى قادمة: يتم التوسع تدريجيًا بإضافة قطاعات جديدة تقدم تنوعًا أكبر وتجربة أعمق.
كل قطاع يتيح لك الترقية في الرتب، وتحمُّل المسؤولية، والقيادة الفعلية لفرق أمنية.
نظام رتب وقيادة الفرق
تبدأ رحلتك برتبة جندي، وتترقى حسب أدائك إلى عريف، ثم وكيل رقيب، وهكذا حتى تصل إلى رتبة فريق أول.
عند وصولك لرتب متقدمة، تصبح مسؤولًا عن فريق مكوّن من 7 أفراد أو أكثر داخل المهام والعمليات، سواء في اللعبة أو داخل مجتمع اللعبة على الديسكورد.
مجتمع ديسكورد رسمي يعكس واقعك داخل اللعبة
تدعم اللعبة مجتمعًا نشطًا على منصة Discord، حيث تنضم إلى فرق فعلية، تتلقى المهام، تشارك في التدريبات، ويتم تقييم أدائك بناءً على رتبتك داخل اللعبة.
يمنحك ذلك تجربة ممتدة من اللعب التفاعلي الذي يشبه "الحياة الواقعية" بنظام منظم واحترافي.
مميزات رئيسية:
عالم مفتوح واسع مع بيئة مرورية واقعية.
قطاعات متنوعة قابلة للانضمام، لكل منها طبيعة خاصة.
نظام مخالفات دقيق عبر تطبيق "رصد".
تفتيش المركبات والتحقق من الرخص والهويات.
أكثر من 8 سيارات أمنية مختلفة مع تفاصيل دقيقة.
أنظمة كاميرات، مطاردات، كشافات، واستيقافات.
واجهة استخدام محسّنة ورسومات بجودة عالية.
تحديثات مستمرة تشمل إضافات وتحسينات تقنية وبصرية.
قريبًا: طور الأونلاين
نعمل على إطلاق طور اللعب الجماعي لتعيش التجربة الأمنية مع أصدقائك، ضمن فرق نظامية ومهام تعاونية وتنافسية.
تنبيه الأداء:
قد تواجه بعض الأجهزة تباطؤًا بسيطًا عند أول تشغيل بعد التحديثات، خصوصًا على الأجهزة المتوسطة. ننصح بتقليل جودة الرسومات مؤقتًا من الإعدادات.
الملازم أنس ليست مجرد لعبة… إنها تجربة أمنية متكاملة تُعيد تعريف ألعاب المحاكاة العربية. اختر قطاعك، تولّ القيادة، وابدأ رحلتك الأمنية اليوم.

عند وصولك لرتب متقدمة، تصبح مسؤولًا عن فريق مكوّن من 7 أفراد أو أكثر داخل المهام والعمليات، سواء في اللعبة أو داخل مجتمع اللعبة على الديسكورد.

مجتمع ديسكورد رسمي يعكس واقعك داخل اللعبة
تدعم اللعبة مجتمعًا نشطًا على منصة Discord، حيث تنضم إلى فرق فعلية، تتلقى المهام، تشارك في التدريبات، ويتم تقييم أدائك بناءً على رتبتك داخل اللعبة.
يمنحك ذلك تجربة ممتدة من اللعب التفاعلي الذي يشبه "الحياة الواقعية" بنظام منظم واحترافي.

مميزات رئيسية:
عالم مفتوح واسع مع بيئة مرورية واقعية.
قطاعات متنوعة قابلة للانضمام، لكل منها طبيعة خاصة.
نظام مخالفات دقيق عبر تطبيق "رصد".
تفتيش المركبات والتحقق من الرخص والهويات.
أكثر من 8 سيارات أمنية مختلفة مع تفاصيل دقيقة.
أنظمة كاميرات، مطاردات، كشافات، واستيقافات.
واجهة استخدام محسّنة ورسومات بجودة عالية.
تحديثات مستمرة تشمل إضافات وتحسينات تقنية وبصرية.
قريبًا: طور الأونلاين
نعمل على إطلاق طور اللعب الجماعي لتعيش التجربة الأمنية مع أصدقائك، ضمن فرق نظامية ومهام تعاونية وتنافسية.

تنبيه الأداء:
قد تواجه بعض الأجهزة تباطؤًا بسيطًا عند أول تشغيل بعد التحديثات، خصوصًا على الأجهزة المتوسطة. ننصح بتقليل جودة الرسومات مؤقتًا من الإعدادات.

الملازم أنس ليست مجرد لعبة… إنها تجربة أمنية متكاملة تُعيد تعريف ألعاب المحاكاة العربية. اختر قطاعك، تولّ القيادة، وابدأ رحلتك الأمنية اليوم.

bluejetty:00080623:ios.name: Reina Valera 1960 Santa Biblia
bluejetty:00080623:ios.developer: Maria de los Llanos Goig Monino
bluejetty:00080623:ios.summary:
Reina Valera 1960 Santa Biblia es una aplicación gratuita que te permite navegar a través de toda la sabiduría de la Palabra de Dios en un lenguaje simple y claro con sólo unos pocos clicks.
La Santa Biblia es el libro inspirado por Dios y
bluejetty:00080623:ios.description:
Reina Valera 1960 Santa Biblia es una aplicación gratuita que te permite navegar a través de toda la sabiduría de la Palabra de Dios en un lenguaje simple y claro con sólo unos pocos clicks.
La Santa Biblia es el libro inspirado por Dios y escrito por los hombres que el eligió para cumplir su propósito, en ella vemos el carácter de Dios, su gran amor, su misericordia, el plan que Dios propuso a través de Su hijo Jesucristo y las revelaciones del porvenir para la humanidad.
La biblia está dividida en antiguo y nuevo testamento, usted puede seleccionar el libro que usted desea y comenzar a leer los capítulos de la biblia, al lado de cada libro está el número de capítulos correspondiente.
La aplicación Reina Valera 1960 Santa Biblia es fácil de usar y te permite leer las sagradas escrituras de forma rápida y cómoda,
- Acceso a la Biblia completa Reina Valera 1960 - para leer aun sin conexion! (en texto)
- Escucha los audios completos de la Santa Biblia y con posibilidad de (disponible con conexion)
- Integración con Inteligencia Artificial. Charla con la Biblia y sumérgete en la Palabra De Dios. Haz preguntas, recibe oraciones, devocionales o participa en juegos, permitiendo a las personas interactuar con las Escrituras de una manera única.
Disfruta de la Santa Palabra de Dios en texto y en audio, y evangeliza en las redes.
Interfaz amigable al usuario y de rápido acceso a los libros, capítulos y versículos.
También encontrarás temas de estudio de la Biblia en formato de texto y audio. Además, muchísimos recursos bíblicos que podrás compartir a través de tus redes sociales favoritas.
En Reina Valera 1960 Santa Biblia encontrarás recursos bíblicos tan interesantes como:
Inteligencia artificial: Una característica sobresaliente de esta aplicación es su integración con la inteligencia artificial avanzada. 
- Oraciones diarias: reciba una oración diaria cada día.
- Estudio de la Biblia donde encontrarás en Antiguo Testamento y el Nuevo testamento.
- Como interpretar la Biblia: Aprenda a usar la Biblia como se merece y a interpretarla bien siguiendo todas las fichas que se muestran.
- Mundo Bíblico: Es el estudio de la historia de la nación de Israel: los patriarcas, el éxodo, la monarquía, el cisma, el exilio y el destierro.
- Como estudiar la Biblia: te enseña por dónde empezar a leerla, la frecuencia con que debes hacerlo, la cantidad que debes leer por cada vez o cómo utilizarla.
- Bosquejos para Predicas: disfruta de contenidos con reflexiones poderosas acerca de las Santas Escrituras y recursos variados para elaborar tus presentaciones, sermones y predicas en tu iglesia o en tu reunión de celula o en el hogar.
- Bosquejos de sermones para predicaciones cristianas. Predica y estudia la palabra de Dios con la ayuda de estos magníficos bosquejos que ponemos a tu disposición.
- Temas Bíblicos: dividido en una serie de artículos que van desde el aborto hasta la vida nueva, pasando por temas tan variados como el alcohol, la amistad, la depresión, el divorcio, la homosexualidad, la lujuria, obediencia, paciencia, soledad o tentación.
- Recursos Teológicos: Un complemento imprescindible donde encontrará toda la información sobre teología sistemática y teología fundamental.
- Versículos en imágenes que podrás descargar o compartir a través de tus redes sociales.
- Diccionario Teológico: Totalmente offline para que usted pueda consultar cuando desee todas las definiciones acerca de la teología.
- Estudios Biblicos.
- Temas y devocionales Cristianos.
- Biblia completa escrita y en audio.
- Devocionales cristianos. 
… y muchos más recursos Bíblicos.
¡Lleve la Biblia a todas partes! Los mejores consejos para sobrellevar los problemas más complicados de la vida se encuentran en sus páginas. Las escrituras son muy útiles y ayudan a muchas familias a ser felices.
Escuchar los consejos de la Biblia nos hace más sabios. Póngase en manos de Dios, abrace la Biblia y siga sus consejos.
¡ Descarga ahora Reina Valera 1960 Santa Biblia ¡

bluejetty:00142381:ios.name: Baby Tracker - Newborn Tracker
bluejetty:00142381:ios.summary:
A Must-Have for New Parents!
Sync Across Devices • Family Sharing • Widgets • Apple Watch • Siri Shortcuts
Baby Tracker is designed to be the easiest breastfeeding app and baby tracker for feedings, sleep, and diaper changes. You can quick
bluejetty:00142381:ios.description:
A Must-Have for New Parents!
Sync Across Devices • Family Sharing • Widgets • Apple Watch • Siri Shortcuts
Baby Tracker is designed to be the easiest breastfeeding app and baby tracker for feedings, sleep, and diaper changes. You can quickly see the last feeding time and what side was used.
IMPORTANT:
• No login required - just download and use!
- Nursing tracker with timer
- Pause feature for feedings
- Track bottle feedings with amount fed
- Track sleep schedule
- Growth curve
### Features:
1. Table format record card
The first table format recording method, the overall design is completely consistent with the newborn record card used by the hospital, it is convenient to use, simple to operate, and easy to view. It is the best choice for novice parents.
2. Powerful recording function
• Breastfeeding: including breast milk, formula milk, feeding pumping and milk pumping records, and can fill in the records in a timing or supplementary recording mode, and provide an alarm clock;
• Changing diapers: including peeing, pooping, peeing + pooping, and providing detailed information about the record;
• Sleep: It can be recorded in a timing or supplementary recording mode;
• Growth (height, weight): In addition to recording baby data;
• Supplementary food: When the baby is older, he can eat supplementary food, which should also be recorded;
• Records of more data types such as drinking water, medication, nutrition, body temperature, etc.;
• Support multi-baby record management, which can record the daily activities of multiple babies at the same time.
• Support custom activity types
3. Growth curve.
Superimpose the growth curve on the standard percentile curve, compare its growth progress with the expected growth rate, and track the growth of babies or children.
4. Statistical charts: Provide statistical charts for the main data of the baby's breast milk, formula milk, complementary food, urine, stool, height, weight, sleep, etc., which are more clear and intuitive, and the growth process is perfectly presented.
5. Widget widget, you can quickly add records without opening the APP.
6. Apple Watch app that allows you to add records without opening your phone.
7. Siri Shortcuts - quick logging with voice commands, no need to open the app.
8. Supports multiple data synchronization methods.
• Support multi-device data synchronization after registration and login
• No registration required, data synchronization can also be achieved by email or Airdrop
Data synchronization function allows more people to care about the baby’s growth
By setting data synchronization, data can be automatically synchronized between multiple devices. While operating flexibly, even if you go out, you can grasp the baby's dynamics for the first time.
At the same time, automatically or manually back up data under your account in the cloud, which maximizes your privacy while ensuring data security.
9. Supports data export as an Excel file.
### Pricing
Baby Tracker requires a subscription. We offer monthly subscription plan.
All plans unlock the app on Mac, iPhone and iPad.
Duration and price of each subscription are displayed in subscription page. Payment will be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions and auto-renewal can be managed/turned off in the iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited as soon as a subscription is purchased. 
Terms of Use: https://zuoming.gitlab.io/protocols/babylife/p/services.html
Privacy Policy: https://zuoming.gitlab.io/protocols/babylife/p/privacy.html
We regularly update our app to provide you with the best app performance and experience. We also continually improve the app with your feedback and suggestions. Have a question or need to get in touch with us?

bluejetty:00140865:ios.summary:
HeyBabe is an AI companion app where every chat turns into a story. Meet a whole cast of AI characters — each with their own personality, mood, and a story that goes where you take it.
HeyBabe is a mobile app for AI character chat and inte
bluejetty:00140865:ios.description:
HeyBabe is an AI companion app where every chat turns into a story. Meet a whole cast of AI characters — each with their own personality, mood, and a story that goes where you take it.
HeyBabe is a mobile app for AI character chat and interactive storytelling. It gives you a growing cast of AI girlfriends and original characters across distinct moods — slow burn, gentle and caring, fantasy and mystery, strong and in control — with memory that carries between conversations and branching scenarios you steer yourself.
NOT ONE CHARACTER. A WHOLE CAST.
Dozens of AI characters, each with a name, a background, and a way of talking that's actually their own. Browse by mood, find the one you click with, and start from there. New characters are added regularly.
EVERY CHARACTER. A DIFFERENT VIBE.
Slow burn. Gentle and caring. Fantasy and mystery. Strong and in control. Pick the energy you're in the mood for — the same question gets a different answer depending on who you ask.
EVERY CHAT TURNS INTO A STORY
This isn't question-and-answer. Conversations build: a first message becomes a scene, a scene becomes a plot, and your character remembers how it started.
YOU CHOOSE WHAT HAPPENS NEXT
Secret date, last train, lost city, a masked performance — pick a scenario and play it out. Change your mind halfway and the story follows you.
THEY REMEMBER YOU
Your characters keep what matters: what you told them last week, what you avoid talking about, the running joke you started on day one. Come back after a month and pick up where you left off.
CHAT IN YOUR LANGUAGE, ANY TIME
HeyBabe works in English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, and more, around the clock. Whether it's two minutes on a commute or two hours at 3 a.m.
YOUR CHATS STAY YOURS
Conversations are private to your account. We don't sell your chat data and we don't use it to advertise to you.
Looking for an AI girlfriend app that actually remembers you? An AI companion for interactive stories? A character chat app where the personalities aren't interchangeable? That's what HeyBabe is built for.
Join 272,000+ users already chatting.
HeyBabe is free to download with optional Premium. Premium unlocks unlimited messages, all characters, and priority replies. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.
Privacy Policy: https://heybabeapp.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://heybabeapp.com/terms

bluejetty:00173141:ios.name: Everlog: Daily Journal & Diary
bluejetty:00173141:ios.summary:
Everlog is a calm, private journal for everything worth remembering: your thoughts, photos, places, moods and workouts, together in one place on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Open it and start writing. Everlog stays out of your way while you write
bluejetty:00173141:ios.description:
Everlog is a calm, private journal for everything worth remembering: your thoughts, photos, places, moods and workouts, together in one place on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Open it and start writing. Everlog stays out of your way while you write, then helps you look back.
Write Without Friction
• A fast, distraction-free editor with Markdown formatting, checklists and highlights
• Templates with fill-in fields for routines like gratitude lists or morning pages
• Writing prompts, plus personal prompt ideas based on your recent entries
• Tags, bookmarks, comments and full search keep everything easy to find
Capture the Whole Day
• Photos, Live Photos and GIFs, inline with your words or in a panel beside them
• Location and weather for every entry
• Songs, podcasts, workouts with their routes, places and moods from Journaling Suggestions
• Voice recordings with automatic transcription, videos, PDFs and sketches
Look Back
• On This Day shows what you wrote on this date in past years
• Recaps sum up every month and year with your photos, stats and a summary written by Apple Intelligence
• Widgets for streaks, writing stats and On This Day help you keep the habit
Private by Design
• Lock Everlog with a passcode, Face ID or Touch ID
• Your entries live on your devices and in your own iCloud, never on our servers
• Encrypt your backups with a key only your devices hold
• Back up to iCloud Drive or a folder of your choice, and export to JSON, PDF, text or CSV at any time
At Home on Every Device
• A full Mac app with multiple windows, menus and keyboard shortcuts
• Designed for iPad, and for iPhone Duo both folded and unfolded
• Shortcuts actions, Lock Screen widgets, Control Center controls and Spotlight search
Bring Your Journal With You
Import from nine other journaling apps, or from Markdown and text files. Your entries keep their dates, and photos and tags come along wherever the other app exports them.
Everlog Premium
Everlog is free to use, with no limit on entries. Premium adds iCloud sync across all your devices, unlimited journals, automatic backups, video, audio, PDFs, sketches, weather, extra fonts and alternate app icons.
Privacy Policy: https://everlog.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://everlog.app/terms

bluejetty:00096707:ios.description:
Discover a new way to challenge your mind with a collection of lines, drag, and rotation puzzles. Each level is carefully designed to test your logic, improve focus, and give you that “aha” moment when everything clicks. Whether you enjoy a quick daily puzzle, an intense escape room challenge, or a relaxing fun logic puzzle, this game has something for everyone.
[Key Features]
- Lines puzzle & drag mechanics – draw paths, connect elements, and find the correct solution.
- Rotation & paths – swipe lines to complete levels in the fewest moves.
- Daily puzzles & challenges – enjoy fresh content every day
- Brain training – strengthen memory and reasoning skills with easy, addictive, smart, genius brain experiences.
[Who Will Love This Game?]
- Fans of logic escape and fun escape game mechanics.
- Players who enjoy character puzzle styles.
- Anyone looking for casual puzzle fun with deeper layers of challenge.
- Puzzle enthusiasts searching for classic logic or modern twists like mind logic game and brain logic game.
[Why You’ll Keep Playing]
- Simple controls – just tap, drag, and rotate.
- Mix of relaxing and challenging content – from light funny puzzles to strategic challenge puzzles.
- Designed for all players – from beginners exploring easy logic puzzles to experts ready for hard brain challenges.
[Extra Benefits]
- 100% free to play
- A perfect way to exercise your brain while having fun.
Take on the challenge and see how far your logic can take you. From quick sessions with a mini puzzle to deep concentration in a genius brain challenge, every level is designed to keep your mind sharp and entertained.

bluejetty:00063456:ios.name: GraalOnline Era+
bluejetty:00063456:ios.summary: Welcome to the world of GraalOnline Era, a modern 2D action MMO RPG. Purchase weapons and work with a gang to compete in activities such as special events, base capturing and PvP battles in the Spar Complex, or start your own gang and chart
bluejetty:00063456:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of GraalOnline Era, a modern 2D action MMO RPG. Purchase weapons and work with a gang to compete in activities such as special events, base capturing and PvP battles in the Spar Complex, or start your own gang and chart your own path! There are a ton of unique weapons available. Melee weapons for close quarters or take out your enemies from long range with guns!
Complete quests to access other items to boost your arsenal. Character customization is a staple of GraalOnline! There are thousands of hats and outfits with the option to upload your own graphics to the game, which makes the customization options endless! Player houses and gang houses offer further customization options, with stores across the map providing a wide variety of ideas and unique furniture items. Seasonal changes bring various updates, including unique themed shops, season-appropriate methods for making money, and unique changes to the map.
Game Features:
Create your Gangster
There are infinite Free ways to customize your character when you start playing, options to upload your pixel art to create endless customization possibilities and to show off your style. 
House customization, with countless shops in-game that sell thousands of unique pieces of furniture to customize your house the way you want.
Massive Open World PVP
Battle against thousands of players in real-time on GraalOnline Era, Whether it be 1 v 1 sparring matches or 5 v 5 gang spar matches, or maybe you join your friends and play Laser Tag, defend against waves of enemies in Plasma Corp, or join in a Battle Royale! Or even take part in a Gang War with gangs of up to 25 players to claim Gang Bases or battle players across the giant map! 
Collect
GraalOnline Era is updated regularly with various hats, weapons, items and furniture to collect! 
Jobs
There is something for everyone to do to gain currency in GraalOnline Era. Make pizzas at Speedy Pizza, dig up shells at one of the beautiful beaches around the game, collect mushrooms and garbage across the massive map, and many more!

Follow us on our Social Media for the latest news & updates!

bluejetty:00078333:ios.description:
Go on an exciting journey! Meet free to play puzzles, brain teasers and mini-games of City Legends: The Curse of the Crimson Shadow! Choose your adventure story, explore mysteries and find all hidden objects.
You are a famous horror novelist, so all things strange and terrifying are familiar to you. So on your search for inspiration, you set out to find more information about a sinister spirit from legends. Who could have known that when you watch a video about the Crimson Shadow, the ghost himself comes for your blood? And you will definitely not become his last victim. The only way to save yourself — find out everything you can about the Order of Witches. How are the members connected to the fabled Shadow? 
· FACE THE ORDER OF WITCHES IN THE BONUS GAME!
Witches are everywhere! Will you be able to make your own story about them and not be caught in their net? Play the best hidden object mystery game to see if you are a natural horror novelist!
· SHOW OFF YOUR SKILLS BY EARNING ACHIEVEMENTS AND REPLAYING YOUR FAVORITE MINI-GAMES!
Each strange and horrible thing that you overcome will give you more strength! Play the hidden object adventure game and solve intriguing riddles to track down the ghosts and become a hero!
· KEEP AN EYE OUT FOR ALL THE COLLECTIBLES AROUND THE GAME!
Play this free casual game, search for highlights hidden pictures and gather articles of interesting interviews, photos of scary monsters and film rolls! 
Download one of the most amazing free hidden objects games – City Legends: The Curse of the Crimson Shadow! Play the game for absolutely free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!

bluejetty:00140287:ios.description:
Step into the spine-chilling world of "Gloomy Tales: One-Way Ticket", where a Halloween party at a posh mansion turns into a real-life nightmare! Was it destiny or something far more sinister? As a successful photographer, your mission is simple: capture moments at this prestigious event. But when a monster drags your friend through a portal into the land of the dead, the stakes become terrifyingly real. Navigate through horror hidden object games and unravel the truth hidden within this spooky horrorland. Face spine-tingling puzzles, brain teasers, and scary horror challenges as you dive deeper into the supernatural. Don't trust what you hear and only believe half of what you see in this thrilling ghost game!
This time, you were invited to take a group photo in a big, historical mansion. The place is spooky. You realize how scary it truly is when a monster takes your friend Millie through a portal in front of a crowd. He took her to the world of the dead, so you will have to risk your life to save her. Luckily, you have help: Professor Power and his sister Astra will help you get there, and a ghost called Faceless certainly wants to be your friend and trick Allister on his home turf. Will it be enough? Also, not to brag, but the party host Anna Charlestone has some experience with going against the supernatural as well, even though she’s not telling you about it… What kind of dark secrets does this girl hide?
· HEART-POUNDING HORROR QUEST!
Every minute counts! Unravel the chilling mystery in this thrilling ghost game. Can you outwit the malevolent monster? Dive into the shadows, solve fun halloween games, puzzles, and search for mystery hidden object games. It's a race against time – rescue awaits!
· SPOOKY ATMOSPHERE!
Embarking on this mysterious event of horror hidden object games you will have the opportunity to visit many curious corners of the old mansion filled with hidden objects, Halloween stories and supernatural secrets! What's a world without some horrorland, right?
· TRICK AND TREAT!
Get ready for a chilling journey filled with scary horror, party Halloween, and adventure as you gather an eerie assortment of Halloween-themed collectibles. From scarecrow games to pumpkin treasures, dive into the missing objects games to unravel the secrets of these macabre treasures!
· A VARIETY OF ACHIEVEMENTS!
Risk everything as you confront creepy games challenges and navigate Halloween stories! Sharpen your wits by solving mystery hidden object games and enjoy moments of respite with engaging mini-games, all while earning an array of achievements that showcase your mastery! 
Enjoy the Halloween spirit with hidden objects that capture the essence of the holiday, adding an extra layer of festive enjoyment to your adventure!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00182590:ios.name: Solitaire Mobile
bluejetty:00182590:ios.summary:
Solitaire is an exciting way to pass the time. Whether at home, at office or outside this game will help you have some relaxing time. 
Solitaire Mobile is a modern card game specifically tailored for mobile devices. Customize your game as
bluejetty:00182590:ios.description:
Solitaire is an exciting way to pass the time. Whether at home, at office or outside this game will help you have some relaxing time. 
Solitaire Mobile is a modern card game specifically tailored for mobile devices. Customize your game as you want. It comes with 17 card fronts, 26 card backs and 40 backgrounds to pick from. It has multiple settings you can turn off and on. 
We also give you the most helpful hints and a new visual help system. If you are new to Solitaire games, our help system will help you get started by showing you what moves you can play.
GAME MODES
- Draw 1 - Classic Solitaire Klondike
- Draw 3 - Classic Solitaire Klondike
- Draw 1 - Vegas Mode
- Draw 3 - Vegas Mode
- Level Mode with 100,000 solvable Draw 1 and Draw 3 games
- Daily Challenges
FEATURES
- Tap or drag & drop cards
- Works in both Portrait and Landscape Orientation - Just flip your device
- 4 Scoring Options: Standard, Standard Cumulative, Vegas, Vegas Cumulative
- Complete personalization options: card fronts, card backs and backgrounds 
- Vibrations for a more personal, tactile experience
- Unlimited Hints
- Unlimited Undos
- Visual In-Game Help
- Enhanced Statistics and many achievements to unlock
- Play across multiple devices
- 30+ achievements to unlock
- Online leaderboards to compete with people everywhere
- Left Hand and Right Hand option
- Out of moves alerts
- Cloud Save, so you can always pick up where you left off. Your data will be synchronized across your multiple devices.
- Big cards that are easy to see
- Responsive and efficient design
- Phone & Tablet support
- Stylus support
HOW TO PLAY
- In this game you have to build up 4 stacks of cards of the same suit in each of the 4 foundation piles from the top of the screen. Each of the foundation piles must start with an ace and end with a king.
- The cards from the 7 columns can be placed in descending order by alternating between red (hearts and diamonds) and black (spades and clubs). For example, you can place a 5 of hearts on a 6 of spades. 
- You are allowed to move runs of cards between columns. A run is a set of cards with numbers in a descending order and alternating colors.
- If you ever get empty columns you can place a king or any run starting with a king.
- When you run out of useful moves you can continue by tapping on the deck at the top left of the screen. You will draw 1 card or 3 cards depending on the type of the game. If there are no more cards in the deck tap on its outline to draw more cards from the beginning.
- You should try to expose more and more cards as quickly as possible. Important cards might be buried under other cards.
If you have any technical problems, please email us directly at support@gsoftteam.com. Please, don’t leave support problems in our comments – we don’t check those regularly and it will take longer to fix any issues that you might encounter. Thank you for your understanding!

To access all features and content you can subscribe to Woman Evolve TV on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.

Take control of your health with the Ballad Health app. With the Ballad Health mobile app, you can quickly access your health records through MyChart anywhere there's internet – 24/7.
Schedule and manage appointments with our trusted providers.

- View vaccination records
- Estimate your medical bill
- Request prescription refills

bluejetty:00076354:ios.description:
Apprendre la langue des signes n'a jamais été aussi facile !
Pause LSF vous permet d'apprendre la langue des signes française partout et à tout moment, de manière amusante et efficace. Notre programme consiste en 20 modules, chacun portant sur un sujet différent et offrant des résultats d'apprentissage spécifiques. Au sein de chaque module, vous disposerez de 4 à 7 leçons ludiques, grâce auxquelles vous pourrez acquérir de nouveaux signes, vous entraîner, vous familiariser avec la grammaire et continuer à apprendre cette nouvelle langue. Notre IA s'assure non seulement que vous apprenez de nouvelles compétences, mais aussi que vous les conservez au fil du temps.
Rapidement, vous maîtriserez tous les mots essentiels pour signer au quotidien.
Pause LSF s'adresse à toute personne désireuse d'apprendre la langue des signes ! Si vous cherchez à apprendre les signes pour communiquer avec vos proches, pour apprendre une nouvelle langue, pour vous connecter avec les gens de votre entourage, pour votre carrière ou pour toute autre raison, vous êtes au bon endroit.
Notre objectif est de transformer la façon dont le monde apprend et pense la langue des signes. Notre but est de combler le fossé entre les communautés sourdes et entendantes.
Si vous appréciez Pause LSF, vous devriez essayer notre version premium ! Elle vous donnera accès à tout le matériel pédagogique de la plateforme et vous offrira la meilleure expérience pour apprendre la langue des signes. Nous proposons des abonnements annuels et mensuels.

De plus, votre compte sera débité pour le renouvellement dans les 24 heures précédant la fin de la période en cours. Le renouvellement automatique peut être désactivé à tout moment en accédant à vos paramètres dans l'iTunes Store après l'achat. Toute partie non utilisée d'une période d'essai gratuite, si elle est offerte, sera perdue lorsque l'utilisateur achètera un abonnement à cette publication, le cas échéant.

bluejetty:00090563:ios.description:
Get the most epic, fully professional intros,openers and outros. All through your device. 
Are you a content creator of any kind who wants a professional intro, opener,outro or just your logo or name revealed in the most awesome way? If you are and you can't re-create some of the most professional intros,outros, titles and openers in the world, Videoblast was built for you. It gives you access to amazing content with zero need for a expensive high end computer, professional expensive software, the skills needed to create the content or hiring a professional freelancer to do it for you. If you have an Instagram,Snapchat, page, YouTube channel you can use Videoblast to get any professional titles,intros,openers or outros you may need. And if you run everything through your phone, worry not there is also zero need for a computer.
How it works? 
We took a very complex procedure and made it rather simple and scalable. We have been working on video advertising and VFX for long before we got into apps so we do have the team,software, and workstations to put together something like this. A system of special created plugins and software handle requests as soon as you send them, they queue your render make it ready, we check before if needed and always after to assure the quality is up to par. While on your end all you see however is the render request being sent and the video becoming available on your device once its rendered and ready! All this with something we could not image to be possible just a few years ago. With our cloud workstations we can scale up and render hundreds of videos whenever you request may need them.
We provide content in 1080p, HD, Snapchat/ Instagram Story ready resolutions. Instagram post resolutions and more. In various frame rates. We deliver to you full file sizes and the full final files so that you may use it as you wish, wherever you wish. Each video has various options you can choose from. 4K and UHD renders can be available on personal request, and may come as an optional option on certain videos. 
Videoblast will serve you as a very handy tool wherever you may be in the world, as long as you have an iPhone or iPad on you. The delivery times are dynamic as they depend on the number of render requests and the time it takes for your template to be rendered. We have render farms and have built entirely custom software to assure that your content gets delivered fast.

At
bluejetty:00182757:ios.description:
Muscle Clicker: Gym Game is an idle workout clicker where your taps build real muscles.
Build your hero from a beginner into a powerful bodybuilder, train in the gym, upgrade your stats and enjoy a simple, satisfying fitness simulator.
At the beginning your character is so weak he can barely run on an exercise bike or lift light dumbbells. Your goal is to change that. Tap to train, earn money in competitions, buy new equipment and watch how his muscles grow with every level.
Tap to train and grow muscles
Train in the gym – lift dumbbells, ride exercise bikes and push yourself to the limit in a simple idle gym game.
Join competitions – set new records in pull-ups and squats to earn extra cash and show your strength.
Control your stamina – the more you exercise, the faster your energy runs out. Manage your stamina to keep training efficiently.
Upgrade stats like in an RPG
Level up your hero – gain experience and levels after each workout session.
Spend status points – increase arm strength, leg strength and stamina to train longer and earn more.
Watch your body transform – see your skinny guy slowly become bigger and stronger as you progress.
Customize your style
Change hairstyle and beard – make your character look unique.
Pick shirt and shorts colors – create your own gym outfit with different color combinations.
Choose music and backgrounds – set the mood for your workout with different tracks and scenes.
Simple controls & offline play
Easy tap controls – just tap or hold the screen, each exercise has slightly different mechanics to master.
Play offline – no internet connection needed, enjoy this idle gym simulator anywhere.
If you love gym games, idle clicker games or bodybuilder simulators, Muscle Clicker: Gym Game gives you a relaxing loop: tap to train, upgrade your stats, customize your style and slowly turn a weak newbie into a real muscle pro.
Download Muscle Clicker: Gym Game now, start your workout and remember – movement is life!

WHY PIANO WORKS FOR YOU
Learning piano shouldn't feel overwhelming or require expensive private tutors. Piano brings professional instruction directly to your fingertips with interactive lessons that adapt to your pace. Our real keyboard interface responds to your playing just like an acoustic piano, providing instant feedback that accelerates your progress. From reading your first notes to mastering complex chords, every lesson builds confidence through achievable milestones.
CELEBRATE FATHER'S DAY WITH THE GIFT OF MUSIC
This June, give Dad something truly meaningful. Piano makes the perfect Father's Day gift for the dad who always wanted to learn music, the grandfather sharing melodies with grandkids, or any father figure ready to explore a rewarding hobby. Step-by-Step Lessons: Progress through carefully structured courses designed by professional piano instructors. Each lesson introduces new concepts while reinforcing previous skills, ensuring solid foundation building from day one.

Daily Practice Reminders: Build lasting habits with customizable notifications that encourage consistent practice. Even 10 minutes daily produces remarkable results over time.
WHO THRIVES WITH PIANO
Complete beginners discovering music for the first time find our curriculum removes intimidation through encouraging, bite-sized lessons. Parents seeking quality educational activities for kids appreciate our child-friendly interface and engaging content. Adults returning to piano after years away rediscover their passion with flexible lessons fitting busy schedules. START YOUR MUSICAL JOURNEY TODAY
Thousands of users have discovered the joy of playing piano through our app. Join a supportive community of learners sharing their progress, asking questions, and celebrating musical achievements together. No matter your age or background, the ability to create beautiful music awaits.

bluejetty:00118923:ios.description:
Credit Sesame is an all-in-one credit score management app designed to improve your credit score and financial health. Our platform empowers you to access, understand, and build your credit, managing its growth and protection.
We analyze your credit profile to find the best offers for credit cards and products that match your needs, making it easier to reach financial goals.
From understanding your credit score to finding credit card options, our app provides tools for smarter financial decisions. Whether your goal is to improve your credit score, repair credit, or secure your dream home, Credit Sesame is your trusted partner.
Join millions who rely on Credit Sesame to manage, protect, and grow their credit scores daily.
Be wise and start improving your credit score and fiscal wellness today with features like:
▶ Check your Credit Score for Free
Credit Sesame refreshes your credit score daily, so you can monitor progress! Understand what impacts your credit score and get insights on how to improve it.
▶ Credit Report Summary & Sesame Grade
Receive a weekly credit report summary with a simple letter grade, highlighting key factors influencing your credit score.
▶ Free Credit Alerts & Credit Monitoring
Stay informed with real-time alerts on changes in your credit report, safeguarding your credit score from unexpected shifts.▶ See Your Credit Score Potential
Get insights into how current actions may impact your future credit score. Receive guidance on steps to improve.
▶ Credit Sesame Premium Subscription
Unlock enhanced credit score insights and protection with a Credit Sesame premium subscription, which includes:
• 3-Bureau Credit Scores: Access your credit scores from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.
• Credit Score Simulator: See how different financial actions impact your credit score.
• Credit Dispute Support: Identify and dispute inaccuracies that affect your credit score.
• Rent Reporting: Build credit history by reporting rent payments to credit bureaus.
• Instant Credit Offers: Receive personalized credit offers with high approval odds.
Take advantage of these features with a Credit Sesame premium subscription—empowering you to make informed decisions and protect your credit score and financial future.
▶ DISCLOSURES
Eligibility and additional details, personal loan interest rates and fees: You can see personal loan offers on the Credit Sesame personal loan marketplace from third party advertisers from which Credit Sesame receives compensation.
Offers have rates that range from 1.99% apr to 35.99% apr with terms from 1 to 10 years. Rates are subject to change without notice and are controlled by our third party advertisers, not Credit Sesame. Depending on the particular lender, other fees may apply, such as origination fees or late payment fees. See the particular lender's terms and conditions for additional details.
All loan offers on Credit Sesame require your application and approval by the lender. You may not qualify for a personal loan at all or you may not qualify for the lowest rates or the highest offer amounts.
Personal loan repayment example: the following example assumes a $15,000 personal loan with a four year (48 month) term. For aprs ranging from 1.99% to 35.99%, monthly payments would range from $338 to $594. Assuming all of the 48 payments are made on-time, the total amount paid would range from $16,212 to $28,492.
Join over 18 million members maximizing their credit potential with Credit Sesame. Make informed decisions and take control of your financial future today!
For more information:
All Policies: https://www.creditsesame.com/legal/policies/
Customer Service: help@creditsesame.com

bluejetty:00066046:ios.description:
Get ready to dress up and battle it out in our new girls game! Style the Fire and Frozen Princesses and let the fashion face-off begin. Vote for the best outfit!
In a perfect world, we would all be princesses every day! Welcome to the world of games for girls, where you can try on any outfit and become a real princess. In our dressup game you have to go through the dress-up of two sisters and to choose who will defeat fire or cold? Perhaps there will be friendship between the sisters in this princess dress up game? 
It will be your choice to select an outfit and this is a challenging task, especially when there are so many different outfits and this will be a tough choice: a bright flaming dress or a snow-chilling dress? Only fire can melt her cold heart and the friendship will come?
This frozen dress up game for girls about two girlfriends is very exciting and interesting while performing. You can wear ball gowns, or dresses for every day in this sisters dress up game. This is the kingdom of two princesses, or two sisters, a frozen dress up game with two sisters that you can play without the Internet and endlessly dress up girly dresses, changing hairstyles and creating a new unique style.
Her outfits radiate confident, creative and vibrant energy, dresses sparkle, snowflakes are reflected in them. She is still a princess, but sooner or later she will become a queen, which means she needs to prepare a dress for the coronation and choose the right outfit. She can freeze with one glance or touch. She has a cold heart and all outfits are soaked in cold. This is a real snow kingdom in your phone. She is inviolable to others, but only in this dress up game you can make her not only the queen of cold, but also the queen of fire. You can decide is it cold or fire in her heart? 
A huge selection of dresses, New Year's dresses will help you to make the right choice! This princess dress up fashion game has a huge selection of outfits from Sevelina. If there is a coldness in her heart, then dresses should be chosen in cold blue shades, but if there is fire in her heart, do not forget to dress her in fiery dresses, as well as share the game with a friend and play together!

bluejetty:00097439:ios.name: Libertyville Savings Mobile
bluejetty:00097439:ios.summary: The Libertyville Savings Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so
bluejetty:00097439:ios.description:
The Libertyville Savings Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Bill Discovery: The app will automatically identify bills within your list of transactions and display a reminder to you when upcoming bills are due.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Libertyville Savings Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Libertyville Savings Mobile App, you must be enrolled as an Libertyville Savings Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00038456:ios.description:
Open a Ubank account in minutes for Money Done Better. Ubank is a digital bank that makes money feel simple, easy to understand and more personal. From daily banking to managing your home loan, Ubank has smart features and tools to help you succeed.
What you can do with Ubank:
Spend
• Digital bank accounts with no account or card fees¹
• Spend instantly by adding Ubank to your digital wallet
• Create joint accounts in minutes to share money with your partner-in-finance
• PayID and Osko for instant money transfers (if the other bank participates)
Save
• Open up to 10 no fee savings accounts with high bonus interest that’s simple to earn
• Earn bonus interest on savings up to $1M per customer when bonus criteria are met²
• Set up Savings Targets on each of your Save accounts to track your goals
Travel
• Use your Ubank card overseas instead of a travel card for no fees from Ubank¹
• Withdraw from any ATM with no fees charged by Ubank¹
• No currency conversion fees when you pay in a foreign currency
• A competitive Visa exchange rate on all your international transactions
Budget
• Set Budgets to track your spending on 50 categories and merchants in real time
• Track your Pay Cycle and sync the Ubank app to when your money comes in
• Use a separate Bills account to plan and pay for expenses so you know what’s safe to spend
• Schedule bills and get reminders from the Bill Planner
Buy a home
• Ubank offers home loans for owner-occupiers and investors on new and refinanced loans
• Skip the upfront cost with no LMI on any Ubank home loans
• Buy with as little as 10% deposit
• Easy paperless application online
• Chat to our local lending specialists 7 days a week
And more
• Ubank is part of NAB. You can trust that your money is safe with deposits guaranteed up to $250K³
• Ubank has encrypted passkey login to help keep your accounts secure
• Link external bank accounts with Ubank using Connected Accounts
• An Australian based call centre available 7 days for any of your queries
Download the Ubank app and follow the prompts to get started in minutes. You’ll need valid ID and a unique mobile number.
Signing up with a bonus code? See the terms and conditions below for more details.
Important information
Ubank is open to Australian or New Zealand citizens, or Australian permanent residents. You must be aged 16 or older with an Australian residential address and mobile number to hold an account. If you’re over 18 you will need at least one form of ID (Australian driver licence, Australian passport, or international passport) to sign up. If you’re under 18, you’ll need at least two forms of identification: an Australian driver licence, Australian passport, international passport, Medicare card or birth certificate.
Products issued by Ubank, part of National Australia Bank Limited ABN 12 004 044 937 AFSL and Australian Credit Licence 230686. Registered Office: Level 28,395 Bourke Street, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia.
Credit criteria apply. Info is general. Consider if it’s right for you. TMDs and product terms at ubank.com.au.
¹Ubank won’t charge you any fees overseas, but some third party merchants and ATM operators may still charge a fee.
²Rates are variable and subject to change. Interest is payable on total savings up to $1,000,000 per customer where bonus criteria are met. To earn bonus interest, you must have a Spend account, and grow the combined balance of your Save accounts by at least $1. Interest doesn't count towards the $1, and special rules apply to offset accounts. For more info about bonus interest, see ubank.com.au/banking/savings-account
³The Australian Government guarantees deposits up to $250,000 per customer, per Authorised Deposit-taking Institution. As Ubank is part of NAB, the government guarantee applies to the combined value of your Ubank and NAB accounts.
Signing up with a bonus code? Read our Welcome Bonus Offer terms at ubank.com.au/campaigns/welcome-offer.

bluejetty:00156920:ios.description:
Are you applying for the Maryland CDL permit driver’s license test certification? Use this app to prepare, practice and pass CDL driver’s license test for Maryland state and get permit on the first go. 
This app includes questions based on official Maryland CDL state manual. The app allows you to prepare and practice for the Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) test for Maryland state and all practice tests are based on the latest manuals. So if you are searching for CDL driver’s license test preparation – this is the perfect CDL driver’s license test practice app for you. This app is a handbook manual to practice and prepare for CDL Knowledge Test Permit. 
It is designed keeping in mind the learning needs of a user applying for a driving license and driver’s license test and best learning practices established by researchers. It makes preparing for the driving permit test more enjoyable and fun. Users using this application finds it very easy to answer the questions asked in real CDL permit driver’s license test. 
Following is a brief overview of the facilities provided by the app.
- Practice tests design specially for you.
- Bookmark questions you want to look at a later stage.
- Keep your progress for each practice test and view history. 
- Scope of improvements suggested based on your performance. 
- Practice tests for Commercial Vehicle (CDL) driver’s license test.
- Exceptionally large set of practice questions which covers every aspects of the driver’s license test.
- Very intuitive and clutter free User Interface.
Following test categories are covered in this app : 
- General Knowledge Test
- Hazardous Materials Test
- School Bus Test
- Passenger Vehicle Test
- Air Brakes Test
- Comb. Vehicles Test
- D/T Trailers test
- Tanker Vehicles Test
- Pre-trip Insp. Test

bluejetty:00129200:ios.description:
Welcome to the very unique idle tower defense game. Build a powerful army of your own, fight with a tribe of monsters against the army of Light, and gradually reveal the hidden secrets from thousands of years ago.
AFK FEATURES
While participating in intense battles or even when the device is off, your Hive is still working, you still gain rewards from AFK mode. A lot of rewards for you to upgrade your heroes and monsters, and be ready to defeat any enemy. You can build your Hive AFK mode to get bigger rewards and collect even more valuable resources!!!
DIVERSE MECHANICS AND STRATEGIES
Dozens of heroes and powerful skills, each with different talent paths, combined with monsters and towers from the clan. Each player will build an extremely distinct army for themselves. Strategies and mechanics in the game are so vast, a sky of knowledge for you to explore!!!
MANY GAME MODES
Besides fighting against the army of light, you can explore the Dungeon mode, buy and sell artifacts, participate in bounty hunting to collect resources, and upgrade Heroes, Monsters as well as Towers. Additionally, you can also sail with the legendary captain to the sea to discover new lands.
WORLD ARENA
You are not alone in the game world, enter the world arena to test your army with other players. With army battle modes, 5 heroes vs 5 heroes, 1 hero vs 1 hero solo battle, you are going to have extremely harsh challenges from other players. Try to reach the highest rank and win enticing rewards.
MAIN FEATURES:
 - AFK builds your base to get rewards and resources.
 - Upgrade, level up, and awaken Heroes to crush your opponents.
 - Beat the Dungeon bosses to collect ancient coins, and buy artifacts to strengthen the squad.
 - Crafting, and strengthening Hero equipment, bringing the power of your heroes to a new level.
 - Explore Exploration, Adventure modes to collect valuable lost spells and skills.
 - Join the arena, compete with players around the world, and dominate the leaderboard.
 - Dozens of events taking place throughout the game waiting for you to participate and collect rewards.
Let’s join the Monster Clan and enjoy the game!!!
Contact us:
Email : genix.developer@gmail.com
Fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/afkmonstergame

bluejetty:00073420:ios.description:
Spruce is the leading platform for HIPAA-compliant communication and care outside of the exam room. Call, text, fax, secure message, video chat, and more—all from one secure app, with a unified team inbox. Designed for healthcare professionals and their patients, Spruce takes your clinical operations to the next level, with powerful, easy-to-use tools for team collaboration, panel management, telehealth, business phone functionality, and automated custom communications.
Healthcare Professionals: Start your free 14-day trial today—no credit card required.
Patients: Spruce is always free. Download to connect with your care team for secure messaging and telehealth.⁣⁣⁣
— SPRUCE FOR HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS —
• Get new phone and fax numbers, or transfer in your existing lines
• Robust mobile and desktop apps
• Built-in compliance: Automatic HIPAA BAA, two-factor login security, SOC 2 auditing, HITRUST certification, and automatic audit logging for communication read, write, and view
• Advanced phone system: Phone trees, multiple lines, secure voicemail, automated transcription, VoIP, number sharing
• Messaging and fax: Secure individual and group messaging, two-way SMS texting, secure two-way eFax
• Telehealth: Secure video calling, as well as adaptive clinical questionnaires for patient intake and screening
• After-hours: Automated schedules adjust your phone system and messaging to match your business hours
• Automation: Save messages for reuse, schedule messages for future delivery, implement automatic message responses for common needs
• Panel management: Contact and conversation tagging, patient list upload, advanced search, bulk messaging, and custom inbox configuration and communication routing for each team member
• Team collaboration: Secure team chats, shared inboxes, internal notes, and @-paging bring the features of modern team software to the healthcare space
• And more…!
— SPRUCE FOR PATIENTS —
• Sign in to a free and secure patient app, on mobile or desktop
• Receive video calls from your care team
• Send and receive secure messages, including photos
• Receive alerts for new activity
Ask your healthcare team for an invitation to connect on Spruce. If they're not on Spruce yet, ask them to sign up today!

bluejetty:00063773:ios.name: My PixelGames
bluejetty:00063773:ios.summary:
My pixel game collection is a treasure trove filled with nostalgia and pixel art style, featuring many fun and creative games. Each game offers players a unique experience and captivating features.
In this collection, you can find classic p
bluejetty:00063773:ios.description:
My pixel game collection is a treasure trove filled with nostalgia and pixel art style, featuring many fun and creative games. Each game offers players a unique experience and captivating features.
In this collection, you can find classic platform games like jumping adventures and obstacle challenges that will remind you of your childhood gaming days. You can also challenge yourself to eliminate enemies in fast-paced shooting games or solve puzzles and mazes to showcase your intelligence and reasoning skills.
Our mini-game collection focuses on gameplay and creativity, allowing you to discover endless fun beneath simple pixel graphics. Each game has unique level designs and challenges to ensure thrilling and engaging experiences for players.
Whether you are a nostalgic gamer or a fan of pixel art style, our mini-game collection will satisfy your needs. Come and explore this nostalgic gaming world filled with joy and creativity!
Game One: Coin Guardian
A thrilling and intense game where thieves will try to steal your coins from the ground and sewers. Use your weapons to protect your wealth, but be careful not to shoot innocent civilians.
Game Two: Arena Clash
There are no friends on the arena. Swing your fists and kick your opponents to knock them down.
Game Three: Dino Dash
Only through constant running and jumping can you see the dawn ahead.
Game Four: Rock, Paper, Scissors
Simple and understandable rules: rock eliminates scissors, scissors eliminate paper, and paper eliminates rock. Just press the corresponding buttons to shoot patterns and eliminate falling rocks, scissors, and paper before they reach the bottom. The game has two power-ups to help you clear obstacles: screen-clearing bomb and time freeze. The more consecutive hits you achieve, the more rewards in terms of power-ups and lives. Come and compete with friends to see who can get the highest score.
Game Five: Plane Dodge Battle
Control your plane to dodge incoming objects. The longer you survive, the cooler spaceships you can upgrade to.
Game Six: Snake
Classics never go out of style. Relive your childhood memories with this game, controlling a cute little snake to eat endlessly.
Game Seven: Moon Landing
When astronauts land on the moon, place as many flags as possible on its surface.
Game Eight: Mini Pinball
A very fun and adorable pinball game.
Game Nine: Christmas Presents
Christmas is here, and Santa Claus is delivering gifts. What kind of gift will you receive? Put the gifts in stockings.
Game Ten: Puzzle Box Push
You can only move and push boxes. You cannot pass through walls or boxes, nor pull boxes. Push all the boxes to the smiley face position to win.
Game Eleven: Slot Machine
Test your luck today and see if you're lucky.
Game Twelve: Soccer Kid
Control the player to score more goals.
More games will be added in future updates. If you enjoy them, please show your support and stay tuned for more!
