bluejetty:00065890:ios.description:
Embark on an epic journey with Clicker Heroes, the groundbreaking idle RPG that has taken the gaming world by storm. Originally a hit on Steam and PC browsers, this beloved title has now arrived on mobile devices with an array of exciting new features. In Clicker Heroes, you'll find yourself immersed in a deceptively simple yet incredibly addictive idle adventure. Your mission? Tap your way through waves of menacing monsters, assemble a team of heroes, and empower them with unique abilities. Accumulate wealth by vanquishing foes, unearth hidden treasures, and traverse uncharted realms in this captivating quest.
Gameplay:
 Tapping Mastery: Engage in thrilling battles by tapping to unleash devastating attacks on hordes of monstrous adversaries.
 Heroic Companions: Recruit and nurture a diverse cast of heroes, each possessing distinct and powerful skills, to aid you in your relentless quest.
 Tactical Abilities: Strategically unlock and utilize up to 9 active skills during combat, adding depth and strategy to your battles.
Heroes:
 Heroic Progression: Elevate your heroes to new heights by leveling them up, enhancing their capabilities, and transforming them into formidable champions.
 Skill Unleashed: Uncover the unique abilities of your heroes, allowing you to tailor your team to your preferred playstyle and combat strategy.
Meta Upgrades:
 Ancient Enchantment: Discover and harness the might of ancients, bestowing your heroes with powerful enhancements and unique advantages.
 Ascension: Ascend your main hero to unlock new dimensions of strength, pushing your limits further than ever before.
Clan:
 Form Alliances: Join forces with fellow players to forge formidable clans, uniting your strengths to face a formidable common foe.
 Immortal Showdown: Challenge the fearsome Immortals in clan-based boss raids, where teamwork and coordination are the keys to victory.
As you progress through over 1000 zones, battling epic bosses and collecting valuable loot, the adventure in Clicker Heroes unfolds before you. Immerse yourself in the exciting world of multiplayer battles, engage in epic Clan-based boss raids against the formidable Immortals, and climb the ranks of Game Services Leaderboards while unlocking a multitude of Achievements. Clicker Heroes also offers extensive multi-language support, ensuring a global gaming experience for players worldwide.
Developed by Playsaurus, Clicker Heroes is more than just a game; it's an adventure waiting for you to embark upon. Unleash your tapping prowess, assemble your heroic squad, and conquer the Immortals. The time to embark on this incredible journey is now. Will you rise to the challenge and become the ultimate Clicker Hero?
Download Clicker Heroes today and join the ranks of legendary adventurers!
 -JOIN US ON-

High Vibe TV has the expertise in delivering exciting content using the newest technologies, social media approaches, and finds a way to always connect with the viewer. Media content is also made with a core algorithm, of infusing positive energy into every piece of content that comes out.
Another interesting fact about High Vibe TV, is it is not about talking about subjects that are vanilla. It is about, “Waking” people up, and doing it in way that has a positive edge. bluejetty:00062448:ios.summary:
Miffy Educational Games contain 28 educational games to develop intelligence, aimed at kids up to 6 years old. Children can have fun playing while learning with Miffy and its friends.
Miffy Educational Games are divided into 7 types of lea
bluejetty:00062448:ios.description:
Miffy Educational Games contain 28 educational games to develop intelligence, aimed at kids up to 6 years old. Children can have fun playing while learning with Miffy and its friends.
Miffy Educational Games are divided into 7 types of learning games:
- Memory games
- Visual games
- Shapes and forms
- Puzzles and mazes
- Music and sounds
- Numbers
- Drawing
These games will help develop children's reasoning skills and improve their concentration. Numbers, puzzles, memory games, musical instruments… your kids will boost their intelligence while having fun!
Thanks to this game collection, children will learn to:
- Sort objects and shapes by shape, color or size.
- Associate geometric figures with silhouettes.
- Recognize sounds and play instruments like the xylophone or piano.
- Develop visual and spatial intelligence.
- Recognize different colors.
- Solve educational puzzles and mazes.
- Learn numbers from 1 to 10 
- Boost their imagination making fun drawings.
INTELLECTUAL DEVELOPMENT : CONCENTRATION AND MEMORY
Miffy Educational Games provide many benefits for developing children's abilities:
-Improve their capacity for observation, analysis, concentration and attention. Exercise their visual memory.
- Help to identify and establish relationships between shapes and silhouettes, improving spatial and visual perception.
-Exercise fine motor skills.
In addition, Miffy Educational Games offer positive reinforcement with cheerful animations when the child completes the puzzle correctly, to help them increase their self-esteem.
ABOUT DICK BRUNA
Dick Bruna was a well-known Dutch author and illustrator, whose most well-known creation was the small female rabbit Miffy (Nijntje in Dutch). Bruna has published over 200 children's books, with characters such as Miffy, Lottie, Farmer John and Hettie Hedgehog. Moreover, Bruna´s most recognized illustrations were for the Zwarte Beertjes series of books (Little Black Bears in English) as well as The Saint, James Bond, Simenon or Shakespeare.
THANK YOU FOR SUPPORTING US!
Thank you very much for playing Edujoy games. We love creating educational and fun games for your kids. If you have any suggestions or questions, feel free to send us feedback or leave a comments.

bluejetty:00115574:ios.description:
Investigate crimes on a huge city map, jam-packed with hidden details, challenging puzzles, weird folks—and lots of crimes.

MicroMacro: Downtown Detective is an adaptation of the iconic and award-winning board game series MicroMacro: Crime City and comes with a whole new city map, its own set of cases, and innovative game mechanics, turning the cooperative hidden picture board game into a captivating solo adventure.
Your help is needed, Detective! Crime City is shaken by crimes. Deadly secrets, sneaky robberies and ruthless murders are lurking around every corner. How was the famous violinist killed? Why did rockstar Axl Otl have to die? And: can you put a stop to the mischiefs of the notorious Polly Pickpocket? Find clues, solve tricky puzzles—and catch the culprits.
With its cartoonish style, cozy gameplay and clever storylines, Micro Macro: Downtown Detective is the perfect combination of hidden picture game and detective game. On the huge city map you’ll follow suspects and spot them at different points in time while they’re moving through the bustling city. So what are you waiting for—get to work, detective.

Set off in exploration of world animals in a lifelike 3D world and use the various items available t
bluejetty:00129178:ios.description:
"4DKid Explorer: Wild Animals" will have you going in search of animals in a new adventure from the creators of the "Find Them All” series.
Set off in exploration of world animals in a lifelike 3D world and use the various items available to you to learn more about them.
Take photos and videos, go diving in search of marine animals, use the drone or the car to find them faster - these are just some of the things you can do in this game aimed at children aged 5-12.
And to complete your knowledge, unlock the encyclopaedia's fact sheets using the drone and its scanner!
For even more fun, you can mount the animals and ride them...
You can use your device in VR (Virtual Reality) mode to guide you or unlock the AR (Augmented Reality) mode so you can see and play around with the animals using your camera.
The game is entirely narrated and the interface has been designed to suit young and older children alike.
Why "4DKid Explorer"? 
-> 4D because the game is in 3D with a VR mode as well as an AR mode
-> Kid because it is for children (vocal guide, simple commands and parental control)
-> Explorer because the game is in the First Person perspective and the goal is to explore the world to find a task’s animals or items.
You can try out the game for free through 10 tasks.
The complete version contains 40 tasks and is available as an in-app purchase or from the store.

A worksheet is provided for each letter, offering a comprehensive learning tool. The worksheet displays an enlarged sample letter, arrows indicate the order in which the elements are written, and a dot marks the beginning of the letter. The process begins with tracing the outline, followed by independent writing, with the aim of accurately repeating the letter pattern. 
There are two main methods of writing letters: printed letters, where each letter is separated from each other in a word, and cursive, where all the letters are connected in a flowing style. Currently, printed writing is more common than cursive, but this app allows you to learn both styles.
The application will assist you in memorising the letters of the alphabet and learning to write correctly and neatly. This process requires dedication and attention to detail. Avoid rushing, and strive to write neatly according to the provided pattern. Pay close attention to the oblique guides and dotted lines that delineate the boundaries of each letter.
You may follow the standard alphabetical order for handwriting, or you may choose to learn the letters in a manner that suits you best. 
FEATURES:
- Lots of activity worksheets: lines, shapes, letters, numbers and more
- Step-by-step tutorials
- Follow your progress
- Fully supports finger, Apple Pencil, and third-party stylus inputs
---
Privacy Policy: https://asveta.cz/privacy
Terms of Use: https://asveta.cz/terms

The Dayforce app helps you do the work you’re meant to do by putting you in charge of your work and life - anytime, anywhere.
With the Dayforce app, staying connected and in control is simple. Skip the paperwork and manage tasks efficiently across your devices.
From clocking in and out to planning time off, checking your schedule, swapping shifts, or reviewing benefits, the Dayforce app makes it easy to manage your day-to-day.
You can also track your real-time earnings and access your pay before payday, giving you greater control and flexibility when you need it.¹
Plus, if you’re a people leader, the Dayforce app puts essential manager tools right at your fingertips so you can handle tasks on the go and free up more of your time. Need to approve timesheets or respond to requests? Dayforce makes it simple to stay connected and in control, wherever you are.
Disclaimers:
Features available to you depend on your employer’s setup, and not all features may be available.
Dayforce mobile access is available only to employees of organizations that use Dayforce and have enabled the mobile experience.
¹ Not all employers choose to offer on-demand pay with Dayforce Wallet. Check with your employer to see if this is available to you. Some blackout dates and limitations may apply based on your employer's pay cycle and configurations. Partner banks do not administer and are not responsible for on-demand pay.

bluejetty:00165081:ios.summary:
Anonymity guaranteed - no registration
There is no connection to a telephone number and no collection of user identification data. The TeleGuard-ID is your very personal identification number that you need in order to connect with your fri
bluejetty:00165081:ios.description:
Anonymity guaranteed - no registration
There is no connection to a telephone number and no collection of user identification data. The TeleGuard-ID is your very personal identification number that you need in order to connect with your friends. Every TeleGuard user receives an ID number and a QR code, which can be sent out to get in touch with others. 
Designed to be the most secure messenger in the world
TeleGuard's focus is on protecting privacy and confidential communication. TeleGuard is the secure messenger from Swisscows. Swisscows has set itself the task of protecting its users from data misuse in every situation. As the smartphone is the most widely used medium in the world nowadays, a secure messenger is indispensable.
Highly secure and modern server
All servers are located in the data centers in Switzerland. A complex encryption system is used for all transmitted data and absolutely no user data is stored on the servers. Everything is absolutely anonymous.
That's why TeleGuard is better than the others
TeleGuard encrypts every message and voice call with the one of the best encryption algorithm currently available: SALSA 20. Since our servers are in Switzerland, we are not subject to the data protection laws of the EU / USA and do not have to pass on any data.
How is my privacy secured?
HTTPS, end-to-end encryption, deletion of messages from the server after reading. No user data, neither IP address nor other, is recorded or stored.
Functions
• Send text and voice messages
• Share pictures and videos
• Video and voice telephony
• Send files
• Create groups
• The identity of contacts can be verified by scanning the QR code.
Support
If you have further questions, you will find our FAQs here: teleguard.com/en#faq

• Bill Pay: No stamps, no envelopes, just a few taps. Manage and pay your bills directly through the app.
• Mobile Deposit: Deposit checks anytime, anywhere, without visiting a branch.
• Transfer Funds: Move money between your accounts in seconds.
• Person-to-Person Transfer: Send money to friends and family, whether they bank at Austin Telco or not.
Track & Manage Your Finances
• Card Management: Block, activate or report a lost or stolen card.
• Link External Accounts: Consolidate your financial world! Link your external bank accounts to view balances, transactions, and more—all in one place.
• View Credit Score: Stay ahead of your financial goals with free credit score updates.

bluejetty:00184046:ios.description:
“Welcome to your own personal FirstBank branch.”
Download our free app and bank securely from your mobile device 24/7. Now, every waiting room and living room can be your private FirstBank. Just enroll in Online Banking and you’re ready to start!
MANAGE YOUR ACCOUNT:
• Fingerprint Login: With just the touch of a button you can have access to your account. Fingerprint Login allows you to login quickly and securely using the fingerprint scanner on your device.
• FirstGlance: Spin the cube! Quickly view balances and eBills due without logging in. Simply enroll and set up the accounts you would like to view (up to 3) by selecting “FirstGlance” within the main menu. After enrolled, spin the FirstBank cube before login to access FirstGlance.
• Mobile Deposit: Deposit your check through the app. Anywhere you have a phone you have a personal FirstBank branch. Simply take a picture of the front and back of the check and submit your deposit.
• Zelle®: With Zelle® you can quickly send, receive and request money to friends and family using only their email address or mobile phone number and name. This is how money moves®
• Pay Now: Receive a notification on the Account Summary page when your FirstBank credit card, cash reserve, or loan is due. Rest your weary fingers and save time by clicking the Pay Now button to transfer the funds.
• Bill Pay: Receive your bills electronically and schedule your bill payments all in one location. Bill Pay can be used to pay anyone in the United States that you would normally pay by check, automatic debit, or cash.
• Account Details: Check balances on your accounts and loans, transfer money between FirstBank accounts, and schedule a payment on an existing FirstBank loan.
• Communication Center: Bank mail allows you to communicate securely with the bank and receive messages and tasks related to your loan requests. Stay informed about your FirstBank account activity with alerts about your balance, deposits and withdrawals, fraud detection, and more. Setup Alerts to get notified by text message, email, or push notification.
*FirstBank is a regional bank found in Colorado and Arizona. If you don’t see an orange cube on your bank statements, you’re probably a member of a different First Bank, and this app will not work for you.
Member FDIC, Equal Housing Lender.

YOUR PRODUCTIVITY DAY PLANNER & STRUCTURED TASK LIST MANAGER
Productivity Wizard is a powerful “get things done” (GTD) day planner that will help you plan, focus and create the results you want in any area of your life or business.
It includes a structured and comprehensive set of effective and productive tools that will boost your productivity and help you accomplish your most meaningful objectives and routines.

Productivity Wizard will help you:
* Set weekly objectives, productive goals, and daily routines
* Develop your personal action plan and task list
* Create an effective and balanced daily routine & morning routine
* Boost your productivity and get things done
* Manage your tasks, track your time, and achieve your most important goals

--> Morning routine gets you focused, ready and prepared for a productive day

--> Lists and Notepad to record all your ideas, questions, notes, etc. 
--> Time and Routine Tracker to record your daily progress
--> Daily and weekly reflections to keep you focused and on target
--> Share your plans, tasks, and lists with your friends or colleagues 
--> Sync among all your devices and web program
--> Use the daily planner app even when you are offline, where there is no network connection
Today is the best time to re-shape your future, make real progress and get things done consistently and efficiently. 
Download this powerful app and bring DIRECTION, FOCUS and RESULTS into your LIFE!
Be Productive – Get It Done …
#####
Productivity Wizard is free to download and use. The Productivity Pro upgrade gives you access to enhanced functionality in the iOS app. The Pro upgrade let you accomplish even more by allowing you to set your own custom categories, manage unlimited goals and set unlimited routines. You will also be able to export your data to a pdf or Excel file. 
Productivity Pro subscription is available through an auto-renewing subscription.
Subscription will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
Our Terms of Use: https://successwizard.com/terms

bluejetty:00021758:android.description:
biubiuVPN is a user-friendly, smooth, secure and private VPN service that provides 24/7 private Internet access without logging your browsing history, selling your data to third parties, or restricting downloads. It protects all your connected devices from being tracked and provides complete online security and freedom, allowing you to bypass geo-restrictions and access the world's content with just one click.
biubiuVPN offers the following features and benefits:
Split Tunneling (Android)
With Split Tunneling, you have more control over your Internet traffic and can optimize your online experience. You can choose which apps to route through the VPN and which to access directly. Selected apps will use the VPN network for added security and privacy, while unselected apps will use the local network for faster connection speeds.
Multi-hop mode
This feature encrypts and forwards data through multiple server nodes to prevent data eavesdropping and tracking, and effectively hides your real IP address and location, providing further security and freedom for users to access the Internet.
Private Servers
Each user gets a fixed IP4 address, guaranteeing personalized and uninterrupted access to the network and avoiding illegal intrusions and cyber threats. Enjoy a new level of Internet freedom and security with biubiuVPN, allowing you to surf the Internet without worry.
Streaming Media Acceleration
Helps users overcome geographic restrictions, network censorship and privacy protection, allowing them to access any content globally. For countries with poor internet access, using biubiuVPN can significantly increase the speed of cross-border access.
Ultimate Privacy
biubiuVPN ensures that your data is secure and never tracks or stores what you are doing online. It also provides the security of public Wi-Fi and allows you to browse the Internet privately, without anyone knowing which sites you visit.
Fast VPN server network
biubiuVPN offers a fast VPN server network that lets you choose the most suitable VPN server in your country or region. It provides bulletproof protection for your data without sacrificing speed.
No hassle
Connecting to biubiuVPN is easy and hassle-free, it only requires two steps: downloading and connecting. Connection logs are only stored locally and are not synced to the server.
24/7 custom

bluejetty:00152214:ios.description:
Banana Pro - AI Photo Editor
Transform ideas into stunning visuals instantly. Banana Pro combines cutting-edge generative AI with intuitive editing tools to create, customize, and perfect images in seconds—no design skills required.
Key Features:
Text-to-Image Magic: Describe anything ("a cyberpunk cat in Tokyo") and watch Banana Pro generate high-resolution art in 4K detail.
AI-Powered Editing: Upload existing images to erase objects, swap backgrounds, or restyle visuals with a prompt. Fix flaws or reimagine entire scenes effortlessly.
Flexible Aspect Ratios: Create content for every platform—1:1 for Instagram, 16:9 for YouTube banners, 9:16 for TikTok, or custom dimensions.
50+ Art Styles: From anime and oil paintings to photorealism and 3D renders, craft visuals that match your vision.
Precision Controls: Adjust lighting, color palettes, and composition with sliders or natural language tweaks ("make it sunset lighting").
Batch Creation: Generate multiple variations in one tap to brainstorm faster.
Privacy-First: Your data stays on-device. No uploads to external servers without consent.
Perfect For:

Lightning-fast generation, pro-grade results, and zero learning curve. Your imagination, now limitless.

Weekly Plan – first week at US $0.99, then US $9.99 per week

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account once you confirm the purchase.

You can manage or cancel the renewal anytime by going to Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions > Banana Pro.

The Ultimate DnD & Pathfinder 2e Companion
• Design custom fantasy map layouts for dungeons and dragons games with our intuitive map maker tools and big selection of terrain tiles
• Enhance gameplay with built-in DnD dice roller functionality
• Import your custom Hero Forge miniatures for your campaigns
• Perfect for 5e, Pathfinder 2e, Warhammer 40,000 and other tabletop battles
[POWERFUL WORLD BUILDING TOOLS]
• Design fantasy environments for pen and paper RPGs with detailed customization options
• Craft immersive 3D dungeons, caverns, and villages with terrain elevation and interactive elements
• Peer into buildings and play multi-levels with clipping planes
• Create and customize battle maps with terrain, props and minis from top brands like Dwarven Forge, Reaper Minis and Fat Dragon Games
[FREE TERRAIN, MINIS AND DICE]
• Build the map of your dreams with free digital terrain from Dwarven Forge and Fat Dragon Games
• Copy and paste terrain tiles to build on a massive scale
• Get five free authentically painted and ready-to-play minis from Reaper Miniatures
• Link your account and get 5 additional free minis from Hero Forge
• Play any rule-set with a starter set of digital dice from d4 to d20
[ENHANCED GAMING WITH 3D AND AUGMENTED REALITY]
• Experience your dungeons and dragons game in stunning AR
• Place life-sized dragons and monsters on your table
• View your battle maps in authentic 3D with realistic lighting and effects
• Literally walk through your creations in AR life-scale!
• Enter the PoV of your character and see the world from their perspective
• Digital dice bounce off your actual tabletop in augmented reality!
• Perfect for both in-person and remote tabletop gaming sessions
[ADVANCED DUNGEON MASTER TOOLS]
• Control Fog of War and dynamic lighting for immersive gameplay
• Create custom encounter scenarios with our intuitive interface
• Design and save multiple fantasy map layouts for your adventures
• Manage complex battle scenarios with ease
• Measurement tools ease building and combat
• Share all your assets for free with your players!
[CROSS-PLATFORM GAMING]
• Play seamlessly across mobile, PC & Mac (Steam), and AR devices
• Share your custom fantasy battle maps with other players
• Connect with friends for remote tabletop gaming sessions
• Sync your creations across devices
[JOIN OUR GAMING COMMUNITY]
• Easily share your dungeon maps with other game masters
• Explore user-generated content for endless inspiration
• Connect with fellow TTRPG enthusiasts
• Access an expanding library of assets for your games
Download Mirrorscape today and elevate your tabletop RPG experience with the most comprehensive world building and map maker tools available!

bluejetty:00062640:ios.summary:
Rhythm Skydiving 401 for iPhone – A Rhythm Coach in the palm of your hand!
This is the ultimate app for 4way and 8way enthusiasts at any level, brought to you by SDC Rhythm XP.
Sign up now to get access to tons of content, including artic
bluejetty:00062640:ios.description:
Rhythm Skydiving 401 for iPhone – A Rhythm Coach in the palm of your hand!
This is the ultimate app for 4way and 8way enthusiasts at any level, brought to you by SDC Rhythm XP.
Sign up now to get access to tons of content, including articles, flash cards, continuity plans, pictures and over 200 videos. Download videos to your phone for review offline at the dropzone. Pause, adjust speed, and move frame by frame with the advanced video player. Use the filter and search bar to see just the content you want. An annual subscription gives you unlimited access to Rhythm’s constantly updating content including:
* The Basics (FREE)
 - Articles and resources about how to learn 4 way, how to form and plan a
 team, performance tips, bodyflight techniques
 - Rhythm continuity plans, color coded by slot for both beginner and
 advanced block techniques, including key inter-pictures
 - Interactive flash cards to help you learn the formations
* Blocks
 - Rhythm best of block videos in air
 - Video of each block in the tunnel, including color coded helmets, lines and
 intermediate pictures overlayed, including both beginner and advanced
 block techniques
* Randoms
 - Rhythm in air examples and color coded tunnel examples
* Exits
 - Rhythm best of exit in air videos
 - Detailed pictures in the mockup of each exit, including color coded
 helmets and foot placement, inside and outside the mockup
 - Video of Rhythm demonstrating each exit from the mockup both from
 inside and outside
 - Chart of recommended transition exits
* Rhythm training videos
 - Exclusive access to select Rhythm training and competition dives and
 tunnel video, with new content added every month.
* Dive Timer (FREE)
 - Dive timer designed specifically with 4way and 8way in mind. Enter the formation to
 view time at each point, and see a filtered list of each point. Click
 anywhere on the screen to log points for easy use while looking at the TV
 screen.
* Draw Generator (FREE)
 - Create random draws, view, export and share color-coded diagrams for
 each dive
 - Create specific parameters to ‘customize’ your random draw (i.e. all dives
 that start with a block as the first point or specify a block and fill in at
 random around it).
* Ask Rhythm (FREE)
 - Have a question? Contact Rhythm directly through the app for answers.
* News and Calendar (FREE)
 - Keep up to date with Rhythm, news about the Rhythm apps and learn
 about upcoming events
Subscription Information
------------------------
Rhythm 401 is supported through two auto-renewing subscriptions which you can choose to purchase within the app.
• The subscriptions are called '401 Annual Subscription' and '801 Annual Subscription'
• They are both annual subscriptions. They give you access to all the 4way and 8way content in the app, and new 4way and 8way training/competition videos as they are released
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Terms of use are available at https://rhythmskydiving.com/app-terms-and-conditions
• Privacy policy is available at https://rhythmskydiving.com/app-privacy-policy

Level up your gladiators and dominate the arena! Manage, battle, bribe, and ascend to become Rome’s finest Lanista. Free to play. No ads. In-app purchases for more content. No pay-to-win.
Gladiator Manager is a turn-based management sim set in ancient Rome, where tactical auto-battles reward smart decisions over reflexes.
Hire and train gladiators with unique traits. Handle injuries, develop skills, balance egos, and survive in a corrupt arena system full of intrigue and betrayal.
Win matches to gain influence, unlock better gear, and enter tougher tournaments. Lose, and your best fighters may be gone forever.
- Bribe, scout, sabotage, or assassinate your rivals
- Die, restart, and ascend to insane difficulties
- Plan technique-based combat
- Strategic resource, influence, and roster management
- Customize gear, techniques, traits, and loyalty
- Grow your estate and build out your influence skill tree
- Undertake quests, survive raids, make hard calls
Earn gems by completing in-game achievements. Use them to unlock new weapons, tournaments, buildings, quests, and features. If you’d like to speed things up, there are two optional in-app purchases: Pouch of Gems and Chest of Gems.
Need help or want to share tactics? Join 9,000+ lanistas on Discord: https://discord.gg/H95dyTHJrB

Level up your gladiators and dominate the arena! Manage, battle, bribe, and ascend to become Rome’s finest Lanista. Free to play. No ads. In-app purchases for more content. No pay-to-win.

Gladiator Manager is a turn-based management sim set in ancient Rome, where tactical auto-battles reward smart decisions over reflexes.

Hire and train gladiators with unique traits. Handle injuries, develop skills, balance egos, and survive in a corrupt arena system full of intrigue and betrayal.

Win matches to gain influence, unlock better gear, and enter tougher tournaments. Lose, and your best fighters may be gone forever.

- Bribe, scout, sabotage, or assassinate your rivals
- Die, restart, and ascend to insane difficulties
- Plan technique-based combat
- Strategic resource, influence, and roster management
- Customize gear, techniques, traits, and loyalty
- Grow your estate and build out your influence skill tree
- Undertake quests, survive raids, make hard calls

Earn gems by completing in-game achievements. Use them to unlock new weapons, tournaments, buildings, quests, and features. If you’d like to speed things up, there are two optional in-app purchases: Pouch of Gems and Chest of Gems.

Need help or want to share tactics? Join 9,000+ lanistas on Discord: https://discord.gg/H95dyTHJrB

bluejetty:00120138:ios.name: Future Drummer
bluejetty:00120138:ios.summary: Get ready to ignite your creative spark and produce electrifying tracks that will make your audience groove. With a vast collection of cutting-edge drum and futuristic percussion sounds, you'll be able to craft the perfect beats and rhythms
bluejetty:00120138:ios.description:
Get ready to ignite your creative spark and produce electrifying tracks that will make your audience groove. With a vast collection of cutting-edge drum and futuristic percussion sounds, you'll be able to craft the perfect beats and rhythms to elevate your music.
Our technology boasts an improved jamming algorithm that has been specifically designed to cater to the needs of electronic and experimenta music producers, musicians and students. The advanced algorithm provides you with the power to create grooves that are not only innovative but also adaptable to your musical vision. Whether you're into Minimal, House, Electro, Hip Hop, Industrial, Electro Latino, or EDM, you'll find all the drum and percussion sounds you need to produce the beat-driven tracks of your dreams.
Unleash your inner rhythm master and craft electrifying beats and grooves that will keep your audience moving. With a wealth of editable sounds and intuitive tools, you'll have the power to create drum patterns that are truly unique and innovative. So, why wait? Start exploring the world of electronic music production today and take your sound to the next level!
EXPORT -> New Audio & Midi Export feature. Get Multi-Track or Full Mix in seconds.
- Midi Out sends all note grooves and jamming at real time, so you can record the sequence or apply external sounds.
- The new Live mode involves you in the grooves like never before with loads of controls with effects, hits, reverses, slices and groove controls at real time
- Reverse or Slice individual hits with the easy editor.
- Live Pads to assign rhythms, jam intensity and colors to play live session. Selectable by Midi with Notes or Program Change.
- Song Mode. Extra fast tool to create rhythmic structures for your song in seconds
- Song Mode is the fastest and effective way to create the structure for your songs with the best quality.
- Integrated Effects: Compressor, Delay, Reverb and EQ for main Mix. 2 Extra Send delays for Live mode
- Random generators to get creative ideas instantly.
- More than 100 Multilayer sounds
- Add new In-App Purchase Sounds
- More than 300 editable grooves easy searchable by tags. Don't need to program but you can make your own grooves, no limits.
- Random generators to get creative ideas instantly.
- Ableton Link Sync
- Inter-App Audio
- Midi Out

bluejetty:00140478:ios.description:
Are you ready for an absolutely addictive puzzle adventure that not only entertains but also boosts your brainpower? Let me introduce you to Kitty Sort: Twisted Tails – the coolest color sorting game around, designed to challenge your brain, melt away stress, and bring a smile to your face! Brace yourself for an exhilarating journey through a world filled with adorable kitties, dazzling colors, and brain-teasing challenges that'll keep you hooked for hours!
Why choose "Kitty Sort: Twisted Tails"?
- Engaging Gameplay: Dive into the colorful world of Kitty Sort: Twisted Tails, where each level brings a fun new challenge to test your sorting skills. From simple sorting tasks to tricky puzzles, every level is crafted to keep you entertained and smiling.
- Variety of Levels and Puzzles: With tons of carefully crafted levels and puzzles, Kitty Sort: Twisted Tails offers endless fun for players of all levels. Whether you're a casual player or a puzzle pro, there's something here for everyone!
- Easy-to-Use Interface: Kitty Sort: Twisted Tails features an intuitive interface and simple mechanics, so anyone can jump right in and start having fun. Whether you're a pro or new to sorting games, you'll feel right at home!
- Stunning Graphics: Immerse yourself in a world of cuteness with Kitty Sort: Twisted Tails! With adorable graphics and charming animations, you'll be smiling from ear to ear as you play.
- Addictive Gameplay: Be ready to get captivated by Kitty Sort: Twisted Tails! With its addictive gameplay and endless challenges, you'll find yourself coming back for more again and again.
- Boost your Skills: Challenge yourself with increasingly tricky puzzles that'll put your brain to the test. Kitty Sort: Twisted Tails is the perfect way to sharpen your mind while having a blast!
- Relieve Stress: Take a break from the hustle and bustle of daily life with Kitty Sort: Twisted Tails. Its relaxing gameplay and adorable visuals make it the perfect way to unwind after a long day.
So why should you play Kitty Sort: Twisted Tails? Because it's not just a game – it's a fun-filled adventure that'll leave you smiling from ear to ear! Whether you're looking to challenge your brain, de-stress, or just have a great time, Kitty Sort: Twisted Tails has got you covered. 
Download now and start sorting your way to fun!

bluejetty:00019473:ios.name: Summoners Greed: Tower Defense
bluejetty:00019473:ios.summary: Experience the ultimate idle hero summon and squad-building RPG! Build an unstoppable team, set up your perfect auto battle formation, and collect epic loot in this thrilling idle AFK adventure. Your powerful AFK monster army never stops fi
bluejetty:00019473:ios.description:
Experience the ultimate idle hero summon and squad-building RPG! Build an unstoppable team, set up your perfect auto battle formation, and collect epic loot in this thrilling idle AFK adventure. Your powerful AFK monster army never stops fighting, gathering offline resources, and leveling up 24/7. 
IDLE HERO SUMMON & GACHA ROSTER
Unlock the summoning portal to collect over 40 unique characters. Pull for common, rare, epic, and mythic heroes to build your ultimate squad. Every idle hero summon brings a unique skill tree, elemental affinity, and combat style to the battlefield. Awaken their hidden powers, unlock epic evolutions, and create perfect synergies. Will you pull the ultimate legendary tier summon to dominate the rankings?
AFK MONSTER AUTO BATTLE
Leave the endless grinding behind. Set up your arena formation and let the auto battle system handle the heavy lifting. Whether you are actively managing your roster or totally idle AFK, your units are always working for you. Close the game and return later to claim massive offline rewards, gold, and magical loot. Leveling up your AFK monster collection has never been this effortless.
STRATEGIC IDLE DEFENSE
Winning requires more than just high-level units; it demands a brilliant tactical mind. Place your roster carefully on the tactical grid to maximize their elemental damage and crowd control abilities. Freeze enemy waves, unleash fiery magic, and debuff powerful targets. Tweak your idle defense strategy and optimize your formations to overcome increasingly difficult challenges and enemy factions.
MYTHIC HEROES & EPIC BOSSES
Push the limits of your auto battle tactics by taking on colossal bosses and participating in special weekly events. Summon exclusive, limited-time mythic heroes to add to your collection. Climb the leaderboards, optimize your idle defense grid, and prove your squad-building strategy is the most effective in the game. 
KEY FEATURES:
• Effortless Idle AFK Progression: Your squad auto-battles and collects offline loot constantly!
• Epic Gacha System: Experience the thrill of the idle hero summon to unlock powerful units.
• Strategic Auto Battle: Position your AFK monster army perfectly to unleash devastating combos.
• Deep RPG Progression: Level up, evolve, and ascend your mythic heroes to their maximum potential.
• Tactical Idle Defense: Upgrade spells, passive boosts, and placements to conquer elite boss encounters.
If you love the satisfying progression of a squad-building game, the thrill of gacha collecting, and deep strategy mechanics, your search ends here. Download Summoners Greed now and start building your ultimate team today!

bluejetty:00017577:ios.name: ASCU Mobile Banking
bluejetty:00017577:ios.summary: ASCU Mobile Banking is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easi
bluejetty:00017577:ios.description:
ASCU Mobile Banking is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with ASCU Mobile Banking:
-Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
-Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
-Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
-Transfer money between your accounts
-Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
-Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
-View and save your monthly statements
-Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the ASCU app, you must be enrolled as an ASCU Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00144579:ios.description:
Organize, play and have a video game experience in your real life football.
The time has come to revolutionize your footy with the football app that is changing the way the sport is played in Brazil and around the world.
Appito allows you to book a field, organize matches and even find a game that will happen near you or that has your player profile.
Organize your football all in one place
- You can organize your matches, either by creating a group or a one-off game with other players.
- Invite players however you prefer: via WhatsApp, Facebook, Messenger, link, email or via the app itself.
- When you organize your football through Appito, you will also have a presence list for your match, with a confirmed and pending list. In addition, this list can be divided between the monthly and one-off players of your game.
- Tracking football payments is also much easier! With the payments tool you will be able to manage all the group’s money, as well as control whether the money has been paid or not, month by month. No more using that cash spreadsheet or that old notebook.
- Also count on the wall of the match, where you can talk to other players, facilitating the organization of your football.
- And if you need to complete the team, just make your game public to allow the people who are in the community to find it and fill the available slots. Never again will your football lack players.
- With the independent Apple Watch app version, you can keep track your fitness data and health stats for every football game you play. The app is integrated with CareKit and HealthKit in the watchOS 6 version so you can track your performance in the field.
Video game experience in real life
- If you are the kind of player who loves to play football anytime and when you get home plays football video game, now you can have both of these things in one app.
- Create your own player profile based on your real game characteristics.
- During and after the end of the games, you will be able to input football statistics by adding your goals, assists and defenses. In addition to being able to time and control the match.
- At the end of the game, all players evaluate each other, generating a ranking of the best players in the match, top scorer, top playmaker and best defender. This way, the ranking is generated from the grades and statistics that each player receives from other players.
- The grades you receive influence your profile’s evolution and allow you to track your progress, based entirely on your performance on the field.
Play more football!
- If you have that urge to play football, you can now find matches that will happen near you and that fit your players profile and availability.
- Now you can play football anytime. And rest assured, we will warn you if football matches that fit your profile and schedule happens near you.
- At the end of the game, you will be able to evaluate both the match and the organizer, so you will help other people decide where and with whom to play.
Rent a field in a practical way!
- It is now possible to rent fields from the app. See photos, information, ratings and contacts of the fields, all in a simple way.
- And if you want, you can also find football fields near you, according to your location

apple-macos:6757662900.name: NanoMouse - IME for AI era
apple-macos:6757662900.description:
NanoMouse is a Rime keyboard and BytePaste workspace built for AI input. It saves common prompts, snippets, materials and clipboard content, then syncs them across iPhone, iPad, Mac and the keyboard extension under the same iCloud account.
For AI chat, writing, coding and research, input is more than typing. You often need role settings, output formats, frequent phrases, images, Markdown, canvas sketches, causal graphs or quick voice notes. NanoMouse keeps those materials close to the keyboard.
Key features:
- Rime keyboard: Wusong Pinyin, double pinyin, Japanese romaji, stroke input and more.
- Pinyin shortcuts: easier rules such as `ng -> nn` and `uan/uang -> vn/vnn`.
- Mixed Chinese, Japanese and English input with quick switching.
- Long-press letters for extended characters, and long-press `123` for the number keypad.
- Keyboard toolbar for voice input, canvas, Markdown and BytePaste.
- AI workflow: store prompts, role settings, output templates, high-frequency text and code snippets in BytePaste.
- Multi-type cells: plain text, rich text, links, colors, images, camera, photo library, PDF, files, Markdown and canvas files.
- iCloud sync for cells and previews across devices signed in to the same iCloud account.
- Clipboard history: copy on Mac, reuse on iPhone, iPad or the keyboard extension.
- Voice input for capturing quick thoughts before turning them into AI-ready text.
- Markdown workspace with live preview, Mermaid diagrams and HTML color rendering.
- Canvas and causal graphs for expressing structure visually.
- macOS configuration tool for managing Squirrel/Rime settings without hand-editing YAML.
AI input and BytePaste are useful for:
- Pasting common prompts, system prompts, role settings and output formats with one tap.
- Reusing frequent phrases, canned replies, signatures, templates, code snippets and links.
- Keeping images, files or Markdown in fixed cells and continuing on another device.
- Recording ideas with voice, organizing context in Markdown, and expressing structure with canvas or causal graphs.
- Opening common materials inside the keyboard instead of switching between the current app and Files.
- Copying content on Mac and reusing it from the keyboard on iPhone or iPad.
Basic usage:
- In the main app or on Mac, open BytePaste and place common prompts, frequent phrases, rich text, images, files, Markdown, canvas files or causal graphs into cells.
- In any text field, switch to the NanoMouse keyboard and tap the BytePaste button in the toolbar.
- Plain text and prompts can be inserted by tapping a cell.
- Rich text, images, files, Markdown and canvas content are limited by the system keyboard environment. Usually, long press a cell, choose copy, preview, export or the matching action, then paste or insert it in the target app.
- Clipboard content copied on Mac can enter clipboard history and later be reused on iPhone, iPad or in the keyboard extension.
Long-press tips:
- Long press letters for extended characters.
- Long press `123` for the number keypad.
- Long press the language key to switch Chinese, Japanese and English input.
- Long press the candidate bar to switch between Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
- Long press or right-click a BytePaste cell to edit text, copy from clipboard, set as file, take a photo, choose from photo library, copy to clipboard or clear it.
NanoMouse respects system permissions and data boundaries. Voice, location, camera, photos and iCloud capabilities are used only when needed. BytePaste sync uses your private iCloud database and syncs only between devices signed in to the same iCloud account.
If you like Rime configurability and want less switching between typing, pasting, voice, drawing, Markdown and causal graphs before talking to AI, NanoMouse fits that workflow.
